tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rnam 'dren shākya seng ge dang*/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dbyer med sku/ /thar pa'i lam ston de la gus pa'i yid/ /rab tu rgyas pas dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ /dpal ldan bde chen sku ni ye shes lang tsho'i nyams 'gyur bye bas 'khyud/ /kun rtog sder bcas dbyings su zhi bas dri bral 'od kyis phyogs cha 'gengs/ /mtha' yas yon tan gser gyi dra bas mngon par khebs 'di srid zhi'i dpyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa gang des mtha' yas 'gro la dge bar mdzod/ /tha mal rtog pa'i yid kyi chom rkun ni/ /mi bzad srid pa'i lam du rtag par rgyu/ /rang yid mgron po rang gnas 'tshol 'dod kyang*/ /srid zhi'i longs spyod 'joms par byed mthong nas/ /gang zhig stobs ldan ye shes dpung gi tshogs/ /snang stong lha sku'i go cha chu khur 'phreng*/ /rab 'byams 'phrin las mtshon char dkrigs pa des/ /rab bsrung bde ba'i gnas su phyin byed 'gyur/ /bar chad sa rdul mi bzad zhi byed cing*/ /grub pa'i lo tog rnam par rgyas 'dod la/ /sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i char chen 'di phab kyi/ /skal ldan zhing pa'i tshogs kun dga' bar gyis/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rgyud sde rnams las yang dag par bstan zhing gsungs pa sgrub pa'i thabs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho lta bu dag las grub pa'i slob dpon so so'i yul dus gnas skabs tha dad par sems can so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa mdzad pa rnams deng 'dir chabs cig tu 'god par bya ste/ ji ltar rgya mtsho las char sprin gyi phung po dag byung la/

de dag las kyang yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i char dag yul so sor babs so/ /de dag kyang sa'i bye brag tha dad pa dang 'brel bas/ chu mig dang*/ lteng ka dang*/ lu ma dang*/ mtshe'u dang*/ mtsho rdzing sna tshogs par gyur nas/ yul dang yul dag tu chu phran rnam pa mang po dag 'babs pa de dag kyang mthar gyi yongs su 'du ba'i rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes pa rin po che du mas gang bar 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /deng 'dir rdo rje 'chang chen po nas brtsams te/ skyes bu dam pa gcig nas gcig tu yongs su brgyud pa/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' ma nyams pa rnams bdag gis yongs su mnos pa las/ slob ma rjes bzung gi bya ba/ dbang bzhi'i don tshang yang dbang gi cho ga dngos ma yin zhing*/ bya ba'i rim pa yang shin tu zor yang ba rnams la byin rlabs kyi cho ga zhes rdo rje'i slob dpon rnams la rab tu grags te/ de ltar na/ byin rlabs dang*/ rjes gnang dang*/ rig gtad dang*/ bzlas lung dang kha cig lung tsam gyis 'grub pa ste/ de thams cad kyang dang por dbang bskur ba rnam par dag pa zhig yang dag par thob pas/ sngags kyi dam tshig dang ldan pa dag rjes su bzung bar bya ba yin gyi/ gzhan du na yi dam lha'i sgrub thabs rnams kyang 'bras bu mchog dang bral ba'o/ khyad par 'di na rnal 'byor bla med las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs mchog tu zab pa mang du yod pa'i phyir/ 'dus pa la sogs pa'i gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nod pa la 'di dag sbyin par bya'o/ /slob dpon yang 'di dag thob pa tsam gyis chog pa ma yin te/ rab tu na dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po/ 'dir bshad kyi lha rigs gtso bo gtso mo rnams kyi bsnyen pa song ba zhig dgos shing*/ min na'ang dam tshig can theg pa bla na med par dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba thams cad shes pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi las la mkhas pa zhig nges par dgos so/

/de la sgrub pa'i thabs grags che ba rnams nye bar mkho ba'i don dang*/ shin tu dkon pa kha cig ni brgyud pa mi 'chad par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang bdag gis thob pa rnams che long du bsdus pa ni/ 'di ltar thog ma kho nar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang khu las gnyan sgrol du grags pa dang*/ rje btsun ma rig byed ma/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ tshogs bdag dmar chen/ rdo rje sems dpa' ser po/ 7 bdun po de dag cung zad tshig sna ring bar byas te/ bkra shis pa'i don du/ thog mar blo yul du 'jebs pa'i phyir brjod do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can gyi sgrub thabs la/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi chings shes pa'i don du brgya rtsa'i nang gi thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i chings shes pa'i don du/ de'i nang gi dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang*/ zur bka' la thub chen gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba dang*/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi thub pa chen po dang*/ bcom ldan 'das sman bla dang*/ sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po ste/ 13 skabs 'di drug go /rnal 'byor bla med las 'byung ba dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sgrub thabs las/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso rkyang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje lhan skyes mahā mā ya/ 10 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes/ go cha'i dpa' bo drugago cha'i dpal mo drugabade mchog dkar po byang chub sgrub lam/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub/ mi tra dzo gi'i lugs kyi bde mchog spyan ras gzigs/ kyai rdor lhan skyes/ dus 'khor lhan skyes/ khro rgyal rdo rje shugs/ gshed dmar lhan skyes/ rdo rje 'jigs byed bsdus pa ste/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ 28 £© 'dir bcu bzhi'o// //de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyogs la/

nā ro mkha' spyod/ zhal gnyis ma dpyal lugs/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ in+d+ra mkha' spyod/ phag mo don grub ma/ phag mo dbu bcad ma/ phag mo gnam zhabs ma/ phag mo kurma pa dī/ phag mo bram ze dpal 'dzin lugs/ go zlog lhan cig skyes ma/ phag mo khros nag lha dgu/ phag dkar shes rab gsal byed de/ skabs 'dir bcu gnyis so/ /༈ de nas spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa jo bo lugs rgyas pa/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi spyan ras gzigs/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs/ don zhags lha lnga ba ri lugs/ don zhags kha che paṇa chen lugs/ kha sar pa ṇa lha lnga/ yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga/ sems nyid ngal gso/ gsang sgrub mi tra dzo gi'i lugs/ spyan ras gzigs nam mkha' rgyal po/ 'phags pa yid bzhin nor bu 'khor los bsgyur ba/ bcu gcig zhal 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ spyan ras gzigs rdo rje snying po/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra/ 'phags pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho ste/ skabs 'dir bco lnga'o/ /༈ sgrol ma'i skor la/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi sgrol ma/ kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi sgrol ljang dang*/ sgrol dkar/ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro/ u rgyan sgrol ma/ sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu/ sgrol ma dmar mo sa lugs/ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma/ sgrol ser gtso 'khor gsum pa/ rmi lam sgrol ma/ sgrol ma lha lnga/ phyag brgyad sgrol ma/ ka pa li tā ra/ tsan+da tā ra ste/ skabs 'di bcu bzhi'o/ /༈ phyag rdor gyi skor la 'phags pa u tsar+ya/ gos sngon can jo bo lugs/ gos sngon can ba ri lugs/ ras chung lugs kyi gtum chen bsrung ba'i mkhar dang*/ gtung chung khra thogs/ gtum po dmar po/ gos sngon can 'gro bzang lugs/ gsang bdag khang brtsegs ma/ dpal chen 'byung po 'dul byed de/ skabs 'dir dgu'o/ /༈ rta mgrin gyi skor la/ rta mgrin dpa' gcig lhan skyes su grags pa dang*/ rta mgrin khyung gshog can dang*/ rta mgrin shā na bzhi skor te/

jo bo lugs gsum dang*/ rta mgrin kha che paṇa chen lugs/ skyer sgang lugs/ lcags ral can te/ skabs 'dir drug go /༈ mi g.yo ba'i rigs la/ mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs ma/ sngon po jo lugs 'di bka' gdams lha bzhir bgrang rgyu yin/ mi g.yo dkar po/ mi g.yo phyag bzhi pa/ mi g.yo zhabs bzhi pa/ mi g.yo spre'u brgyad ma ste/ skabs 'dir drug go /༈ tshe sgrub kyi rigs la/ tshe dpag med sprul sku/ tshe dpag med ba ri lugs/ tshe dpag med dkar po mi tra lugs/ dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal lha dgu/ 'chi med rdo rje lha mo ste/ skabs 'dir drug go /༈ shes rab kyi lha'i rigs la/ 'jam dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs/ a ra pa tsa na dmar ser/ gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub/ 'jam dpal smra seng*/ 'jam dkar shes rab 'khor lo ste/ 'jam dbyangs kyi rigs lnga dang*/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs ni ri ti ba'i lugs/ sher phyin ser mo/ sher phyin dkar mo/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo ste/ skabs 'dir bcu'o/ /༈ rdo rje gdan pa lha drug tu grags pa las/ mi g.yo ba gong du song*/ 'od zer can ma/ thub pa mi ru shi ṣa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed dang bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ dam tshig gsum bkod gtso rkyang ste/ 'dir lnga'o/ ༈ dbang bsdud kyi lha'i rigs la/ ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub/ dmar chung skor gsum du grags pa'i dpal mo gser gyi snying thig can/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo/ lha mo te nu rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma thod rgyan/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes te/ skabs 'dir drug go /༈ de nas sna tshogs pa'i sde la/ rnam 'joms ljang khu/ rnam 'joms dkar po/ gsang 'dus las 'byung ba'i khro bo bgegs mthar byed/ sna tshogs yum dkar mo/ so sor 'brang ma/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma ser mo/ ri khrod ma rigs bzhi la le tshan gcigagaza' yum/ rme brtsegs dud kha/

rme brtsegs ljang khu/ khro mo rme brtsegs/ khro bo reg tshigabade mchog bya khyung*/ dus 'khor khyung khra rgyud lugs dang*/ man ngag lugs/ khyung ser/ 'jam dbyangs nag po/ lha mo shra ma ṇa/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma sngon mo dang*/ dmar mo/ 'jam dpal na ga rak+ṣa ste/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /༈ de nas rgya gar gyi slob dpon pur+ṇa badz+ra las mnos pa'i sgrub thabs 'di rnams la/ rgyud sde gong 'og dang lha rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod na'ang*/ lag len mthun zhing brgyud pa gcig pa'i phyir phyogs gcig tu brjod na/ sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od dpag med/ byams pa/ kun tu bzang po/ nam mkha'i snying po/ sa'i snying po/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs la/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ sna tshogs dbang po/ pad ma'i phyag/su kha wa ti/ don yod lcags kyu/ don yod mchod pa'i nor bu rnams dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po lhan skyes/ lha mo mā ma kī/ lha mo gos dkar mo/ gtsug gtor rnam rgyal phyag gnyis ma/ lha mo tsun+da phyag mang*/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ rta mgrin dkar po/ mi g.yo ba dmar po/ 'od zer can ma rta ljang can/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ lha mo ro langs ma/ gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma/ tshogs bdag ser po ste/ nyi shu rtsa drug go /༈ de nas nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs sngar sbyar ba 'dir gzhug par bya'o/ /༈ de nas nor lha'i rigs la/ rnam thos sras ser chen/ mdung dmar can rta sngon ma/ ljang seng be con can ma/ dmar po gar mkhan mchogagasung mchog lus ngag g.yo/ drag byed nag po rta sngon can/ dkar po tshe 'dzin te/ rnam sras rigs chen brgyad du grags pa dang*/ rnam sras ljang khu dzñā na lugs/ yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa ste bcu dang*/ dzaṃ bha la ser po gtso rkyang*/ gsang 'dus las 'byung ba'i dzaṃ ser/ dpa' bo chig grub las 'byung ba'i lha mang*/

dzaṃ bha la nag po kha che paṇa chen lugs/ dzaṃ la dkar po lha lnga/ dzaṃ la dmar po srog sgrub/ dmar po grwa pa mngon shes kyi lugs/ dzaṃ la ljang khu dus 'khor lugs te brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po/ sras gar mkhan mchog/sras rgyal ba khyu mchogalha mo dpal chen mo/ gzungs las 'byung ba'i nor rgyun ma/ nor rgyun ma ya mā ri'i lugs/ nor rgyun ma ba lang rdzi/ yid 'phrog nor rgyun ma/ gnod sbyin zha 'on rdo rje bdud 'dul/ gnod sbyin a pa ra dzi ta/ tshogs bdag chags pa rdo rje/ tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ 174 klu rgyal sog ma med/ dbyug gu ma spun gsum/ khol po kun+dha li ste sum cu so bzhi'o/ /༈ bstan srung mgon po lcam dral gyi rigs sna tshogs pa'i skor la/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa nag po bar chad kun sel/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/ 200 mgon ser nor srung blo 'phel/ mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po/ mgon ljang tshe bdag ste/ spyir byin rlabs kyi mgon po 'di la sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba khungs ma shin tu mang yang 'dir lnga po de tsam zhig bkod do/ /de nas ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs/ phyag bzhi pa nags rin lugs/ kun khyab yongs grags rga lo'i lugs/ mgon dmar rkang gling ma/ lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka /las mgon bya rog gdong can te/ phyag bzhi pa dang 'brel ba drug/gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ gur lha brgyad gur mgon phur zhabs khyung gshog can/ gur yum can klu sgrub lugs/ gur rkyang rngog lugs te lnga dang*/ legs ldan nag po mgon po sde lnga'i skor ni/ sku'i rigs la mgon po stag zhon/ gsung gi rigs la beng bka' ma/ gter ma/ legs ldan mched gsum/ aṃ gho ra/ lha chen dpal 'bar jo bo lugs/ thugs kyi rigs la/ gri gug dpa' gcigalho nub mgon po/ mgon po bzhi sbrag/gri gug kha che paṇa chen lugs/

gyi ljang lugs kyi mgon po lha bcu bdun ma/ 'di gur gyi rigs su grags na'ang gur dang gri gug ma ngo bo gcig pa la bsam na rung gi /ngo bo ni gri gug nyid yin no/ /gri gug lha dgu dzñā na lugs/ ber nag zangs gri can/ gcer bu zangs gri can/ yon tan gyi rigs la/ tshogs bdag mgon po seng ge'i gdan can/ 'phrin las kyi rigs la/ mgon po trak+shad gnyos lugs/ trak+shad seng zhon jo bo lugs/ trak+shad gri gug ma/ rkang thang ma/ ma ning ma/ 'brong zhal can/ shwa na'i zhal can rnams so/ /sku'i rigs dang mthun pa la/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus de dang las sgrub kyi khyad par/ las bzhi mgon po la le tshan gcig/zhal bzhi gdong brnyan can/ sha za ce spyang gdong rnams so/ /༈ lha mo'i skor la/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma/ dmag zor rgyal mo/ rang byung rgyal mo/ lha mo dung skyong ma/ bdud mo re ma tī/ klu mo phyag bzhi ma/ gnod sbyin re ma tī/ rdo rje gshog rgod ma/ lha mo e ka dza ṭī/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can rnams so/ /chos rgyal las kyi gshin rje/ dmar mo ma ru rtse bzhi skor/ dmar po khrag mdog ste gsum/ dur khrod bdag po lcam dral/ pu tra ming sring bran bdud/ dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral te/ skabs 'dir drug cu re gcig go /༈ de ltar de rnams kyi mthar bkra shis shing dge mtshan dang ldan pa'i don du chos skyong ba po'i sgrub thabs gsum dgod pa ni/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga rnams so/ 202 /de dag las sgrol dkar dang*/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang*/ thub pa rdo rje gdan dang*/ dam tshig gsum bkod dang*/ phyag rdor u tsa dang*/ 'jam dkar dang*/ nā ro mkha' spyod dang*/ phag mo dpyal lugs dang*/ gur mgon/ phyag bzhi pa/ phyag drug pa rnams kyi rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs re re tsam re thog mar byang por bzung bar bya'o/ /de ltar le tshan nyis brgya drug cu re gnyis po rnams las sgrol dkar la nang tshan sgrub thabs bzhir dbye ba dang*/

de bzhin du phag dkar la gnyis/ don zhags la gnyis/ ri khrod ma rigs bzhi la bzhi/ rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs snga ma la gnyis/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul la gnyis/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa rga lo lugs la gsum/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa la sgrub dus las sbyor gnyis so sor phye/ las bzhi mgon po la so sor phye bas bzhi ste/ de rnams sgrub thabs kyang mi 'dra zhing*/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba yang so sor dgos pas/ sgrub thabs so so re re bar byed dgos shing*/ de bzhin du nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan la/ spyi'i sgrub thabs su grags pa rtsa ba'i sgrol ma dang*/ las tshogs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcigasgrub thabs dang*/ bstod pa rnam dag gtsug nor ma la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi dgu pa bstod pa las seng ldeng nags sgrol du bshad/ de dang phyogs mthun seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum pa 'phros don du bshad pas/ rjes gnang nyer gsum mam/ nyer bzhi 'byung*/ de rnams kyi nang nas re re nyis brgya drug cu re gnyis dkyus kyi grangs la bcug/lha por sgrol dkar gsum/ phag dkar gcigadon zhags gciga'abyung 'dul gcigarnam 'joms gcigari khrod ma gsum/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa la gnyis/ zhal bzhi pa la bzhi ste bcu drug dang*/ nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma la nyi shu rtsa gsum ste bsdoms pas sum cu so dgu yin la/ de dang sngar gyi nyis brgya drug cu re gnyis bsdoms pas gcig gis lhag pa'i sum brgya'o/ /༈ de rnams las/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon las dngos su thob pa'i sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa la/ mahā mā ya dang*/ nag po chen po grub chen zhi ba'i lugs/ phyag rdor dang mā ma kī 'gro lding ba'i lugs/ lhag ma nyer bzhi shākya rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa yin no//gzhan yang sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo gnyan lugs dang ba ri lugs/

gnyan sgrol/ dmar po skor gsum/ thub pa rdo rje gdan/ bde kyai lhan skyes/ go cha gnyis/ seng ge sgra/ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro/ sgrol ma dmar mo/ phyag rdor ba ri lugs/ 'byung 'dul ring brgyud/ mi g.yo sngon po sogs rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drugami g.yo phyag bzhi/ mi g.yo zhabs bzhi/ tshe dpag med ba ri lugs/ rnam rgyal rdo rje lha mo/ a ra pa tsa na ser po/ sher phyin dkar mo/ ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub/ dmar mo skor gsum/ dmar chung skor gsum/ rnam 'joms ljang khu/ bgegs mthar byed/ so sor 'brang ma/ gdugs dkar/ ri khrod ma rigs lnga/ gza' yum/ rme brtsegs dud kha/ khyung khra man ngag lugs/ 'jam nagaseng gdong ma gnyis/ dzaṃ dmar srog sgrub/ mgon po gur rigs gsum/ zangs gri rigs gnyis/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra/ bran bdud/ dkar bdud lcam dral te/ zur bka' de rnams/ dpal ldan sa skya ba yab sras kyi chos so/ /don zhags ser po dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga yang re zhig brgyud pa 'di phyogs su 'ded mod kyi/ de gnyis la rje btsun gong ma lnga'i yig rigs dang man ngag med cing*/ phyi ma ni jo bo rje nas nges par brgyud dgos pas/ ba ri lots+tsha ba man chad brgyud pa 'di la phyogs gcig tu bzhugs kyang*/ jo bo'i gdams pa yin no/ /sgrol dkar jo bo lugs/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ thub pa gnas bcu/ bka' gdams lha bzhi/ sman bla/ klu dbang rgyal po spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa/ yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga/ yid bzhin 'khor lo/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ sgrol ma lha lnga/ phyag brgyad sgrol ma/ gzungs las 'byung ba'i phyag rdor/ rta mgrin rigs gsum/ rme brtsegs ljang khu/ khyung ser/ shra ma ṇa/ dzaṃ ser lha mang*/ dzaṃ la dkar po/ a pa ra dzi ta/ tshogs bdag dkar po rigs gnyis/ sngags bdag sog ma med/ dbyug gu ma/ kun+da li/ rtsis mgon/ gri gug lhan skyes/ lho nub pa/ bzhi sbrag

/tshogs bdag mgon po/ trak+shad seng zhon/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma rnams phal cher jo bo rje las brgyud pa dang*/ bka' gdams lugs so/ /bde mchog dkar po gnyis/ go zlog lhan cig skyes ma/ don yod zhags pa/ sgrol ljang*/ sgrol dkar/ sgrol ma nor sbyin/ sgrol ser gtso 'khor gsum ma/ rmi lam sgrol ma/ rta mgrin rigs gcigami g.yo ba dkar po/ 'jam dkar rigs gnyis/ byams pa ni ri ti pa'i lugs/ dzaṃ nagamagon po gri gug rigs gcig ste/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa bcu drug yod pa rnams shas che ba zhig khro phu ba dang 'brel/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ bde mchog spyan ras gzigs/ dus 'khor lhan skyes/ phag mo khro mo/ spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub/ sems nyid ngal gso/ spyan ras gzigs rdo rje snying po/ sher phyin ser mo/ dbyangs can dkar mo phyag bzhi ma/ rnam sras ser chen gyi brgyud pa'i lugs gcig /nor rgyun ma rigs gsum/ gar mkhan mchogargyal ba khyu mchogalha mo dpal chen mo rnams kyang khro phu ba'i gdams pa'o/ /gzhan yang phag dkar/ sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu/ dzaṃ ser phyag gnyis gtso rkyang*/ gzungs las byung ba'i nor rgyun ma rnams rat+na rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag dang*/ rdo rje shugs/ sna tshogs yum dkar mo/ khyung khra rgyud lugs/ dzaṃ bha la ljang khu rnams dus 'khor las 'byung zhing*/ jo nang pa'i man ngag gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ sgrol dkar dang*/ phag dkar dang*/ kha sar+pa ṇa/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang*/ gur rnams kyi rigs re re nags rin nas brgyud pa sogs sgrub thabs lhag ma rnams brgyud pa'i bka' babs sna tshogs las 'byung ba'i tshul ni 'chad 'gyur brgyud yig la brtags pas shes par 'gyur ro/ /phyis gang las bka' babs pa ni/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo jo bo lugs/ ba ri lugs/ nags rin lugs te gsum dang*/ dbyangs can dkar mo dang dmar mo/ dmar po skor gsum/ mkha' spyod ma skor gsum/

rdo rje gdan/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ klu dbang rgyal po/ yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga/ phyag rdor 'gro bzang*/ 'byung 'dul nye brgyud/ rta mgrin lcags ral can/ rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms ljang khu/ gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub/ sher phyin dkar mo/ rme brtsegs ljang khu/ rnam thos sras rigs chen brgyad/ dzaṃ la dkar po/ phyag drug pa nag po/ gur lcam dral dang lha brgyad/ zhal bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ pu tra*/ tshe ring ma rnams dang*/ gong du bshad pa'i kha che paṇa chen dang*/ khro phu ba las brgyud pa de rnams las go zlog lhan cig skyes ma/ don zhags/ sgrol dkar/ sems nyid ngal gso/ spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub rnams ma gtogs gzhan thams cad de/ zur bka' drug cu lhag bcas dang*/ nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs sgrol ma'i skor nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rgyal ba shākya mchog ldan nas brgyud pa yin la/ phag mo nag mo/ spyan gzigs gsang sgrub/ u rgyan sgrol ma/ sgrol ma dmar mo/ kā pa li tā ra/ tsun+da tā ra/ phyag rdor gtum po che chung*/ shwa na bzhi skor/ mi g.yo phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ spre'u brgyad ma/ tshe dpag med ba ri lugs/ ras chung lugs gnyis/ gsang ba ye shes/ rnam sras ljang khu/ gsang 'dus kyi dzaṃ la/ a pa ra dzi ta/ tshogs bdag dkar po gnyis/ gri gug lha dgu/ ce spyang gdong*/ trak+shad dwags po lugs/ ma ning ma/ 'brong zhal/ dpal lha mo rdo rje gshog rgod ma rnams dpal stag lung gi bka' brgyud ri bo che ba las brgyud par shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan dang gzhan las brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams kyang brgyud yig la zhib mor brtags pas shes la/ kho bos bla ma dam pa bcu gsum tsam las rnyed pa yin no/ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ rgya mtsho gnyis chings tha dad yin zhing*/ thun mong gi bya ba de gnyis la kha 'phangs kyi rigs mang du yod pas/ 'dir thub pa rdo rje gdan dang*/ dam tshig gsum bkod las shes dgos pas/

de dag nges par slob/ de ltar sgrub thabs sum brgya lhag bcas de rnams las shin tu nye bar mkho ba gtso bo gtso bo dag bsdu bar spro na 'di ltar bya ste/ sgrol dkar jo bo lugs/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ gnyan sgrol/ dmar po skor gsum/ thub pa rdo rje gdan/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ sman bla/ gnas brtan bcu drugaklu dbang rgyal po/ bde mchog kyai rdor/ dus 'khor gsang 'dus te lhan skyes bzhi/ nā ro mkha' spyod zhal gnyis ma dpyal lugs/ yi ge drug pa jo bo lugs rgyas pa/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs/ don zhags dkar po ba ri lugs/ kha sar+pa ṇa lha lnga/ phyag rdor u tsa/ gtum chen/ 'gro bzang*/ 'byung 'dul/ rta mgṛn dpa' gcigaskyer sgang lugs/ lcags ral can/ mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs ma dang dkar po/ tshe dpag med dkar po mi tra lugs/ rnam rgyal lha dgu/ 'jam dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs/ a ra pa tsa na dmar ser/ rnam 'joms ljang khu/ byams pa/ sher phyin dkar mo/ sna tshogs yum/ so sor 'brang ma/ gtsug gtor gdugs dkar/ 'od zer can ma/ ri khrod ma ser mo/ gza' yum/ rme brtsegs dud kha/ khyung khra man ngag lugs/ 'jam dbyangs nag po/ seng gdong ma sngon mo/ rnam thos sras ser chen/ dzaṃ ser gtso rkyang*/ dzaṃ nag kha che lugs/ gzungs las 'byung ba'i nor rgyun ma/ tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa dkar nag gnyis/ phyag bzhi pa rga lo lugs las 'gro mgon phag gru'i phyag bzhes/ gur lcam dral dang lha brgyad/ stag zhon/ ber bka' ma/ gri gug dpa' gcig/trak+shad gnyos lugs/ zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus/ dud sol ma/ dmar zor ma/ las gshin mthing kha/ dur khrod bdag po/ rgyal chen sde bzhi rnams so/ /lha'i ngo bo/ shāka thub/ sman bla/ tshe dpag med/ klu dbang rgyal po/ bde kyai gsang gsum/ dus 'khor/ mā ya/ gshin rje gshed/ rnal 'byor ma/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag rdor zhi khro/

rta mgrin mi g.yo ba/ rnam rgyal/ byams pa/ dbyangs can ma/ sher phyin ma/ 'od zer can ma/ ku ru kul+le 'dod rgyal/ te nu/ rnam 'joms/ rme brtsegs pho mo/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ sna tshogs yum/ sor 'brang*/ gdugs dkar/ ri khrod ma/ gza' yum/ khyung*/ shra ma ṇa/ seng gdong ma/ nā ga rak+ṣa/ yang kun tu bzang po/ nam snying*/ sa snying*/ sgrib sel/ lha mo bzhi/ tsun+da/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ 'phrog ma/ rnam sras/ dzaṃ bha la/ nor rgyun ma/ nor bzang*/ sras gnyis/ a pa ra/ tshogs bdagasog ma med/ dbyug gu ma/ kun+da li/ ye shes mgon po/ legs ldan mgon po/ 'dod khams ma dpon g.yog/ral gcig ma/ gshin rje/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra/ dkar bdud/ rgyal chen/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ tshe ring ma rnams su 'dus la/ de dag la yang dper na/ spyan ras gzigs kyi khongs su sgrol ma/ kul+le/ rta mgrin sogs 'dus pa re re la/ nang tshan yang cung zad mi 'dra ba yod pa sogs kyis mtshon te/ gzhan yang lha rigs so so'i dbye ba dang*/ rgyud sde gong 'og gi rim pa dang*/ mchog sgrub dang las sgrub kyi dbye ba dang*/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gang du gtogs pa dang*/ rgyud gzhung gi dngos bstan dang*/ man ngag gi dbye ba dang*/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ slob ma rjes bzung gi bya ba'i khyad par bzhi po de rnams kyi dbye ba sogs zhib mor nges shing*/ blo gros thogs pa med par bya'o/ /de ltar sgrub thabs thabs tshul rnam mang gi /spyi'i rnam gzhag cung zad rigs byas nas/ /so so'i nyams len man ngag khyad par dag/rgyas par 'chad 'gyur 'di la dga' bar gyis/ /yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba las spyi chings bshad pa'i skabs te dang po'o// //zhus dag /bkra shis/ /

༄༅/ /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhina'akhor lo'i bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len mchog tu gsal ba bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / na mo ār+ya tā re/ rab dkar lhun sdug ri dbang ke la shar/ /rab mdzes zla zhun 'khyil ba'i dpal mnga' ba/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /'chi bdag g.yul ngo bzlog mdzad myur zhing dpa'/ /'phags ma sgrol ma de la ni/ /mchog tu dang bas phyag bgyis te/ /de'i sgrub thabs yan lag bcas/ go bde gsal ba'i tshig gis brjod/ /'dir 'chi med lha mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la gnyis te/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ thub mtshams kyi bya ba'o/ / dang po la/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ sngon 'gro la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= lan gsum la sogs pas skyabs su 'gro'o/ / sems cad thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ / lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sngar yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mdor bsdus su bzung ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/

bsod nams tshogs bsog dang*/ ye shes tshogs gsog go /dang po ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du tāṃḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ 'og gi cha la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ / zhes pa nas/ bar la bdud dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal sbyin ma/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba'i/ /sgrol ma lha tshogs bcas la 'dud/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ ar+ghaṃ gyi sar pād+yaṃ sbyar/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai we te/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ don yid la dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cigasdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cigasdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur ciganye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig/ ces brjod/gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa ni/ chos thams cad rang gi sems tsam dang*/ sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug chu zla lta bu la mnyam pa bzhag ste/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ yi ge bkod pa/ ye shes pa bstim pa/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod cing bstod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las ma bcos pa'i sems snang hūṃ gi sgra gdangs nam mkha' gang ba/

hūṃ las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa gur/ bla bre/ me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i dbus su bh+ruṃ las snod kyi 'jig rten zla ba chu shel gyi gzhal yas khang*/ dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong ldan yal ga lo 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i sdong po dang bcas pa/ pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba nya gang zhing*/ rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid tāṃḥyig dkar po las ut+pal dkar po'i sdong po ze'u 'bru la tāṃḥyig dkar pos mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid lha mo sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ nor bu chu shel ltar dwangs la dri ma med pa 'od zer lnga ldan du 'phro ba/ rab tu zhi ba chen po'i 'dzum zhal can/ ut+pa la'i 'dab ma ltar rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan bdun dang ldan ma/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pa'i 'theb srin gyis ut+pa la dkar po'i sdong bu'i rtsa ba thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ rab tu rgyas pa'i snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba bsnams pa/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams ldan nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ mu tig dkar po gtso bor gyur pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do shal/ se mo do/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ sked rgyan/ zhabs gdub/ g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang bcas pa dang*/ lha rdzas kyi me tog du mas mdzes pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ sna tshogs dar gyi smad dkris gsol ba/ dbu skra : yib [ li ba ] ltag par bcings pa'i zung phud rnam par g.yo zhing*/ gzhon nu'i lus can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'gying tshul du bzhugs shing*/ ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyab yol can du gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/

hūṃ gi stod tsam du pad dkar dang zla ba la tāṃḥyig dkar po/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyi sa mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis gong bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma thams cad dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ lnga pa ni/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gong bzhin/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad ma la btud de/ /'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i gdan la/ 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar zla ba la tāṃḥyig dkar po/ mtha' skor du oṃ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig hā/ zhes pa rnams g.yas bskor dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la/ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā/ zhes yi ge brgyad kyis bskor ba gsal btab/

sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe spel ba la sogs pa'i don byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rjes byin rlabs rnams tshur bsdus/ 'od zer rnams sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas/ bkrags mdangs gzi brjid rab tu 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa de nyid la gnas bzhin pa'i sgo nas/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa yi ge bcu pa ste snying po'o/ / oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye dzñā na puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes spel tshig dang bcas pa 'di ni las sngags so/ /bsnyen pa sogs thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa na/ bzlas pa'i ngo bo yi ge bcu pa la byed cing*/ thun so so rdzogs mtshams su spel tshig dang bcas pa yang brgya rtsa brgyad re bzla bar bya'o/ /rgyun gyi bzlas pa la ni/ spel tshig dang bcas pa kho na bzla ba yin no/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad bdag nyid kyis bsgoms pa'i bsrung 'khor la thim/ rang nyid rten dang brten par bcas pa yang thugs ka'i tāṃḥyig la thim/ de nyid kyang khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla phyed/ thig le/ nā da rnams gcig la gcig thim/ nā da yang 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs par gyur/ slar yang rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad don dam par rang bzhin med pa/ snang cha sgyu ma lta bu/ ye shes lha'i ngo bor rnam par dag go /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/sgrol ma dkar mo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog/dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/

/bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog/ bdag bskyed bsdus pa la mos na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsdus pa byas la/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms te/ oṃ shū n+ya ta zhes pa man chad kyis chog cing*/ shin du bsdu na/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ pad zla'i gdan la/ tāṃḥlas rang nyid lha mo sgrol ma zhes sogs dang*/ ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyab yol can/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ dpral bar zla ba la nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho'i bar bya/ de nas bzlas pa la 'jug go / gnyis pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba ni/ bris sku bgram/ maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon dkar pos pad ma 'dab brgyad bris/ lte ba la rdul tshon dkar po'am/ 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ dkar gtor gcig dang mchod pa bshams/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ me tog gi gang pa'i snod/ dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba/ ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa 'dus byas la/ rang skad cig gis sgrol ma dkar mor gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ lan nyer gcig gam/ brgya rtsa tsam bzla zhing*/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgyas ku sha'i 'thor yab bzung ngo*/ /de ni bsang chu sgrub pa yin no/ /bsang chu de nyid gnas khang dang mchod rdzas sogs la gtor/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams ye shes kyi rang bzhin/

mchod pa'i rnam pa/ zag med bde chen gyi rgyu bla na med pa'i mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nai we te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pa ra mi ta na da sam+bha we te/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni/ san+to ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ mdud bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ gi sgra gdangs nam mkha' gang ba zhes pa nas/ rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba/ de'i steng du tāṃḥdakar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha mo sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra/ gal te cung zad spros pa la mos na/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i skabs/ tshigs bcad dang*/ mchod yon gdan 'bul sogs rgyas par byas kyang rung ngo*/ / slar yang rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang gi tshogs thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ zhes pa nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ a mṛ ta 'i sngags kyis phyis 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ rin po che'i khri dang*/ pad zla la sogs pa'i gdan phul bar bsam/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ sngags kyi 'gor pad skor dang*/ 'jug tu se gol gtogs shing*/ ar+ghaṃ zhes sogs so so'i ming gi skabs/ mchod yon sogs so so'i phyag rgya bca' ba phyag len yin no/

/ oṃ ār+ya tā re gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pād+yaṃ la yang sbyar bas/ zhabs bsil 'bul/ me tog la/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wa ra bh+yaḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ bdug spos dang*/ ā lo ke mar me dang*/ gan+dhe/ dri chab dang*/ nai wi te/ zhal zas/ shap+ta rol mo rnams 'bul lo/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tut+tā ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba kun las skyob/ sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma/ /mchog sbyin sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i gdangs 'dra zhing*/ /zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcu drug lo lon lus can ma/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams khyod kyi sras/ /'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum/ /'phags ma sgrol ma phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor lo dkar po 'od zer 'bar/ /rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad/ /yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can/ /yid bzhin 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod/

/gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba rin po che las grub pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum mam lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis rje btsun ma dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis 'khor tshogs thams cad la phul bar mos/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ dge ba can ma gzi brjid ldan/ /dbyangs can ma dang nor gyi bdag/dpal mo la sogs sprul pa mdzad/ /lha mo sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*/ /mgon med rnams kyi mgon dang skyabs/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod cing*/ khyad par yid la 'dod pa'i don gang yin pa de nyid 'grub par gsol ba drag tu btab bo/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ / zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa rten rnams la me tog dor zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ mchod gtor gyi mgron rnams gshegs su gsol bar mos te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas bsdus gang 'os bya'o/ /'di dag la rgyun gyi nyams len la/ mchod chog sogs rgyas pa mi lcogs na/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gsum po gang rung zhig blangs la/ ye shes lha'i ngo bor rnam par dag go / zhes pa yan chad bya/ de nas gtor chog tsam bya ba yin te/ gong bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/

lho phyogs po ṭa la'i ri bo nas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ tā re zhes pa nas/ bkra shis kyi bar gtor ma 'bul tshul gong bzhin bya'o/ /de yang snga dro lta bu bdag bskyed kyi thun 'jug de nyid du gtor ma phul kyang rung*/ bdag bskyed snga dro blangs nas/ srod thun sogs la gtor ma phul kyang rung ngo*/ /'di'i bsnyen pa'i lag len ni/ bris sku maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor sogs zhal lhor bstan la gong ltar bsham/ bdag nyid gdong byang du phyogs pas/ gong mchod chog gi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ mchod pa byin rlabs yan chad byas pa'i rjes la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed yongs su rdzogs pa byed la/ bzlas pa'i gtso bo yang bdag bskyed kyi skabs 'di nyid rang yin zhing*/ bdag bskyed kyi thun rdzogs pa na/ rab tu thun bzhi char gyi mthar/ gong du bshad pa'i mchod gtor gyi cho ga yongs rdzogs tshar re bya zhing*/ 'bring du na snga thun dang*/ srod thun la bdag mdun mchod gtor yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa re bya la/ thun bar pa gnyis la skyabs 'gro nas dge ba bsngo ba'i bar bdag bskyed kho na bya'o/ /tha mas de yang ma grub na/ snga thun gyi mthar mchod gtor 'bul ba rgyas pa'i las la bsngags pa yin no/ /yang shin tu rtsol ba chung bas de yang ma 'grub na/ snga thun gyi mthar/ gong du bstan pa ltar gyi dus rgyun gyi lag len gyi gtor chog de bya zhing*/ tshes bco lnga sogs dus bzang rnams la/ mdun bskyed gtor ma dang bcas pa rgyas pa de byas pas kyang 'grub pa yin no/ /spyir bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ sngags spel tshig can de mi the ba'i yi ge bcu pa nyid la 'bum phrag bcu grangs bsnyen yin la bye ba song na las dang dngos grub rnams sgrub pa la dbang ba yin no/

/'on kyang zhag bdun tsam la bzlas pa gang song byas pas kyang phan yon dpag tu med pa yod pas de yang nan tan du bya ba kho na'o/ /spyir kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir sgrol dkar gyi chos skor lugs lnga tsam byon par grags te/ jo bo rje'i lugs dang*/ gnyan lots+tsha ba'i lugs dang*/ ba ri lots+tsha ba'i lugs dang*/ nye brgyud paṇa chen nags rin gyi lugs te/ bzhi po de slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i gdams pa dang 'brel ba yin la/ lnga pa ni paṇa chen shākya shrī lugs te/ lha sngags kyang rnam pa gzhan du gnas pa yin no/ /de dag las 'di ni snga 'gyur jo bo lugs gtso bor byas pa ste/ phyis jo bo lugs kyi sgrol dkar gyi sgrub mchod du grags pa'i yig cha gsar pa rnams ni rang lugs kyi thob thang ma tshang zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi bdag 'jug sogs gzhan gyi bsre lhad dang*/ rang bzo du ma byas pa dag kyang mthong ngo*/ /'dir skyon de dag thams cad 'bad pas spangs shing*/ rang lugs kyi snying po tshang la ma 'khrugs pa legs par brjod pa'o/ /bsam gyi mi khyab zab mo'i phyogs grol la/ /blo dman byung dus dor byir mi nus mod/ /man ngag la brten cung zad sbyar ba 'di/ /blo ldan lam 'dir mos la yid bde'i gnas/ /'di bris rnam par dkar ba des/ /'gro kun 'chi med rdo rje'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyur sgrol ma yi/ /go 'phang myung du thob par shog/ces pa sgrol dkar jo bo lugs/ brgyud pa'i bka' srol gnyis la brten pa'i man ngag bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len gsal bar bkod pa bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ 'jig rten mgon po stag lung thang pa'i byin rlabs kyis 'tsho 'di ga zhes pa/ dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag mi dbang tshe brtan rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'am/ ming gzhan kun dga' snying po zhes bya bas gnyan thog gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o//

//bkra shis// ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'phrin las lhun grub lha mo'i sku/ /sgrol ma'i tshogs la gus btud de/ yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang gi /rim pa cung zad bri bar bya/ /'di la slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa bdag bskyed/ mdud bskyed mtha' dag sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen sgrub gyi lag len gsal bar bkod pa bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhin bya ba las/ rdul tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'bri ba ma lcogs na/ maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu bkod pa tsam gyis chog cing*/ mdud bskyed kyi bstod pa'i rjes/ gtor chog gi sngon du bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor chog song ba'i mtshams su/ slob ma rjes 'dzin bya ste/ slob ma rnams sgo drung du khrus bya ba ma 'grub na/ kha bshal ba'i chab btang*/ gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu bya ste/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod/ sems cad thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de ma thob kyi bar du yang phyi nang gi 'jigs pa bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa'i don thams cad gegs med par 'grub cing*/ khyad par du tshe'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang zab mo zhu snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang mdo rgyud rin po che nas ji skad bka' stsal ba ltar legs par gsal btab te gsan par mdzad pa zhu/ 'dir grub pa'i slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa zhes bya ba rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhal rtag tu gzigs pa des/ rgyud sde mang po nas gsungs pa'i tshe bsgrub phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i 'chi bslu blu chen mo zhes bya ba sh+lau ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa zhig mdzad/ de'i nang na sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gsal bar bzhugs/

slob dpon de'i slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta thu bo zhes bya bas de logs su phyung ba'i sgrub thabs kyang mdzad/ de chos 'di'i gzhung gi rtsa ba yin zhing*/ de nyid kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir snga 'gyur jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i lugs dang*/ bar 'gyur gnyan lugs dang*/ ba ri lugs/ phyi 'gyur nags rin lugs kyi nye brgyud de lugs bzhi yod pa las/ 'di snga 'gyur yin/ de yang slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa la gser gling pas gsan/ de la jo bo rjes gsan/ jo bos bod du mang du gnang na'ang*/ 'di 'brom ston las brgyud pa yin zhing*/ bar skabs su sgam po lugs dang*/ bka' gdams lugs zhes brgyud pa tha dad du gyes pa yod na'ang*/ man ngag gi ngo bo la dbye ba med cing*/ 'dir de gnyis kar brgyud pa gcig tu 'dus pa yin la/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song*/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces brjod/ slob mas kyang maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ / bdag ni 'gro la phan don du/ /gtso chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ / lan gsum/ de nas rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa ni/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis kar 'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bzhugs par bsams la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi 'dun pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs lan gsum/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la yid rang ba/ skyabs 'gro dang smon pa sems bskyed du 'jug sdom len pa dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs lan gsum/ rjes gnang dngos la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gy-i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas rnam smin sha khrag rdos bcas kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs te stong bar sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ rgyab yol can du gyur/ dpral bar zla ba zhes pa nas/ tāṃḥdakar po/ de nas slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim/ lho phyogs ri bo po ta la nas/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo la/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams la thim/ slob dpon dang sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs ka nas/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam/ yang chung rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin du khyed rang rnams kyi lus la gnyis su med par sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ dri zhim po'i spos dud dang*/ rol mo 'jam rol rgyun ring bas byin dbab/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol bzhin pas/ oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra a be sha a a/ zhes lan nyer gcig nas brgya rtsa'i bar gang 'os pa brjod do/ / des sku'i rjes gnang grub pa lags/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar pad zla la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃḥyig dkar po/ mtha' skor du oṃ ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye dzñā na puṣ+tiṃ ku ru hā/ rtsibs brgyad la/

tā re tut+tā re tu re swā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams kha dog dkar po mgo gyen bstan/ kha nang du phyogs pa 'od zer dkar po 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du bzhugs par mos/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las sngags 'phreng gnyis pa chad/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lte ba dang*/ rtsibs rnams la spar btab pa bzhin du 'khor bar mos la/ 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ yi ge bcu pa lan bdun dang*/ sngags spel tshig can lan gsum rjes zlos byed gzhug des sngags kyi bzlas lung thob/ 'on kyang bzlas brjod ma byas na/ lung phog pa tsam gyis dngos grub mi thob pas/ bzlas brjod kyi don du dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub ma thob bar du/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gzungs sngags nyin re la rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa 'di tsam re ma chag par bzla snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gzungs sngags nyin re la ci nus re bzla bar dam 'cha' lags so/ / lan gsum/ de ltar sngags bzlas pas kyang dngos grub tsam thob par 'gyur ba yin mod kyi/ lo dang zla ba mang por bsgrubs pas mthar gyi dngos grub 'thob pa zhig kyang*/ bla ma dang lha'i byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis nyin zhag 'ga' zhig tsam gyis khyad 'grub pa'i phyir/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung bya dgos pas/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / ces lan gsum/ de ltar phul bas me tog de nyid sngags 'phreng du byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas gtor bas/ spyi gtsug gi sgo nas zhugs te/ snying gar sngags 'phreng la thim zhing*/ byin gyis brlabs par mos mdzod/ me tog spyi bor gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / ces lan gsum snying gar gtor te/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zab mo'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad thogs med du 'jug par gyur cigades gsung gi rjes gnang thob pa lags/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad phyag mtshan ut+pal dkar po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro bas rnam par spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar thim/ mdun bskyed la mos gus dung ba byas/ de nyid rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'od kyi gong bur zhu ba spyi bo nas zhugs te snying gar thim/ de'i ngang der sems dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa thams cad spangs te/ cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ ces brjod la cung zad mi rtog pa sgom du gzhugades thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa lags/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/

lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod ces brjod la/ slob mas kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba'i dngos po thams cad lha dang bla ma la 'bul/ cha shas kyang longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyod kyis slob ma bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ lan gsum/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod/ des slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i bya ba rdzogs pa yin/ rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i nas/ a khaṃ swāhā 'i bar kyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ār+ya tā re gu ru bud+dha nas/ sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum nas/ bkra shis kyi bar yang sgrub thabs kyi mchod chog bzhin bya'o/ /'di ni sgrol dkar jo bo lugs kyi dbang du byas pa ste/ lugs bzhi'i nang nas rtsa ba'am/ ma lta bur gyur pa yin la/ lugs 'di la tshe khrid zab mo'ang bzhugs shing*/ las tshogs kyang mang rab yod do/ /lugs gzhan rnams kyi khyad par cung zad tsam brjod na/ ba ri lugs dang*/ gnyan lugs la sgrub thabs kyi skabs gnas gsum byin rlabs med/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med yin/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra/ gnyan lugs la bum chog spyi dang mthun pa'i bum pa zhig bcas la/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mthar bkru byabs bsrung gsum mdzad/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor la 'khor lo'i mu khyud la oṃ yig gi 'phreng ba bsgom/ ba ri lugs la sku'i rnam pa'ang spyan gnyis ma gtso bor mdzad/ sku 'gying bag med pa'i drang po/

g.yon gyi ut+pal dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i me tog kha zum zhing yal ba dang*/ 'bus pa dang*/ rgyas pa gsum yod/ lugs 'di la las tshogs shin tu mang*/ paṇa chen nags rin gyi lugs la/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems kho na yin/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las bsrung 'khor dang*/ bh+ruṃ las chu shel gyi gzhal med khang*/ der tāṃḥlas sgrol dkar 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan rang chas su yod pa zhig bsgom/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod bstod rnams bdag bskyed la mi mdzad/ rjes gnang la phal cher jo bo lugs dang 'dra ba las/ sngon 'gro'i skabs sangs rgyas chos dang ma mi dgos/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi skabs/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags 'khor la bstim/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi skabs/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sngags 'khor gyi 'od kyis rigs bdag bskul/ phyag gi lhung bzed kyi 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad kyi bcud bsdus nas slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor la bstim/ 'di dang ba ri lugs gnyis mthun par las sngags kho na la bzlas pa byed cing*/ 'khor lo la mu khyud rim pa gsum gyi nang ma la ā li g.yon bskor/ bar pa la kā li g.yas bskor/ phyi ma la rten 'brel snying po g.yas bskor du bsgom/ paṇa chen shākya shrīs kyang ngag dbang grags pa'i lugs 'di cung zad gsungs shing bsgyur bar yang mdzad mod kyi/ deng sang de nas brgyud pa'i bka' med par mngon/ paṇa chen nyid kyi zhal gzigs ni lha dgu ma yin la/ sngags kyang gzhan yin pa'i phyir ngag dbang grags pa'i lugs dang ma 'brel bas/ lugs 'di dag dang bsre bar mi bya ste/ sgrub thabs kyang logs su ston to/ /'di shes chos 'di'i lugs srol kuna~X/ /ma 'dres so so'i 'byed la dga~X'/

/yig tshogs che ba mi ngom par/ /snyinga~X po~X'i gnad la mkhas par 'gyur/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rjes gnang gi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ye shes 'char ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ye shes 'char ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /gdul bya'i blo mun bsal ba'i phyir/ /thabs mkhas lha mo'i skur sprul pa/ /dpal mo dbyangs can ma la 'dud/ /sgrub thabs mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ /man ngag bcas pa mdor bsdus te/ /blo ldan gzhan la phan don du/ /cung zad yi ge'i lam du spel/ /'di la bsnyen pa'i man ngag dang*/ mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ nyer mkho'i man ngag ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las snod kyi 'jig rten lha dang drang srong dri za grub pa'i tshogs kyis bsten pa'i gnas/ ri bo nags tshal sman ljongs nyams dga' ba'i dbus/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar la dwangs pa'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma 'bum phrag rgyas pa'i sdong po/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang sems hrīṃḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ skyil krung phyed pa tsog pu'i 'dug stangs can/ zhal ras zla ba nya gang ba lta bu/ ut+pal ltar bkra ba'i spyan zung g.yo bas mdzes pa/ phyag g.yon pas baiḍūr+ya'i rgyud mang 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas pa'i phyag sor gyi 'du byed kyis bskul bas sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho mngon par sgrub pa/

bung ba ltar gnag pa'i skra tshogs phyed stag par bcings shing*/ phyed gsil bur grol bas sku stod khyab pa/ pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba'i thod bcings dang*/ rin po che'i sna tshogs pas skra'i zar bu mdzes pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ nu 'bur mtho la rgyas pa/ sked skabs phra zhing sgeg la 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ lha rdzas kyi stod g.yogs dkar po dang*/ smad g.yogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i lhab lhub g.yo ba/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyan du mas rnam par brgyan pa ni/ gtsug gi nor bu/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sor gdub/ ska rags/ do shal/ se mo do/ g.yer kha'i phreng la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying chu shing gi me tog ltar kha thur du lta ba de nyid gyen du langs pas ut+pal dmar po kha 'bus pa'i rnam pa can du gyur pa'i nang du/ oṃ dkar po/ rlung cung zad phyir bsal/ oṃ gyi nā da las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ sna bug g.yas nas thon/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram rig 'dzin dga' ba'i tshal na lha mo dbyangs can ma bzhugs pa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ thugs ka nas ngo bo ye shes sems dpa'/ rnam pa dbyangs can gyi 'khor lo 'od zer 'bar ba spyan drangs te/ shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ skad cig gis byon te/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la glo bur du byung ba'i mchod pa nam mkha' gang bas mchod par gyur/ oṃ pri ti de wī dī bya puṣ+pe hūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ dhū pe/ gan+dhe/ nai we te/ ā lo ke oṃ pri ti de wī dī bya bi le pa ni hūṃ/ zhes pas mchod/ oṃ pri ti de wī me hrīṃḥṣ+ṭhi tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ zhes shub bur brjod nas/ dbugs nang du rngubs/ 'khor lo sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ 'od du zhu ste/ oṃ gyi nā da la thim/ oṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ dbyangs can gyi 'khor lo pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad shin tu rgyas pa/ lte ba ljang khu ze'u dmar ser/

de'i steng du zla ba rnyog bral gyi dbus su hrīṃḥdakar po nā da dang bcas pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis gnyis te g.yas bskor du 'khor ba/ mar me dkar po'i phreng ba lta bu'o/ /'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab/ mi shes pa'i mun pa dag/shes bya thams cad la chags thogs med pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsgom/ dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhabs kyi sgrub thabs na/ yan lag bzhi bskyed mdzad pa ltar spro na bya bar lta rung mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'di ni man ngag thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /bsdus pa la dga' na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig tsam gyis sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo zhes pa man chad kyis chog go /bzlas pa ni 'khor lo de nyid lte bar bkod kyang rung ste/ hrīṃḥ zhes bzlas pas/ 'khor lo'i dbus kyi hrīṃḥgi nā da las hrīṃḥchad/ zhal nas thon/ de'i 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs dang lhan cig lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas zhugs te 'khor lo'i dbus kyi hrīṃḥl thim/ 'khor lo ltar zlum po dang*/ mu tig do shal ltar 'chang ba gang bsgoms kyang rung ngo*/ /thun 'jog khar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma phul la/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i shes rab stsal du gsol/ zhes lan mang du gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams byas la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug dzam+bha la 'i chu sbyin yang ma chag par bya/ de dag ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor te/ de ltar thun bzhir brtson pa la gnas shing*/ mi tshig gis bar mchod par bzlas pa 'bum phrag gcig dang*/ nyi khri lnga stong bzla bar bshad pa da lta bzhi 'gyur du byed dgos pas/ 'bum phrag lnga bzla zhing*/

de nyid lan gsum du brtsams pa ni/ 'bum phrag bco lnga ste/ de tsam gyis grangs kyi bsnyen pa tshar gcig rdzogs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mchod pas cho ga ni sa stegs gru bzhi khru do pa shin tu mnyam pa'am/ dbus dang*/ lho dang*/ nub cung zad mtho zhing*/ shar dang byang cung zad dma' ba la/ ba byung lngas chag chag btab/ tshangs zur gyis thig gdab/ lte ba sor bzhir bskor ba dang*/ 'dab ma la khru phyed bskor ba/ de la rdul tshon nam chu tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ yang na dar ram ras gzhi la bris pa stegs bu'i steng du bkram yang rung ngo*/ /de'i dbus dang 'dab ma brgyad la mar gyi mar me re re bzhag pa'am/ ting lo chung ngu dgu dbus su bzhag kyang rung ngo*/ /yang na lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la bzhi mnyam gyis snying ga'i 'khor lo dang 'dra ba'i yi ge rnams bri'o/ /bzhi mnyam ni/ tsan dan/ gla rtsi/ gur gum/ gi haṃ ste bzhi po sbyar ba'i lde gu yin no/ /dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su sku gzugs lugs ma lta bu bzhugs su gsol/ de med na dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab tu bris sku bkrams pas kyang de'i dod du 'gyur/ ma 'byor na bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs med kyang rung*/ mdun du dkar gtor che chung gnyis dang*/ mchod pa gtsang zhing bzang ba 'byor tshad bsham/ chang bu'i gtor ma'ang bsham/ de nas a mṛ ta 'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa tshar gcig bsgoms te/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su oṃ yongs su gyur pa las dbyangs can gyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ lta bu'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i 'od zer ring du 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram rig 'dzin dga' ba'i zhes pa nas/ bi li pa ni hūṃ gi bar gong bzhin/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'khor lo dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/

oṃ pri ti de wī hrīṃḥ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ 'khor lo de nyid gzhal med khang dang bcas pa lha mo'i skur gyur/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya ba'i nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā nas/ shab+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes bde ba chen po'i dngos/ /mchod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /dpal gyi lha mo dbyangs can ma/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ swa ra swa sti de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du 'don pa spos te/ zhabs bsil bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di/ /pād+yaṃ/ lha'i me tog sna tshogs pa/ /yongs 'du man+da ra ba dang//'dab brgya ut+pal ku mud sogs/ /'bul gyi bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /puṣ+pe/ sna tshogs dri zhim spos kyi mchog/zhing kun khyab par byed pa 'di/ /ngag dbang lha mo la 'bul gyi/ / dngos grub stsol phyir bzhes su gsol/ /dhū pe/ sna tshogs nor bu'i snang gsal dang*/ /bgegs 'joms mar me'i phreng ba 'di/ /mchog tu dges pas bzhes su gsol/ /blo dang mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /ā lo ke¿/bzhi mnyam sbyar ba'i dri mchog 'di/ /lha'i dri bzang phye ma dang*/ /byugs pa yis kyang byug par bya/ /rdzu 'phrul dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /gan+dhe/ bza' ba bca' ba'i khyad par dang*/ /sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i zhal zas ni/ /btung ba'i bye brag 'bum dang sbyar/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab par mdzod/ /nai we te/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal tshim byed pa'i/

/sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig/shap+ta/ de nas spro na rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang mche ba'i rtse mo las ni mngon sprul zhing*/ /thogs med rnam 'phrul mtha' yas rol pas rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo khyod sku rab tu gsal ba'i rnam 'gyur can/ /biṣ+ṇu'i gzugs brnyan gtum po rab dga' bskyed pa'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /rjes su chags bcas rol pa'i lo ni brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams/ /chu gter 'gram ngogs sbu ba'i phreng bas rtse ba'i dga' ba can/ /dri za'i bu mos mngon bstod nyid kyi rnam thar phul byung rnams/ /gang gis yid la dran byed de la ngag gi dngos grub myur du stsol/ kho bos khyod dran ba spu shas cher g.yos pa'i lag pa yis/ /thal sbyar me tog gzhon nu kha 'bus lta bu spyi bo'i steng*/ /rab bzhag snying nas gus pa lhur byed khyod kyi yon tan che/ /mtha' dag rtogs min 'dir ni sdeb sbyor legs pa'i phreng bas mchod/ /de ltar khyod bstod lhur len gang yin de ni yon tan gyis/ /dbus 'gyur sna tshogs rig pa'i gzhung las rab skyes chos kyi don/ /myur rtogs sa gsum skye dgu'i gzhung sgron gti mug mun pa rnams/ / rab bsal skye bos rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med 'dra thob par shog/

ces pa dang gzhan yang tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i bstod pa ci shes kyis bstod do/ /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod rin po che las grub pa yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum dang khyon mnyam pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ nyer gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ zhes lan bdun gyis lha mo dbyangs can ma la phul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog la sogs pas mchod/ mkhyen bzang rab tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma dang*/ /thugs rjes dri med zla ba'i gdan la 'gying*/ /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho pi waṃ gsung snyan gyis/ khams gsum dbugs 'byin lha mo khyod la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/'phags ma dbyangs can ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ phun sum tshogs pa'i shes rab/ chags thogs med pa'i spobs pa/ gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i blo gros/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi ngag rnams stsal du gsol/ rig pa rang grol ba'i smra ba phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ sde snod ma lus pa'i don rtogs pa dang*/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag khong du chud cing*/ rig pa dri ma med pa'i rtog ge dang*/ tshig rgyan phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros bskyed du gsol/ gzhan yang phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub ma lus pa yid bzhin du stsal du gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa yang gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs te/ nor rgyun ma 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ bā su dha ra hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ pra : bha £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ ka £© ra dza me swāhā/ zhes lan bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'bul/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bar dpal lha mo dbyangs can ma sgrub pa la phrag dog dang bar chad ma mdzad par nor 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gtab/ chang bu'i gtor ma gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags lan bdun gyis 'byung po thams cad la bsngos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gzugs mdzes dam pa la= sku 'byams klas la= 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la= srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa ma mdzad cigadakar phyogs skyong ba mthu ldan rnams kyis bar chad bsrung zhing*/ dngos grub stsol ba'i mthun rkyen mdzod cig ces dang yi ge brgya pa lan mang du brjod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ brgya rtsa bzla'o/ / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod/ lha mo 'od du zhu/ 'khor lor gyur/ slar yang gong ltar/ oṃ pra ti sogs kyis mchod/ bris sku sogs la brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs bar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ /smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa bya'o/ /gsum pa man ngag ni/ slob ma rjes bzung dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ 'dod chags kyi gegs bsal ba/ nor gyi gegs bsal ba/ :zhes pa 'byung £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ shes pa 'gyur £© ba'i gegs bsal ba/ gsum la/ thun mong dang khyad par ba gnyis gnyis te drugadangos grub kyi gegs sel la/ dmigs pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ rlung gnad dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams ngag gnyis/ las sbyor kyi skabs rtsod pa las rgyal ba dang*/ dug zhi ba dang*/ dbang bsdud de gsum yod la/ de ltar kun dril bas/

slob dpon bram ze phur bu nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa bcu gsum mthong ngo*/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhabs kyi nye brgyud kyi man ngag tu grags pa gegs sel bogs 'don mang du yod pa ni/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ de'i lhan thabs rnams su gsal bar bzhugs pa'i phyir/ de dag tu blta bar bya'o/ /sngar bshad pa'i man ngag de dag las/ gzhan rnams ni yig rnying dang bla ma'i man ngag las rtogs par bya'o/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mtha' dag la nyer bar mkho zhing*/ sgrub pa po'i sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang*/ bar chad sel ba dang*/ tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ lha dge ba'i thabs bla na med pa yin zhing*/ khyad par sgrub thabs 'di la brten te shes rab bskyed pa la med thabs med pa yin pa'i phyir/ sbyin bsreg gi cho ga mdo tsam bshad na/ bskos thab bam/ brtsigs thab zhi ba'i thab khung spyi dang mthun pa'am/ yang na bris pa'i thab/ tshangs thig zur thig legs btab nas/ khru phyed bskor ba thab kyi nang*/ /de nas sor bzhi lan gsum bskor/ /phyi rol logs bzhir gru bzhi gdab/ /thab dang kha khyer mu ran dang*/ /stegs bu rnams kyi thig yin no/ /de rnams rdul tshon dkar pos bgang zhing*/ dmar po gcad gdab/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ sa bon dang dbyangs yig 'god tshul snying ga'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'bri/ thab kyi steng du shing bzang po'i shing leb bam/ ba dmar gsal gyi lci bas brtsigs/ kha khyer la pad 'dab mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rnams rdul tshon ser po la bzhi mnyam bsres pas bris/ yang na ri mo thams cad dkar pos 'bri zhing*/ bar rnams ser pos bkang yang rung*/ nang bud shing dri zhim pos shing ser por kha bsgyur nas/ gru bzhi bsnol mar 'god/ me tshang bya lugs spyi dang mthun/ mchod gtor gong mchod chog gi skabs ltar bsham/ ba byung gi maṇ+ḍal du bsreg rdzas tsan dan sogs spos sna tshogs

dang*/ me tog ser po dang*/ ting lo mang po dang*/ bzhi mnyam sogs lde gu dang phye ma dang*/ phye mar kyi zas mchog chung ngu mang po dang*/ ku sha'i myu gu mngar gsum dang bzhi mnyam gyis sbags pa dang*/ nas/ gro/ sran/ 'bras/ til dkar nag la sogs pa 'bru sna sna tshogs bsres pa dang*/ mar khu dang*/ me lha'i bsreg rdzas dang*/ dung chos su bsangs chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa bsham/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ bzlas pa ci 'grub byas te/ bsangs chu la dmigs nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams la bsangs chu gtor zhing*/ gong du bstan pa ltar mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i thab khung zlum po gser btso ma lta bur 'bar ba/ kha khyer mu ran stegs bu dang bcas pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang bar gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes dge 'dun gyi rung khang ngam/ rgyal po'i pho brang nas blangs pa'i me sbar/ raṃ las byung ba'i drang srong chen po me lha'i ngo bo me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ me lha 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbyug gu rtse gsum gyi phyag rgyas rna bar g.yob cing*/ oṃ ag+na ye mahā bhu ta de wa ri ṣi dwe dza satwa ma gṛ hi twa a hu ti/ mahā ra asmin sa ni hi twa bha ba/ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'bar ba'i rnam pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha ha bya ka bya ha na ya swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ lan bdun gyis dgang blugs phul/ swa ar+than+tsai wa pa ra ar+than+tsa sa dhi s+t+waṃ gats+tsha/ ha bya bhu ka a ga mi ṣ+ya/ si ya tha ka le/ sarba sid+dhi ku ru ṣā me/ zhes brjod pas me lha dges par bsam/ bsreg rdzas thams cad gcig tu bsres pa'i snod las blangs te/

oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pas lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam phul/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīṃḥyig las 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram rig 'dzin dga' ba'i tshal zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar mdun bskyed bzhin/ 'khor lo'i 'od las lha mo'i sku byung bar mos la/ oṃ pri ti de wī hrīṃḥ.a ā sogs lan bdun bzlas/ gong mchod chog gi skabs su bshad pa ltar mchod bstod bya/ oṃ pri ti de wī hriṃḥde bya dhu pe hūṃ/ me pradzñā war+dha ma na ya oṃ/ zhes pas bdug spos dang*/ oṃ pri ti de wī di bya puṣ+pe hūṃ/ me pradzñā war+dha ma na ya oṃ/ zhes pas me tog ser po dang*/ de bzhin du 'don pa spos te/ dī pe zhes pas ting lo dang*/ bi li pa ni zhes pas lde gu dang*/ nai we t+ya zas mchog dang*/ ag+na yes mar khu dang*/ a pra ti ha da zhes pas ku sha dang*/ bi dza ye zhes pas 'bru sna tshogs/ shrī pha la yis shing tog sna tshogs so/ /gzhan mang nyung gang 'os 'bul la/ zas mchog la grangs bzung zhing 'bul lo/ / thun rer brgya rtsa la sogs pa 'bul lo/ / slar gtor ma 'bul ba nas/ badz+ra muḥ zhes mgron rnams gshegs su gsol ba'i bar gong bzhin/ oṃ pri ti de wī me hrīṃḥṣ+tīḥtiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ zhes bzlas pas/ 'khor lo rang gi snying ga'i 'khor lo la thim/ slar yang me la mar khu dang bsreg rdzas gong bzhin 'bul lo/ / oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes pas sngar gyi phyag rgya phyir bstan la gshegs su gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci shes bya'o/ /rgyas pa'o/ /de las me lha mchod pa'i skor rnams bor ba 'bring po'o/ kha khyer mu ran stegs bu sogs mi 'bri ba dang*/ bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i tshe hrīṃḥme pradzñā war+dha ma na ya oṃ/ zhes pa kho nas 'bul ba ni bsdus pa yin cing*/ gzhan gong dang 'dra'o/ / hrīṃḥ zhes pa gcig pus bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni shin tu bsdus pa'o/ /'di'i bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la gnas pa'i tshe/

dam tshig ni spyir rang gis blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas shing*/ khyad par sdig pa spangs/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas/ rdzun mi smra ba sha chang sgog tsong la phug la sogs pa'i kha zas spangs/ gos gtsang ma gyon/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la 'bad/ gdan dang sga rngas su mi 'jugalham dang gos rnying skrar rnying sogs kyi 'og tu mi nyal ba rnams la 'bad par bya'o/ /ma lus rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dges mdzad rdo rje lha mo che/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di/ /'gro la phan pa'i nyer 'tsho dang*/ /de las dpag yas sems can rnams/ /bla med dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /mkhyen pa'i gsang mdzod 'dzin par shog/dpal ldan de bzhin gshegs kuna~X gyi/ /lhan skyes dga~X' ba'i rten gyur pa/ /mtsho byung lha mo sgrub pa'i thabs/ /kun gyi snyinga~X po~X ngo mtshar rmad// //ces 'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ye shes 'char ba zhes bya ba/ don gnyer du mas snga phyir yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas yar 'bros sna dkar rtser sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ ma rig mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo'i tshul ston pa/ /de la btud nas rjes gnang gi /cho ga mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /'dir sgrub thabs ni ye shes 'char bar bshad zin to/ /slob ma rjes bzung gi bya ba la/ yig rnying na mdor bsdus tsam zhig las med na'ang*/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dbyangs can dga' ba'i rjes gnang gi tho yig ltar phyag len mdzad pas dus tshes bzang po la/ sa stegs gru bzhi khru do ba shin tu mnyam pa la thig chen brgyad btab/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la ting lo re re 'jog pa'am/ dbus su ting lo gcig la slob ma'i grangs tshad dang mnyam pa'i ting los bskor ba byas kyang rung*/ de'i steng du mañdzi la maṇ+ḍal me long la/ ba dkar dmar gang rung las byung ba'i dkar gsum dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba la dri bzang bzhi mnyam btab ste/

des pad+ma 'dab brgyad yi ge dang bcas pa snying ga'i 'khor lo lta bu 'bri/ de la 'bru dkar po sbyar te 'khor lo'i rnam pa gsal por byas pa bzhagaslob ma la sbyin rgyu'i ting lo yang dkar gsum mngar gsum bzhi mnyam sbyar ba'i rgyu las bya/ 'og gzhi'i dkyil 'khor ma 'grub na tshom bu tsam gyis kyang rung ngo*/ /sgrub thabs kyi mchod chog tu bshad pa ltar mchod gtor gtsang mas mtha' bskor/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad pa nas/ dngos grub stsol ba'i mthun rkyen mdzod cig /ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i mdud bskyed mchod chog ji lta ba bzhin du bya/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i don du bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ bum pa gtsang ma bum rdzas dang bcas pa'i chus bkang ba la/ ba dmar ser gyi dkar gsum dang*/ mngar gsum cung zad blug/me tog gi phreng ba gzungs thag la btags te sne mo nas bzung la/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au.aṃ aḥswāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams kyi/ /rjes su gnang ba bdag la stsol/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yi/ / sogs lan gsum gyis thun mong gi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyangs can ma'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gang bas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag ste/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang du thim par mos su bcug la/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ oṃ dkar po 'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/

sna bug g.yas nas thon/ lho phyogs/ zhes pa nas/ bi le pa ni/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ yang na sku bskyed bstim spyi dang mthun par byas kyang rung ngo*/ / oṃ pri ti de wī me hrīṃḥṣ+tīḥtiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ zhes drag tu bzlas shing rol mo bya/ 'khor lo slob ma'i snying ga'i oṃ la bstim/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /mgrin par 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu drug pa'i lte bar hrīṃḥdakar po rtsibs rnams la ā li bcu drugade las de 'dra ba rang sgra sgrog pa zhig chad/ 'od zer gyis slob ma'i lus thams cad gang*/ 'khor lo mgrin par thim/ hrīṃḥ nyer gcig dang dbyangs yig gi sngags lan gsum rjes bzlos byed du bcug ste/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /bla ma'i snying ga'i hrīṃḥlas 'od 'phros/ slob ma'i snying ga'i sa bon la thim par mos te/ ting lo sbar te ming du gzhug thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal blangs la/ dbyangs yig bzla bzhin du/ bum pa'i chus bkrus pa'i khu ba slob ma 'thung du bcug la/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dgashes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par mos su bcug

yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /gtso bos ji ltar sogs maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs bya/ mdun bskyed mchod pa kha gso/ yig brgya lan mang du brjod pa nas/ bkra shis kyi bar yang sgrub thabs kyi mchod chog gi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya ste/ rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /kuna~X tu zab cing dga~X' bar bsngags/ /snyinga~X nas blo gros mchog 'dod na/ /lhag pa'i lha 'di te po~Xr sgrubs/ /myur du mkhas pa'i gnas thob 'gyur/ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs sngar gzhan du rgyas par bshad zin pas/ rjes gnang bya ba'i le tshan no/ /maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ yum gyur 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ / btud nas sgrub thabs klu sgrub lugs/ /gnyan lo'i man ngag ches zab pa/ /rje btsun chen po'i gsung bzhin bsdu/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro ci nus byas pa'i mthar/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sgom bzlas la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge tāṃḥljang khu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de nas oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ thal mo sbyar te dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid tāṃḥlas ut+pal ljang khu tāṃḥgis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/
