'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus tāṃḥyig ut+pal dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pal sngon po'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung ste/ me tog snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ dbu skra li ba g.yon phyogs su bcings nas g.yas ngos su 'khyil zhing 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i cha lugs can/ zla ba la sku rgyab brten pa/ dar srab mo'i stod g.yogs kyis nu ma bkab cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃḥyig ljang khu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas po tā la nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag/chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha de rnams rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur te rang la thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ thal mo sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar/ srin mdzub gnyis bkug ste/ mdzum mo mnan pa ut+pa la'i phyag rgya dpral mgrin snying ga dpung pa rnams su reg cing yi ge bcu pa tshar re brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du gtad/

:skyo na [ spro na ] thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tāṃḥyig gi mthar yi ge bcu pa kha dog dkar po mgo bo gyen du blta bas bskor bar bsams la/ de la klog pa'i tshul du/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa'i yi ge bcu pa gtso bor bzla/ spro na/ na mo rat+na trā yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a wa lo ki ti shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tat+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma kri te sarba duṣ+tāṃ/ pra duṣ+tāṃ/ dzaṃ bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo hā ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+tāṃ staṃ bha ni tā re swāhā/ zhes gzungs ring yang ci nus bzla/ mthar 'dod don zhus la/ bsngo ba dang smon lam bya zhing*/ spro na thun mtshams su mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ gzungs ring ci nus kyi mthar phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis bstod la/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor mchod pa spyi mthun dang bcas pa bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyang spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ po ṭa la yi gnas mchog na/ / zhes sogs brjod/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ na maḥs man+ta/ bud+dha bo dhi satwā naṃ/ a pra ti ha ta sha sa nāṃ he he bha ga wa ti mahā satwa sarba bud+dha a ba lo ki te/ mā bi lam+ba mā bi lam+ba/ i maṃ ba ling gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ grih+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ dza dza sarba bi sañtsa re swāhā/ lan lngas phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs dang*/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa gnod byed thams cad las skyob tu gsol/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral du gsol/ sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ ces 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams dang*/ smon lam gdab/ bkra shis brjod/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ gtor chog skabs/ spyan 'dren dang gdan 'bul sgos su byed mi 'tshal/ de lta bu'i sgo nas yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum mam/ 'bum phrag brgyad cu'i grangs kyis bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yin no/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ thun mong ba spyi dang*/ khyad par ba lung 'bogs tshul/ slob ma mchog la ste/ de yang maṇ+ḍal dang mchod gtor bshams la/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du rje btsun ma sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la phul/ bstod pa bya/ gtor ma gong ltar phul la/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnams khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa byas pas de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs brgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer ljang khu dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de'i skad cig la paṃ las pad ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ tāṃḥlas ut+pal tāṃḥgis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ slob ma rnams sgrub thabs ltar rje btsun mar bskyed/

slar slob dpon la mos gus byas pas/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ slob ma la thim par bsams la/ sngags bzlas shing dril sil bya ba ni gzhi 'god pa'o/ /dngos la gsum las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon gyis bdag la/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung dang gsang sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las de 'dra ba du ma byung nas zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba la tāṃḥyig gi mthar 'khod par mos pa byas la/ snying po dang gzungs kyi rjes bzlos lan gsum bya/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i mgo bo'i dpal ldan yid 'ong zhes pa nas/ gyur la bstod ces pa'i bar slob dpon gyis tshar gcig klog oṃ dge ba can ni nas/ swāhā 'i bar gyi rje zlos lan gsum byed du gzhug oṃ gyi rnam par 'dod gzugs ma/ / zhes pa nas/ dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug skyes/ / kyi bar lan gcig rjes zlos byed/ de man chad kyi phan yon rnams slob dpon gyis lan gcig klog go /de nas slob mas bcom ldan bdag gis sogs brjod cing me tog gtor/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod cing me tog mgo bor bzhag go /gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun ma yi dam du bzung snyam pa'i bsam pas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun ma sgrol ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o/ / zhes lan gsum/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig

ces brjod cing me tog dor/gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma la gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma mthe bong tsam cig byon te slob ma'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i tāṃḥyig dang dbyer med du 'dres pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ slob dpon gyis me tog gtor te/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams gnas skabs su 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyabs te 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral du gsol/ mthar thug mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun no/ /rjes gnang thun mong ba ni/ skye bo mang po la byed na gzhan rnams 'dra ba las/ gzungs ring dang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung dor bas rung ngo*/ /spyir 'di la/ bsnyen pa dang*/ dbang bsdud kyi sgrub pa dang*/ gtor chog dang*/ bris pa'i bsrung 'khor/ chom rkun 'ching ba/ rjes gnang byed thabs/ mtshan brgya 'don thabs te bdun las/ rtsa ba ni bsnyen pa yin la/ yan lag ni lhag ma drug po yin pas/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug par grags so/ /las tshogs bzhi po de rje btsun grags pa'i yig char gsal lo/ /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs che mang ba/ /kuna~X gyi tog ltar dga~X' ba'i chos/ /gong ma'i yi ge rgyas pa las/ /nyer 'kho snyinga~X po~Xr dril ba yin/ /gnyan sgrol sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /rig byed ma'i mngon rtogs nyams su len tshul thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ 'phags ma 'khor ba kun sgrol ma/ /de la btud nas rig byed ma'i/ /sgrub thabs dges rdor las byung ba/ /lhan skyes rol ba'i lugs bshad bya/ /dmar po skor gsum du grags pa'i nang gi ku ru kul+le sgom par 'dod na/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hrīṃḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥku ru kul+le bh+yaḥ oṃ ku ru kul+le badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shūn+ya ta 'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīṃḥyig dmar po ring mo tsheg dreg dang bcas pa de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems cad thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīṃḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis ut+pal dmar po'i mde'u can gyi mda' dang me tog gi gzhu snyan gyi bar du 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas 'gugs byed lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon 'og mas rtsa ba zhags par byas pa'i ut+pal 'dzin pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing*/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nu 'bur rgyas pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan zhing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis 'od zer dmar po dang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su ut+pal dmar po'i lte bar nyi ma la hrīṃḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rig byed kyi phug nas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ brtse bas rjes chags sogs kyis bstod/ bdud rtsi kyai rdor ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ 'bru gsum brjod cing myangs te bde bas mnyes par bsams la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīṃḥswāhā/ zhes ma yengs par tsan dan dmar po'i phreng ba ming med kyi steng nas drangs shing bgrang bar bya'o/ /thun 'jog pa na/

bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros te/ snang ba thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ gtor ma 'bul na/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags la phul/ brtse bas rjes chags pad ma rā ga'i mdog/zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu ut+pal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes sogs ci shes pas bstod/ 'dod don zhu/ lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzod par gsol/ bris sku sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs su gsol la bsngo ba smon lam ci shes bya/'di'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ thun mong ba spyi dang 'dra ba las gtor dbang tsam byed pa yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ gzhi dmar po'i steng du tsan dan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la/ me tog dmar pos tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la rten gyi gtor ma brag skyibs kyi dbyibs can dmar po rgyan dang ldan pa bkod/ bris sku yod na dgram/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang*/ smug rtsis byugs pa'i 'bul gtor gcigaslob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyai rdo rje bzhin nam spyi dang mthun pa dang bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun bskyed stong par sbyang ba nas bzung*/ mngon rtogs 'don pa spo ba tsam ma gtogs 'dra/ mchod bstod gtor ma phul la/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bzlas pa bya/ slob ma khrus byas/ phyag dang yon phul nas/ gral la 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ 'dir dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams nas bshad pa'i rje btsun ma'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/

slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub/ slob ma'i bya ba la rjes gnang gi sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu byas la/ slob mas kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ gsol ba btab pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs nas gnang bar mdzod/ ces gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams steng gi cha la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'i bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ phyag dang mchod pa phul bar mos pa byas te/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ku ru kul+le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag byas nas tshogs zhing skabs ltar mchod la/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog /ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ tshogs zhing rnams mdun bskyed kyi lha mo la thim par mos pa mdzod/ de rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang gi lus la zhugs pa'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang kun rdzob rnam shes kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs nas bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pas bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de nas slob dpon dang khyed rang gi thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer 'phros pa/

lho phyogs rig byed kyi phug na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phog pas de'i thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po'i phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dmar khrig khrig byon te khyed rang gi lus la thim pas lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad rje btsun ma'i skur gyur te slar tshur 'dus nas khyed rang la thim/ yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang rig byed ma dpag tu med pa byung khyed rang la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rig byed kyi phug na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i sku la phog pas/ de las de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang la thim pas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ sngags kyi mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod de/ dril bu sil zhing gu gul gyis bdug des rje btsun ma'i sku'i rjes gnang thob/ rje btsun ma'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du/ khyed rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar ut+pal dang nyi ma'i steng du hrīṃḥyig gcig bsams te slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma la gus 'dud drag po dungs pa byas pas/ de gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīṃḥyig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos pa byas/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ nas swāhā lan gsum/ zhes bzlas pa'i dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bcos ldan bdag gis sogs lan gsum brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor btag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs gsum gyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di'i rgyud la rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cigades rje btsun ma'i gsung gi rjes gnang thogarje btsun ma'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos par mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sem dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang ma 'dres pa'i chos la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gi thugs kar thim pas/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad rgyud la zhugs par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang hrīṃḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad sogs 'gre/ slar yang de las 'od zer 'phros pas tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad gong ltar spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad rgyas par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad kyang gong ltar spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byas pa yin snyam du mos par mdzod/

oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ a be sha ya hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ zhes yang yang brjod cing*/ gu gul gyis bdugadril bu'i sgra res 'jog tu bya/ des rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ rje btsun ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos par mdzod/ de nas gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bya ba'am/ gtor dbang ma byas kyang rung la/ de lta na rten gtor yang mi dgos so/ / rjes gtso bo= maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas sogs 'dra/ tshom bu la mchod bstod/ dngos grub blangs la gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdus te gnas gsum bsrung dge ba bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas pa yi sngags rgyud la/ /dbang bsdud kuna~X gyi rtsa bar grags/ /dga~X' chen lha mo rig byed ma'i/ /lag len snyinga~X po~X ngo mtshar rmad/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams ngag dang 'brel ba'i zab chos dmar po skor gsum du grags pa las/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //zhus dag/ ༄༅/ /dpal 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ 'dod chags rdo rje la btud nas/ /dbang sdudarno la stobs che ba/ /'gran zla med pa'i rig sngags rgyal/ /'dod rgyal sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis 'dod pa'i rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis gnas nas bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa'i 'dod pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥṭak+ki rā dza bh+yaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+ruṃ dmar po las byung ba'i rin po che pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zla gam sgo gcig pa/

dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang sems hūṃ yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus nas/ 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par tshur 'dus te hūṃ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'phyar stabs su 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor gtsugs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dar dmar po stod g.yogs dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ de'i bar du yum bde ba rgyas byed ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar stabs su 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab kyi thugs kar hūṃ yig dmar po'i mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kha dog dmar pos g.yas bskor du bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas 'dod pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ de'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dmar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma āḥyis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thugs kar hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa dmar po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de gsum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rigs gsum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lha gsum la so sor thim zhing*/ de gsum 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med du gyur/ pad+ma'i phreng ba srin lag gi steng nas drangs te/ oṃ wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ oṃ ku su ma/ mā li bhi hūṃ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ku sa dzi kaṃ bheḥ ṭha ṭha ṭha/ oṃ gro ge ma kri te/ 'gro ba mang po wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ ka ka dha ya ka dha ya/ kha khā hi khā hi/ ga gardza ya gardza ya/ gha gha ta ya gha ta ya/ tsa tsa la ya tsa la ya/ tsha tsha ta ya tsha ta ya/ dza dzaṃ bha ya dzaṃ bha ya/ dzha dzha ta ya dzha ta ya/ ṭa ṭa la ya ṭa la ya/ ṭha ṭha ka ya ṭha ka ya/ ḍa ḍa bha ya ḍa bha ya/ ḍha ḍha ka ya ḍha ka ya/ ṇa ṇa sha ya ṇa sha ya/ ta taṃ bha ya taṃ bha ya/ tha tho bha ya tho bha ya/ da da ra ya da ra ya/ dha dha ra ya dha ra ya/ na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ pa pa ta ya pa ta ya/ pha pha ta ya pha ta ya/ ba ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ bha bhe ta ya bhe ta ya/ ma mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ya yo ha ya yo ha ya/ ra ro ha ya ro ha ya/ la lo ba ya lo ba ya/ wa wa ha ya wa ha ya/ sha sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ṣa ṣuṣ+ti ya ṣuṣ+ti ya/ sa sa dha ya sa dha ya/ ha ha na ya ha na ya/ k+ṣa k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ 'gro ba mang po wa shaṃ kri ti/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ shan+tiṃ ku ru/ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru/

k+ṣa yaṃ ku ru/ k+ṣo bhaṃ ku ru/ ma raṃ ku ru swāhā/ oṃ sid+dhi sarba sid+dhi mahā sid+dhi/ pū dza ag+ṇi taṃ/ bha na te mā ra ṇaṃ/ 'gro ba mang po wā shaṃ ru hoḥ zhes thun re la nyer lnga re bzla/ thun 'jog pa na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ gzhal yang khang gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ gtor ma 'bul na rin po che'i snod du zan leb zlum po gru bzhi gru gsum zla gam rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du gtor ma'i snying po bzhag la smug rtsis bsgyur/ mtha' mamatheb kyu dang kha zas sna tshogs kyis bskor ba zhig gam/ ma grub na gzhan gang rigs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma bsham/ yi dam gang byed kyi nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas nub phyogs bde ba can nas/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bris sku sogs yod na bstim/ slar yang snying ga nas 'phros pas 'od zer gyis gtor ma bteg ste/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag tu phul ba gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu hūṃ/

zhes pa lan gsum maṃ lngas phul/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /dbang bskur pho nya'i las mdzad pa/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni/ khams gsum 'gugs pa khyod la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las gzhol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas gnas kyi mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gtso mo rnams sku mdog dmar mo ḍa ma ru dang thod pa rus pa'i rgyan dang*/ dar dmar po'i na bza' can/ nyi ma'i gdan la gar stabs kyis bzhugs shing 'khor rnams sku mdog sna tshogs pa phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin par bsam/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa mang pos bdud rtsi bcus te/ de rnams kyi phyag gi thod par blug pa gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum la sogs pas phul/ zhing skyes yul gyi dur khrod nas/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo rnams bzhugs pa/ /sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyug/gsung gi gsang sngags phyogs bcur sgrog/thugs ni thugs rje'i ngang la bzhugs/ /sgrub po'i 'phrin las ci yang mdzad/ /mthu dang nus pa bsam mi khyab/ /stobs chen khyed la gus pas bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs gong ltar brjod pas/ de ltar bgyi'o/ /zhes khas blangs par bsam/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzod par gsol la/ bris sku yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs su gsol/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la bsngo ba dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'dod rgyal 'di la rjes gnang ni/ mi zab pa'i lugs dang*/ zab mo'i lugs dang*/ skag chol gyi rjes gnang gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings bzhin yin pa las/ gtor dbang tsam bya ba yin la/ gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo'i las tshogs la nye bar mkho ba'i byin rlabs tsam yin zhing*/

shin tu bka' dog par mdzad pas 'dir mi 'bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal zla gam dmar po'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu can zhig bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la/ gong du bshad pa'i dbyibs khyad par can gyi gtor ma de rten gtor du bkod/ mdun du 'bul gtor dang mchod pa rgya cher bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang bgegs gtor btang zhing bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ bdag bskyed 'dod rgyal nyid dam yi dam gang yang rung ba zhig bsgom pa las/ dang po ltar na/ gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /mdun bskyed sangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ nas/ dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ zhes pa tsam brjod/ bzlas pa ci 'grub byas/ gong bzhin gtor ma phul/ slar yang mchod bstod byas la/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /slob ma rnams kyis khrus byas/ yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso/ /gsang ba'i cho ga bla na med/ /dbang du byed pa'i rigs sngags mchog/bdag la nges par stsal du gsol/ / zhes pas gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs rgyun bshags bya/ oṃ shū n+ya ta nas/ gsum dang dbyer med du gyur gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin dmigs pa phogaye shes spyan 'dren gyi skabs rol chen bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ / slob ma'i snying gar pad nyi la hūṃ dang*/ sngar slob dpon nyid kyis bdag bskyed 'dod rgyal la byas na/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka dang*/ yi dam gzhan la byas na/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar pad nyi la/ sa bon sngags 'phreng ā li kā lis bskor ba bkod/ slob ma'ang de bzhin gsal 'debs su bcug maṇ+ḍal tsan+dan dmar pos byugs pa la/ me tog dmar pos tshom bu bkod pa/ skabs 'di slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul te/ sa gzhi spos kyis zhes sogs brjod/ 'di phyis kyi phyag len la mi byed par snang na'ang*/

sgos chos yin pas 'grub na legs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / dmigs med thugs rje las 'khrungs pa'i/ /'phrin las dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir/ /'di ni rjes su gnang bar mdzod/ / ces lan gsum rjes zlos kyis gsol ba btab/ tshig dang po gnyis 'dra ba las/ thabs kyi 'phrin las zab mo'i don/ /gsang ba che 'dir khyed dad dam/ zhes slob dpon gyis 'dri/ tshig de nyid la gsang ba che 'di bdag dad do/ /zhes bsgyur la rjes zlos byed du gzhugade nas bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par 'bog bcom ldan bdag gi bzung lags kyi/ / sogs kyang spyi dang mthun/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ gtor ma mgo bor bzhag pas/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo re re la 'khor 'bum 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba/ sngags dang rol mo'i sgra chen po dang bcas 'ur 'ur byon te/ 'dod rgyal khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhugs/ 'khor rnams steng 'og phyogs 'tshams nam mkha' thams cad khyab par bzhugs par mos/ de rnams la bla mas bka' bsgos pas 'phrin las rnam bzhi sogs rang gi 'dod don thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub par mos pa mdzod/ de nas rol chen gyi sgra dang sbyar te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /zhi bas 'phrin las chen po yis/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyis/ /gdul bya dbang du 'gyur bar gyis/ /bstan la gnod pa bsad par gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i khro bo ni/ /dbang bskur pho nya'i las mdzad pa/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis/ /'di yi bsgrub bya 'grub par gyis/ /mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /'di yis bsgrub bya 'grub par mdzod/ / ces pa'i mthar rtsa sngags drag tu bzla'o/ /de nas gong gi dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs la/

gsang ba che 'di sgrub par gyis/ / zhes 'don pa spos la gnang ba byin/ 'di'i sgrub pa la brtson pa dang*/ snodamin la gsang zhing*/ skal ldan re re tsam la spel bar bya'o/ / zhes gdams so/ /rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs bya/ tshogs mchod bya/ slar yang las dang mthun pa'i yon 'bul/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ mchod bstod bya/ gsol ba drag tu gdab/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang ba man chad/ gong bzhin bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro kuna~X gyi bka' bgros pa/ /dbang sdud rab dga~X' rgyud chung dang*/ /man ngag rgya mtsho'i snyinga~X po~X las/ /lag len nyer mkho cung zad sdebs/ /dmar po skor gsum las/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// // ༄༅/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ gsang ba'i bdag po he ru ka /'byung po 'dul dang tshogs bdag gi /sgrub thabs rmad byung ngo mtshar can/ /kun gyi mchog gyur bshad par bya/ /tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs thams cad kyi rgyal po tshogs bdag dmar chen 'di yin no/ /dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal la pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po bris/ de'i dbus su zla gam dmar po la tshom bu dmar po dgod/ de'i steng du rten gtor nor bu'i dbyibs can bris sku tsaka li btsugs pa gcigade'i g.yas ngos su 'das gtor/ mdun du rgyun gtor/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ la du/ la phugaspos sna tshogs btab pa'i ril bu mar du btsos pa/ mchod mgo g.yas nas brtsams pa'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod tshar gnyis dang*/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu rnams bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs bde mchog ltar ram/ bla med gang 'os dang mthun par byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang 'byung po byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ bhu ta ḍā ma ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing nag las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas dang pos ba dan rtse gsum dang bcas pa'i rdo rje/ g.yon dang pos bhan : dza £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ dha £© khrag gang thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu rgyab nas 'gengs pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing*/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs kyis sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa'ang 'jig par mdzad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzais pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med pa thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ 'bar ba'i sku can nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /dpa' bo'i stang stabs zhabs kyis sa 'og g.yo/ /rab tu khros pa'i khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug/dpal chen 'byung po'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhad pa'i nga ros sum cu rtsa gsum 'jig/kun tu thogs med gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams/ /snying rje'i dbang gis zhi zhing 'gro la brtse/ /dngos grub stsol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ nang mchod bde mchog ltar ram/ spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis phul/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra （《dzaṃ》+ rā dza ） hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ snod bcud thams cad rang la thim par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar khro bo chen po skad cig gis grub pa ni/ 'byung po 'dul byed nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / de nas mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ 'das gtor nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bhu ta ḍā ma ra 'i mthar/ ā ka ro btags pas phul/ rten gtor nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas zad mi shes pas longs spyod chen por byin gyis brlabs/ bris sku bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid khro bo chen por gsal ba'i mdun du baiḍūr+ya'i brag ri'i khrod du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nor bdag byi ba sngon po rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i steng du gaḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dmar po glang po che'i gdong pa can rno zhing dkar ba'i mche ba rab tu gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/

dbu skra nag po spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mtshan zhing dar dmar po'i con pan can/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na/ dgra sta/ mda' chen/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'phang mdung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na gtun shing*/ gzhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gakhrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ thod pa sha chen gyis gang ba/ phub dang lhan cig mdung la ba dan btags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ rdo rje dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ lhag ma rnams 'phyar ba/ dar sna tshogs gyi sham thabs gsol zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su gaḥyig dmar po/ de nas rang nyid khro bo chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas rdo chen a mo lir gnas dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te mdun gyi tshogs kyis bdag po la thim par mos shing*/ dril bu bsil zhing*/ oṃ gaḥgaḥsid+dhi sid+dhi sarba ār+tha me pra sā ngha ya hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa mang du brjod pas bkug la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur bar bsam ste/ de la oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul nas/ sa ma ya ho zhes pas dam la bzhag slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs ba sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par mos la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ oṃ ga na pa ti ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā zhes sogs kyis dbul/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ /tshogs rje tshogs dbang tshogs kyi bdag/bgegs kyi gtso la mchod cing bstod/

/ rgyun gtor bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs oṃ ga na pa ti zhes pa la a kā ro 'am/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod 'dod don zhus la/ sum+bha ni brgya phrag la sogs pas mgo drangs pa'i oṃ āḥgaḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa 'bum phrag gcig gam/ 'bru 'bum bzla/ oṃ wā ra kā tā ya swāhā/ oṃ wa ka te ka daṃṣ+ta bin+dha hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bh+rūṃ ga na pa ta ye swāhā/ zhes tshogs bdag dkar po'i sngags rnams kyang bzla'o/ /maṇ+ḍal dang mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs la/ me tog phreng ba la sogs rin chen dbyig/la du la phug 'bras bu yid 'ong zas/ /phyogs bcu'i chu skyes thang skyes longs spyod rkyen/ /ris ma bcad pa'i mchod sprin rgyas par 'bul/ /maṇ+ḍal dam pa rab tu mdzes pa dang*/ /bshos btsang mar me yon chab sna tshogs dang*/ /'brang chang rgun chang la sogs btung ba'i mchog/sbrang rtsi bu ram la sogs mngar ba'i ro/ /lhan cig skyes dang rab tu sbyar ba yi/ /sna tshogs mchod pa dam pa 'di dag bzhes/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas rnam 'phrul las/ /byung ba'i bla med mchod pa 'di dag 'bul/ / gzugs sgra dri ro reg sogs kun ldan pa'i/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /bdag nyid dang bas bshams shing sprul ba yi/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis lha chen mnyes gyur cig

/mchod bstod 'dod don zhus te/ khro bo chen po mi dmigs par sbyangs/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs byas la/ rten gtor dang bcas pa gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i sar bzhugs su gsol/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis dang dga' ston rgyas par bya'o/ /rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ rgyal phur 'joms pa'i tshe dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal dang*/ bris sku dang*/ mchod gtor la sogs pa gong ltar dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gcig la khro bo chen po'i tshom bu'ang bshams/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed 'byung 'dul gyi sgom bzlas/ mdun bskyed 'byung 'dul bskyed de/ mchod gtor 'bul ba/ bris sku tshogs bdag tu bskyed pa la mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba/ bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ phyag dang yon phul te 'khod pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gong 'phang thob par bya ba dang*/ gnas skabs su chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i ched du/ khro bo 'byung po 'dul byed dang dpal tshogs kyi bdag po bsngags te sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub/ slob mas bya ba la rjes gnang gi sngon du 'gro ba/ slob dpon la khro bo 'byung po 'dul byed dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul zhes brjod/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs nas/ gnang bar mdzod ces gsol ba btab nas/ de nas rgyun bshags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas/ 'grub par shogade rnams kyis rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/

dngos gzhi la sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi khro bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs te/ lus dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan zhes pa'i bar / de ltar khyed rang khro bo chen por gsal ba'i mdun du baiḍūr+ya'i brag ri'i khrod du nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ tshogs bdag spyan 'dren skabs rol chen bya'o/ / de sku'i rjes gnang yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod par mos pa byas nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ sum+bha sogs nas/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i thugs ka'i gaḥyig las sngags phreng byung ba khyed rang khro bo chen por gsal ba'i lte ba'i gnas su thim par mos nas/ sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gsum mdzod/ oṃ āḥgāḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs sngags tshan bzhi po lan gsum bzlos pas/ dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjais zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs nas/ mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas nas/ khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ brtul bzhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod pas lha gnyis kyi gsung gi rjes gnang thob pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pa mdun gyi tshogs gyi bdag po'i thugs ka'i gaḥyig la phog pas srog rgyud bskul te/ gaḥlas 'od zer dmar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas tshogs bdag dang*/ gter bdag dang nor bdag dang*/ gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams gyi dregs pa can thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas/ de rnams kyis skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dang tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa dang*/ nor dang 'bru dang g.yang dang mdangs dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas/ khyed rang la byin pas/ rang gi gnas khang dang*/ bang mdzod dang*/ yul phyogs thams cad khengs/ longs spyod 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs pa la dbang bar byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ khyad par du tshogs kyi bdag po'i zhabs g.yon pa'i rting pas zhabs 'og gi byi ba la brdabs pas des ma bzod de/ 'jig rten khams kyi zas nor thams cad bsdus nas khyed la phul zhing*/ byi ba'i kha nas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pas khyed rang gi gnas khang dang bang mdzod ces sogs gong bzhin brjod pa'i mthar dril bu sil zhing*/ oṃ gaḥgaḥsid+dhi sid+dhi sogs nas swāhā/ zhes mang du brjod/ thugs rgyud bskul nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ rol chen dang bcas rten gtor slob ma'i lag tu gtad de/ sngags rnams kyi mthar dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas/ dus da nas gzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/

bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cigamathun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor dang dbang phyug thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cigalha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba mang po dbang du bsdus nas/ zas gos longs spyod thams cad kyis 'phongs pa med par yid bzhin du 'byor ba dang*/ de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan pa dang bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cigaces bka' bsgos pas tshogs kyi bdag pos de ltar zhal gyis bzhes te khyed rang gi phyi bzhin du 'brangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i khro bo chen po'i thugs ka nas khro bo chen pa'i sku de 'dra ba zhig byon pa khyed rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs te/ snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyis khro bo chen po dang dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes su gnang ba grub pa yin/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyis/ gtso bos= maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas= sogs spyi dang 'dra/ lha gnyis la mchod de tshom bu'i lha gshegs su gsol/ bris sku brtan bzhugs bya/ lhag ma gong dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X las khungs che rgyud las gsal/ /las tshogs shin tu mang la dga~X'/ /man ngag shes nas snyinga~X thag par/ /sgrubs na myur po~Xr mngon rtogs 'byung*/ / dmar po skor gsum las tshogs bdag dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ mchog gyur dpal ldan bla ma dang*/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la gus btud nas/ /rdor sems sgrub thabs ngo mtshar ba/ /jo bo'i man ngag bzhin du bris/ /skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ shū n+ya ta

sa stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūṃ ser po/ de las 'od 'phros/ las dang nyon mongs pa dang sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ser po 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad zla la gnas shing zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ ser po/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa ci 'grub bya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya ma yengs par 'don/ bdag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad 'dag par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di ni bzlas lung kho nas 'grub pa yin te/ slob mas dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ slob dpon la maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis 'di'i sgom tshul bshad/ slob dpon gyi 'phreng ba la 'jus te/ yig brgya'i rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ mthar slob dpon gyi 'phreng ba slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes brjod do/ /de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dam tshig nyams chags bcas kuna~X la/ /sgrub thabs zab kyang phan mi thogs/ /dngos grub sgrub par dga~X' ba rnams/ /snyinga~X po~X yig brgyar nan tan mdzod/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ /sgrub pa'i thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las thog mar dge ba'i don du nyer mkho sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig bshad pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //zhus dag/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ rgyal ba ston pa shākya'i tog/de la dad pas rab btud nas/

/sgrub thabs chu gter yon tan gyi/ /rin chen 'byung gnas 'dir 'jug bya/ /de la thog ma sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings shes pa'i don du/ de'i thog ma thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi mngon rtogs dang*/ rjes gnang gi cho ga bshad par bya zhing*/ brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gzhan dang sbrel tshul yang brjod na/ dus bzang po la slob dpon bzang pos slob ma bzang po la byin te/ de yang stegs bu gru bzhi pa ras bzang pos g.yogs pa'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal gur gum gyis byugs par rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum gyi tshom bu dbus ma che ba/ g.yas g.yon du chung ba re re lho byang du mtshar du bsgrigs/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog /shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me togalho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ byang nub tu dri chab/ byang du lha bshos/ dri chab dang lha bshos kyi bar du gtor ma bshams/ rjes gnang du ma zhig rjes la sbrel nas byed na ji tsam byed pa'i lha bshos kyi grangs dang*/ gtor gsos kyi mtheb kyu/ me tog gso chas/ spos 'bul rgyu/ mchod yon zhabs bsil/ dri chab gso ba dang*/ gtor ma sbyangs chas kyi chu rnams sta gon bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun du lcog rtse'i steng du ting shags dang rdor dril gang 'os/ slob ma rnams la 'thor rgyu'i me tog ting phor/ slob ma rnams la 'gyed rgya'i me tog ka tor ba re/ las kyi rdo rje'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ de la byug pa'i chu dang bcas pa bshams/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= lan bdun mdzad/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa gyur cigasdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig/sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig/nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig/rang skad cig gis thub pa rdo rje gdan du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūṃ gser gyi mdog can de las 'od 'phros/

mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa chen po gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ oṃ badz+ra nai we te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ / 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri phyogs bzhir bdud bzhi mtshams bzhir seng ge bzhis bteg pa'i steng du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ las rdo rje ser po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid thub pa rdo rje gdan sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ dbu gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ de'i g.yas su byams pa ser po/ g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon na spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/ g.yon pad+ma bsnams pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la lta ba'o/

/de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha āḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de dag gi phyag rgya spyi 'gro ltar mdzad/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas/ bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ byams pa la rnam snang*/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūṃ swāhā/

zhes bzlas la mthar sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'khor gnyis rang la thim/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ pād+yaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri zhes pa nas mdun bskyed yin pas bdag nyid mi zer/ khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur zer nas 'don pa spo/ gzhan dbu brgyan pa'i bar gong gi bdag bskyed dang 'dra bar mdzad nas/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas/ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar dang*/ na ma sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ oṃ sarba bid/ pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya bh+yaḥswāhā/ mchod yon sogs kyi phyag rgya bcing dgrol/ sarba bid la gang ba'i phyag rgya mdzad/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs dang*/ byams chen me sogs dang*/ skyon gyi ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bdun tsam gyi mnyes par byas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems cad thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod g.yog pa gcig gis thams cad la khrus kyi phyir chab btang*/ nang gi mchod g.yog pas me tog 'gyed bsdud skabs cha gnyis byas la/

me tog phyed phyed slob ma so so rang gis tshags byed du gzhugagasol btab kyi dus su thal mo stong par ma song ba byed/ phyed bsdus la maṇ+ḍal phul/ gral dang me tog bkram bsdu zin pa dang*/ 'di skad ces/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan dgongs pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir rgyud sde bzhi las sgrub thabs du ma gsungs pa rnams la/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon so sos sgrub thabs mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhugs pa yin la/ bsdus pa ba ri bas bsgyur ba 'di la sgrub thabs gzungs dang bcas pa dpe sna dgu bcu go drug yod/ sa skya pa gong ma rnams las brgyud cing thugs rtsis su mdzad pa yin la/ 'di ni rgya gzhung rnams las gcod dang dka' gnas gcod pa'i mchan bu dang ṭīk+ka rnams yod pas gzhung yang legs par bshad nus shing*/ shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas yin pas/ de'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gi cho ga sgrub par bgyid pa las/ dang po thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ mdun du dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa la mchod bstod/ bzlas pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ gtor ma rnams sngon du song nas/ da rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ slob mas 'dir maṇ+ḍal phul/ yang bla mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shigadus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ / lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du rgyun bshags dang skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bzung ba la sogs pa bgyid snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs gsum dang*/ khyad par du thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shigaslob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ da sbyor ba rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad pa zhu/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i khri sogs dang khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das thub pa zhes sogs nas lta ba'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gtso 'khor gsum bdag bskyed bzhin gsal btab bo/ /de nas slob dpon yang rang gis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i thub pa rdo rje gdan dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thub pa rdo rje gdan 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ de dag ni rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'o/ /rjes gnang dngos la/ lung gsum las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung blang ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ ser po/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba byung slob dpon gyi kha nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ ser po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags 'phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shiga.oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūṃ swāhā/ dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigabacom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / ces lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phul bar mos pa mdzod cig slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cigagasum pa dam bca' ba'i lung gi phyir/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan 'di nyid ji srid byang chub ma thob bar kyi yi dam du bzung ngo*/ /bdag thugs kyis ma btang zhig snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shigaslob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas gzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje 'das 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ 'di'i gsang sngags nyi ma re re bzhin 'di tsam re 'don par dam bca' lags so/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ des dngos gzhi lung gsum song*/ da ni rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/

mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung pa dang bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ snyam pa mdzad pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka nas thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi sku sor tshad tsam zhig rgyangs te byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di yig rnying na med na'ang phyag len la mdzad/ de nas 'di'i rgya gzhung sgrub thabs kyi lung yang spro na bya'o/ / de dag ni thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa'o/ / 'di gcig pu yin na/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs 'og bzhin bya/ gzhan dang sbrel nas byed na slob ma rnams kyis/ slob dpon cho ga sgrub pa'i bar la mdo 'don pa sogs byed do/ /slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ chos thun re la rjes gnang mang po sbrel nas mdzad na/ spyir slob dpon gyi bya ba la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kun la 'dra/ tshogs zhing dang*/ tshad med rting ma rnams la mi mdzad par stong nyid las dam tshig pa bskyed pa so sor 'gre/ gnas gsum byin rlabs 'dra/ ye shes pa lha de dang de'i rnam par spyan 'dren dbang bskur 'dra/ rigs bdag so sor yod de 'gre/ bzlas pa so so/ 'dod don gsol btab 'dra/ 'khor yod na gtso bo la bsdud pa'ang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs 'dra/ stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa las/ bdag nyid zhes pa 'jogagazhan so so'i bskyed chog bzhin bskyed rjes/ so so'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren te gzhan 'gre/ bzlas lung so sor 'byung*/ dam bca'i lung la 'don pa spo/ byin gyis brlabs pa la so so'i lha byon pa'i dmigs pa spo/ snga ma tsho la lung gsum tshar rjes de dag gis ni lha 'di zhes bya ba'i rjes gnang gi cho ga'o zhes brjod/

mdun bskyed kyi yi dam gshegs sdud kyang 'dra/ rjes lung tshar tshar bzhugs su bcug ste mchod pa 'bul/ nyin gcig gi rjes gnang rting ma la/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyis dam tshig bzung*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te tshar gsum bya/ 'dir sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang las bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang zhes sam/ rdo rje gdan la sogs pa lha khyad par du 'phags pa 'ga' zhig gi rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas des rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ ces byas nas/ bla mas rjes gnang rting ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la mchod pa gong mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i skabs kyis 'gre zhing*/ 'dir skabs rnga brdung*/ bstod pa mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma byed/ dgos 'dod kyi dngos grub blang*/ yig brgya brjod/ bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ bkra shis brjod pa'i tshig ston mchog dam pa sogs te/ rol mo rgya cher mdzad do/ /bstan pa 'di la lhag pa'i lha/ kuna~X gyi rtsa ba 'di yin pas/ rab dga~X' sems kyis bsgrubs gyur na/ snyinga~X po~X mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bcom ldan dam tshig gsum bkod la/ /btud nas sgrub thabs rgya mtsho yi/ /rjes gnang lag len chings shes phyir/ /gang 'di'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /de yang stegs bu gru bzhi pa ras bzang pos g.yogs pa'i steng du maṇ+ḍal rdul tshon gyi pad 'dab brgyad/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i tshom bu can nam/ bsdu na maṇ+ḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod/ chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lnga/ gtor ma rnams ci bder bsgrigs/ slob dpon gyi mdun du/ ting shags dang*/ rdor dril gang 'os/ slob ma rnams la 'thor rgyu'i me tog ting phor/ 'gyed rgyu'i me tog ka tor ba re/ las kyi rdo rje mdun du maṇ+ḍal/

chu dang bcas pa bsham/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= lan bdun mdzad/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cigasdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyud dang bral bar gyur cigasdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur ciganye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cigarang skad cig gis thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hri : traṃ yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nai we te āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta aḥhūṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang bzhin don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyis/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ ljang khu las sna tshogs pad+ma paṃ gyis mtshan pa dang*/ a las zla ba'i gdan la traṃ yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po sku mdog gser ltar 'bar ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba'o/ /sku'i g.yas su rdo rje 'dzin ser po phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar bas rdo rje ser po 'dzin pa/ g.yon du rdo rje 'dzin ma ser mo g.yas nor bu dang*/ g.yon rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi mdun du bu mo mtha' yas ma ljang khu g.yas phyag 'tshal tshul dang*/ g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'khor de gsum zhi ba/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan zhing bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yas kyi mdun du khye'u mtha' yas pa dmar po g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa me tog gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing*/ stag lpags dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang pa'i/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod gtso 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha āḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba'i bcom ldan 'das la rnam snang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ na maḥs+t+rai ya dhi kā nāṃ/

ta thā ga ta kā naṃ/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ta bāsti/ dharma tā bā li naṃ/ aṃ a sa ma/ sa man+ta to/ a nan+ta bāste shā sa nāṃ/ ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇa/ bi ga tā rā gabud+dha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra/ sa ma bā la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na mahā wa ra ṇa/ lak+ṣa ṇe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ na sā ga re swāhā/

zhes bzlas la/ mthar sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'khor bzhi po rang la thim/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ pād+yaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇā khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su paṃ ljang khu zhes pa nas/ mdun bskyed yin pas bdag nyid mi zer/ khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur zer nas 'don pa spo/ gzhan dbu brgyan pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra bar mdzad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis bar dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa sogs dang*/ gsang sngags bdag dang gzungs sngags rgyal/ /rig rgyal rigs kyi lha mo ste/ /bcom ldan dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal/ /mnyes par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ bzlas pa bdun tsam gyis mnyes par byas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wā ra a kā ro gsum gyis phul/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod g.yog pa gcig gis las thams cad la khrus kyis phyir chab btang*/ nang gi mchod g.yog pas me tog 'gyed bsdud skabs cha gnyis byas la/ phyed slob ma so sos bzung ste/

gsol btab kyi dus su thal mo stong par ma song ba byed/ phyed bsdus la maṇ+ḍal la phul/ gral dang me tog bkram bsdu zin pa dang*/ 'di skad ces/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan dgongs pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir rgyud sde bzhi las sgrub thabs du ma gsungs pa rnams las rgya gar gyi slob dpon so sos sgrub thabs mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhugs pa yin la/ de las rgyas pa slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ras bsdus pa sgrub thabs kun las btus sam/ sgrub thabs rgya mtshor grags pa 'di la/ chos tshan nyis brgya bzhi bcu lhag bcas yod pa las/ thog mar gyur pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rjes gnang la nged kyis bya ba rnams sngon du song ba/ rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ slob mas 'dir maṇ+ḍal phul/ yang bla mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shigardo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni 'gro la phan don du/ /gtso chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ / lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir mdun bskyed kyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro bas byang chub kyi sems bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs gsum dang*/ khyad par du thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shigaslob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab nas/ da rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad pa zhu/

oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ paṃ ljang khu la sogs dang*/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das thub pa zhes sogs nas/ thugs kar hūṃ zhes pa'i bar gtso 'khor lnga bdag bskyed bzhin gsal btab bo/ / de rjes gnang dngos gzhi la gsum las/ dang po'i sku'i rjes gnang ni/ de nas slob dpon yang rang gis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs brgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyod rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dril bu dang ting shag 'khrol/ rol mo bya/ mngon rtogs kyi dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa de phog la/ dbu rgyan gyi bar brjod do/ / gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ ser po/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi kha nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ ser po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ la thim pas mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig

na maḥs+t+rai sogs brjod/ dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigabacom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzod du gsol/ / ces lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phul bas mos pa mdzod cigaslob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la/ /bcom ldan 'das thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig/gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung bar dang*/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlob tu gsol snyam pa mdzad pas/ mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas/ phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa rgyangs te byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas 'di'i rgya gzhung sgrub thabs kyi lung yang spro na bya'o/ / de dag ni thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa'o/ / de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyis dam tshig bzung*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te tshar gsum bya/ 'di nyid gcig pu byed pa dang*/ rjes gnang gzhan dang sbrel tshul sogs ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i skabs dang 'dra ba yin pas/ thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi skabs su bshad pa las 'dir rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /rjes chog la/ mchod bstod mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i skabs kyis 'gre zhing*/ 'di skabs rnga brdung*/ bstod pa mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma

byed/ dgos 'dod kyi dngos grub blang*/ yig brgya brjod/ bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa bsdu/ bkra shis brjod pa'i tshig ston mchog dam pa sogs te/ rol mo rgya cher mdzod/ dkyil 'khor kuna~X tu dbang thob cing*/ /ci dga~X' spyod pas 'grub 'gyur sogs/ /snyinga~X po~X yig brgya 'di'i phan yon/ /mtha' yas rgyud las gsungs pa lags/ /dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ston pa gau tam lhag pa'i lha/ /'khor dang bcas pa la btud nas/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa spel byed kyi/ /thabs mchog sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /sgom don dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ dri bzang gi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu can bkod kyang rung ste/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed yi dam gang yang rung ba zhig gi rnal 'byor la gnas pa'am/ 'di'i rang lugs la bdag bskyed med kyang chog ste/ mdun bskyed kyi gzhi stong pa'i ngang las/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i khams las grub cing*/ yo byad sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba/ de'i dbus su rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor du pad+ma'i gdan bcu drug /shar sgo'i nang dang sgo bzhir rin po che'i gdan dang bcas pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba dang mtshungs pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa 'byung bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ spos btul shing*/ rol mos sgra dang bcas te/ ma lus sems can sogs kyi mthar/ 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seṅge yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag/gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa/

/chos skyong dgra bcom chen po bzhugs su 'tshal/ /dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren gyi/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas te/ / gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin zhing*/ khyad par can gyi 'phrin las chos skyong ba'i/ /gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes brjod pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ thub pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi 'khor dang bcas pa phyi bzhin 'brang ba dge bsnyen dharmā pā la/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi'i tshogs dang bcas pa rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku gser mdog g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyi bskor gyi pad+ma rnams la shar nas rim pa bzhin du g.yas skor gyis/ yan lag 'byung spos phor dang rnga yab/ ma pham pa mnyam bzhag/nags na gnas sdigs mdzub dang rnga yab/ dus ldan gser gyi rna bskor/ rdo rje mo'i bu sdigs mdzub dang rnga yab/ bzang po chos 'chad mnyam bzhagagaser be'u rin po che'i zhags pa/ bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mnyam bzhagab ku la ne'u le/ sgra gcan 'dzin rin po che'i dprog zhu/ lam phran brtan mnyam bzhagabha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len glegs bam lhung bzed/ lam brtan chos 'chad glegs bam/ klu'i sde bum pa mkhar bsil/ sbed byed glegs bam/ mi phyed pa byang chub mchod rten 'dzin pa rnams dgra bcom gnas brtan dbang po dul ba'i cha lugs can/ shar sgo'i nang du dge bsnyen chen po chos nyid rnga yab dang bum pa 'dzin zhing*/ dbu skra thor cog can/ glegs bam gyi khur po bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la gzigs shing*/ pus mo g.yas pa las stag sprul ba/ shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/

nub sgor mig mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po yid bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan dang ne'u le 'dzin pa rnams rang rang gi 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bcas te bzhugs par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mtshungs med lta bas mi ngoms zhing*/ / zhes sogs kyi bstod pas bstod/ oṃ mu ne mu ne mahā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ spro na re re zhing mchod pa dang bstod pa dang*/ tshig lhug pa'i gsol 'debs bya zhing*/ gtso bo'i sngags nyid bzla ba yin no/ /thun gyi mthar/ rgyal chen bzhi la gtor ma spyi dang mthun par bsngo/ cha gsum dang gzhi bdag gtor ma yang spro na bya/ rgyas pa la mos shing shes na/ gnas brtan sgrub yig las 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa rnams kyang bya zhing*/ bsdu na bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa nyid tshar gsum la sogs pa bya'o/ /'dir rig gtad byed par 'dod pas gtor 'bul yan chad song ba'i mtshams su slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ thub pa mchog dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /'gro ba'i mun sel dgra bcom gyi/ /tshogs la'ang bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed gsal btab la bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ skyabs sems rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ gsol 'debs tshig lhug pas gsol ba 'debs su bcugaslob ma thub pa'i dbang por skad cig gis bskyed la/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng spro ba'i bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ de tsam gyis don 'grub pa yin te/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs/ / zhes pa nas/ gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shis shog gi bar nges par 'don no/ /kuna~X tu byin rlabs cher grags pa/ /mchog tu dga~X' bas rab zhus te/

/gsol 'debs snyinga~X po~Xr byas na ni/ byin rlabs rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur/ /thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun las ches lhag pa'i/ /lhag bsam smon lam dge ba can/ /shākya seṅge la btud nas/ /de'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams sngon du btang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūṃ ser po'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu phyag g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu byung pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing*/ thugs mnyam par bzhag pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros thub pa ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yid kyis phyag mchod bya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar hūṃ sngon po/ sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar bsgoms la/ oṃ mu ne mu ne mahā mu na ye swāhā/
