zhes ci nus su bzla/ thun 'jog khar ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dod don gsol pa gdab/ dge ba bsngo/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya/'di'i lung 'bogs tshul ni/ thub pa'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang rung zhig gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal la me tog gis tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ oṃ las byung ba'i mchod par mos/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra marda nā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ mahā badz+re/ ma hā bid+ye badz+re/ mahā te dza badz+re/ mahā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi man+d+ro pa saṃ kra ma ṇe sarba karma a ba ra ṇai bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes mchod sprin gyis gzungs bzlas/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod bstod rnams bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ sgrub thabs ltar sgom lung dang bzlas lung 'bogs pa nyid yin na/ lha bzhi'i mi g.yo ba la bzlas lung 'bogs pa dang*/ rjes gnang gnyis ka yod cing*/ gzhan gsum la thun mong ma yin pa'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul tsam las med kyang*/ phyis sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya mtsho sogs dang mthun pa'i rjes gnang byed pa ni/ snying pos dben par shes so/ /thub pa sangs rgyas kuna~X 'dus kyi/ /sgrub thabs nyams len rab dga~X' ba/ /snyinga~X nas bka' gdams la mos na/ /nan tan chen po~Xs 'di sgrubs shig/bka' gdams lha bzhi las de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba sman gyi dbang po la/ /btud nas de'i sgrub thabs ni/ /a ti sha yi man ngag bzhin/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig gsal por bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du oṃ sngon po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/

rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po sku mdog mthing ga rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na a ru ra rgyas pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na baiḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ dar dmar pos chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ thugs kar zla ba oṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu spros/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ g.yas su a las byang sems zla ba ltar snang byed dkar po/ g.yon du maṃ las nyi ma ltar snang byed dmar ser/ gnyis ka'ang thal mo sbyar ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ na mo bha ga wa te/ bhai ṣa dz+ye gu ru baiḍūr+ya/ pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye/ mahā bhai ṣa dz+ye/ sa mud ga te swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ man chad kho na bzla ba'i lugs kyang yod de/ 'bum bzlas pas bsnyen pa'o/ /'jug tu ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs par mos la/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ 'dod don gsol btab dge ba bsngo/ yig brgya gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/'di'i rjes gnang bya thabs ni/ maṇ+ḍal gcig la tshom bu bdun gral rim du bkod/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ byin rlabs mdo chog bzhin byas kyang rung mod kyi/ spyi dang mthun par bya/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin sngon du btang nas/ maṇ+ḍal bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ tshom bu rnams pad zla'i gdan re rer gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa bdun 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can ma tshar gcig brjod/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ lan bdun/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla

zhes pa nas/ brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas kyi gdan gsum la rim pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon mkhyen rgyal po sku mdog dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag/chos sgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhagamya ngan med mchog dpal sku mdog dmar skya phyag gnyis mnyam bzhagagayon gyi gdan gsum la rim pas/ gser bzang dri med sku mdog dkar ser g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam bzhagarin chen zla ba sku mdog dmar ser g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam bzhagamatshan legs sku mdog ser po/ g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'o/ /ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad sogs kyis mchod pa'ang spro na bya/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum/ de nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o/ /gal te mdo chog yongs rdzogs la brten nas bsgrubs na/ bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas/ rjes chog ma gtogs cho ga tshar ba na bzlas pa gang 'grub bya'o/ /slob ma'i bya ba ni khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas gzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po yi dam du 'tshal gyi/ slob dpon gyis bdag la lung stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa lan gsum/ skyabs sems rgyas par 'bogs pa'am/ sangs rgyas chos dang ma lan gsum/ de nas 'di skad ces/ khyed rang rnams tha mal bar gnas pa'i spyi bor bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla zhes pa nas/ brgyan pa'o/ /dbu gtsug tu bla ma'i ngo bo'i nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang*/ de'i dbu gtsug tu mngon mkhyen rgyal po sku mdog dmar po

zhes sogs gcig gi dbu gtsug tu gcig rim pas gsal 'debs/ de rnams la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs 'od du zhu nas/ rin chen zla ba'i sku la thim/ de bzhin du rim pas sbyar te/ mngon mkhyen rgyal po 'od du zhu nas/ sman pa'i rgyal po la thim/ de'i sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung ste/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa bzhin du gyur par mos/ yang sman pa'i rgyal po'i dbu gtsug tu mngon mkhyen rgyal po gsal 'debs pa nas/ sdig sgrib bkrus pa'i bar gong bzhin lan gnyis te/ yongs dril lan gsum gyi mthar/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'od du zhu nas thim pa las/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla zhes pa nas/ brgyan pa'o/ /slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i oṃ sngon po la thim/ dpral bar oṃ sogs 'bru gsum bkod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod bzhin du/ me tog spyi bor bzhagasngags kyi bzlas lung*/ dam bca'i lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ slar yang mchod pa gsar pa zhig bshams la/ dpon slob rnams lhan cig pas byin gyis brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma'i tshigs bcad kyis 'bul/ mthar rol chen dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod nas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi sogs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung bya'o/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ chos skyong gi gtor ma btang*/ cha gsum gyi gtor ma sogs dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /sman bla'i sgrub thabs yi ge ni/ /kuna~X las dga~X' zhing gsal ba 'di/ /shog grangs mang ba mi ngom kyang*/ /snyinga~X po~X'i don bzang ngom du rung*/

/bcom ldan 'das sman bla'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ klu rnams kyi ni ston pa mchog/klu'i nad rnams zhi mdzad pa/ /klu dbang rgyal po la btud nas/ /klu rnams 'dul ba'i thabs la 'jug/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ād+ya nut+pan+na twad/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis bgegs bskrad/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun/ spro na bar 'di tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas/ phyag mchog yan lag bdun pa rnams bya ste/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe/ ma byas kyang rung ngo*/ / oṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po rin po che mi pogs pa'i kha dog lta bu/ zhal ras dkar zhing sku sngo ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ phyag gnyis thugs kar sems can rnams ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las 'don par mdzad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig rnam gsum gsol ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ me tog sna tshogs pa'i rgyab yol dang*/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ de'i mdun du sgrib pa rnam sel dkar po phyag g.yas na rin po che'i myu gu dang*/ g.yon nu bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yas su byams pa dmar po klu shing gi me tog dang*/ spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu 'jam dpal ser po ut+pal bsnams pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad+ma bsnams pa/ de thams cad pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs shing*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la blta ba'o/ /gzhan yang g.yas phyogs su byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang*/ g.yon phyogs su dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dang*/ 'og phyogs su klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o/

/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ puṣ+pe nas/ nai we te 'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po'i bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ tad+ya thā/ ta thā ga te bha ga wan nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhi ṣ+ṭha na a dhi ṣ+ṭha te swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ thun 'jog khar lha sku stong par sbyangs shing dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'di'i bzlas pa 'bum tsam song nas/ bris sku rab gnas can gyi drung du/ mchod pa la brtson pas mdun bskyed sgrub tshul gyis bsgrubs na/ mchog tu byin rlabs che'o/ /thun mtshams su mdo sde me tog bkod pa nas gsungs pa'i gzungs 'don no/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na'ang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal la me tog gis tshom bu lnga bkod/ dkar gtor cha gnyis bshams/ chung ba de la klu sman bsre/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gong du bstan pa ltar bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar bdag bskyed 'dra/ ar+ghaṃ nas nai we te'i bar spyi dang mthun pas mchod/ rol mo sogs mchod pa thams cad bsngo ba'i tshe/ oṃ sarba bi shwa dha ra pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa mud dre hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ chos dbyings skye med ngang las chos skur bzhengs/ /gzi brjid rgyal po nyi ma 'bum shar 'dra/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba dpal gyi sku/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dug sel mchog la 'dud/ / ces bstod/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ gtor ma dang po oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ snying po lan gsum gyis bcom ldan 'das dang*/ yang a kā ro dang*/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags lan bdun brjod pas brtan par byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'khor thams cad la phul nas/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro rig pa 'dzin/ /bcom ldan klu rgyal dkyil 'khor tshogs/ / lhan cig skyes dang bsrung byed pa'i/ /'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang*/ / lan chags snying rjer bcas pa rnams/ /mchog sbyin 'di yis mnyes tshim nas/ /tshogs bsogs bar chad zhi gyur cig/ ces sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gtsang sar gtang*/ gtor ma gnyis pa la dmigs nas/ gtor snod paṃ ser po las pad+ma'i snod du hrīḥyig dpag tu med pa gnas pa steng du sprin 'khrigs nas/ bdud rtsi'i char chen po babs nas 'dod dgu'i rgya mtshor gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ nor rgyas ser po snying gar thal mo sbyar bas/ rin po che'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa la sogs pa klu thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pa la kha 'bar ma'i sngags btags pa lan bdun gyis bsngos nas/ ye dhar gyi mthar/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ / zhes sogs chos bshad/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma de klu gnas sar btang ngo*/ /slob ma'i bya ba ni/ sngon 'gro rgyas par ni/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas par phog pa'i rjes su/ 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa mdor bsdus su len pa rnams bya/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang ma dang*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon bdag la dgogs su gsol/ /bdag ni klu dbang rgyal po yi/ /dam tshig dngos grub 'tshal ba ste/ /bdag la gzungs sngags stsal du gsol/

/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sku'i rjes gnang dang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra/ thugs kyi rjes gnang*/ slob ma'i snying ga'i 'od kyis khams gsum snod bcud lha la bsdu/ lha yang hūṃ la/ de yang stong par bsdu'o/ / slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X las zab cing a ti shas/ /dga~X' bar bsngags pa'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /deng sang sgrub pa dkon pa'i phyir/ /gzhan la phan phyir snyinga~X po~Xr dril/ /klu dbang rgyal po sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ de bzhin gshegs pa chags bral gyi rnam pa can gyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ /zhus dag / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la 'dud de/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rjes 'brang ba/ /nyung ngur mos pa rnams kyi ngor/ /sgrub thabs rim pa mdo tsam bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ rang gi snying ga'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ zhes phyag bya/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs

sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis rgyun bshags bya/ rnam thar sgo gsum dran bzhin pas/ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags brjod/ nam mkhar oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa bar do'i rnam shes so/ /'og tu rdo rje'i rwa gur gyi dbus su/ sna tshogs chu skyes la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang*/ de'i nang du pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang*/ ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ / 'di ni shin tu bsdus pa la dga' ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ shes shing spro na lugs 'di'i mngon byang lnga bskyed nyid bsgoms na nges par legs pa yin no/ / yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pas/ nam mkha'i yi ge lnga po yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi mkhar babs/ yi ge lnga'i 'od zer gyis yab yum byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor zhu/ thig le las lha mo bzhi spros/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ / mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi zhe na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i sku khyod bka'i 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan 'dod pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi zhe na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po= rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la= khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/

/yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po= yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces bskul nas thim pa las/ thig le de nyid maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las dkyil 'khor spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad tshur 'dus/ thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dang sku lus gur gum gzhon nu ltar dmar ser/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing*/ nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ dar dang rin po ches spras pa'o/ /yum yang yab dang mtshungs pa las/ lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs shing*/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'khyud pa/ zla 'od 'phro ba'o/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mig tu k+ṣa las sa snying*/ rna bar dz+riṃ las phyag rdor/ snar khaṃ las nam snying*/ lcer gaṃ las spyan ras gzigs/ dpral bar skaṃ las sgrib sel/ lte bar saṃ las kun bzang*/ dpral bar oṃ las sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje/ snying gar hūṃ las thugs rdo rje/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje gsum la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ= waka= oṃ= tsit+ta= haṃ/ rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ral gri'i yu bar maṃ gyis mtshan pa ni ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o/ /de'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/

sogs kyis dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dmigs pa gsal na skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams la'ang rang rang gi rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan par mos/ yum gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang ba āḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu rnams de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bo gyur/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis yum gyi sku gang*/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dang*/ a las byung ba'i pad+ma/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs/ yang sangs rgyas thams cad 'dod pa'i yon tan dang bcas pa yab kyi sku la bcug mkha' nang du spros pa lha mo bcur gyur/ phyir spros nas bdag nyid la mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchod khyod 'dud/ / sogs 'dud nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod/ nang mchod/ oṃ ā bigha nan+tā kṛ hūṃ gis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bi ra ma mu shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga rnams bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ sbyangs rtogs sbar bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ slar yang 'bru gsum gyis myangs te/ phyi nang gi lha rnams mnyes par bsam/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ ā maṃ hūṃ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mthar lha sku 'od gsal du bsdus te cung zad mnyam par gzhag de las phyag gnyis pa'i skur langs/ gnas gsum dang skye mched byin gyis brlab pa dran tsam byas te/ dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ gyis mchod yon phul/ oṃ āḥmañdzu badz+ra pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ

zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis phyogs skyong sogs la phul bar mos/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gong bzhin bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ sgrub pa'i thabs 'di lag len gyi khyad ma gtogs/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i kun las btus pa'i nang na bzhugs pa nyid yin la/ de'i phyir rjes gnang yang de nyid kho nas chog go /'on kyang gal che zhing nye bar mkho ba'i phyir dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i lag len du grags pa'i bod kyi yig cha rnams na/ sku'i rnam pa dang*/ snying po'i sngags kyi khyad par tsam bkod pa ma gtogs/ mngon rtogs kyi chings rgya gzhung dang mthun par sbyar ba med pas/ 'dir rang gzhung dang mthun par bkod pa yin no/ /kuna~X tu bzang mo las btus pa'i/ /rab dga~X' sgrub thabs bzhin du bkod/ /'dir ni snyinga~X po~X tsam bsdus kyi/ /rgyas par spro na gzhan du ltos/ /gsang ba 'dus pa las 'byung ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po la/ /gus pas btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung bzhin du/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems bsod nams tshogs bsog sogs spyi dang mthun/ bsrung 'khor chos 'byung*/ pad nyi/ sna tshogs rdo rje gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su dbyangs bcu drug nyis 'gyur las zla ba/ gsal byed so bzhi nyis 'gyur/ dbyangs bcu gnyis dang bcas pa las nyi ma/ dbus su hūṃ yig dang bcas pa'i 'phro 'du gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje 'chang chen po mthing ga /nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma rang dang 'dra ba la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/

dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes gsungs shing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po nas/ dbu brgyan/ rjes su chags pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i lha mo spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug zhes sogs sh+lau ka bzhi'am/ oṃ mahā su khaṃ badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ su ra ta s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes bskul bas/ sngon bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ snying gar zla ba la hūṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥ spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ rnams thugs gsung sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du spyan drangs/ gnas gsum du thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin du waka kā ya zhes 'don pa spo/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs gsung skur mdzad gsol/ / zhes bskul/ rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgom zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa gtso bor bzla zhing*/ de'i bcu cha/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dha twī shwa ri hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa bzla'o/ /thun gyi mthar/ snod bcud thams cad 'od gsal du bsdus nas/ mnyam par bzhag /gtor ma'ang bla med spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas 'bul lo/ /'di'i slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba kho na yin no/ /kuna~X nas rnyed dka' ches thob pa/ /dga~X' chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam/ /bskyed rim snyinga~X po~X'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /nyer mkhor mthong nas gsal bar bris/

/'di 'phags skor dang mthun shas che yang*/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs yin par shes par bya'o/ /gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po la/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i rim las 'ongs/ /dran pa gcig pa bshad par bya/ /grub pa'i slob dpon bya da lis mdzad pa'i mahā mā ya'i sgrub thabs dran pa gcig pa sgom par 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ/ zhes spyan drangs/ yid kyi sprul pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags don bsam/ hūṃ yig las rang gi mdun du snod kyi 'jig rten rnam par dag pa pad+ma dang*/ zla ba dmar skya'i gdan la/ hrīḥlas dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo sku mdog sngon mo zhal bzhi sngo ser dmar ljang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs 'phyar ba/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo rang mtshungs dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thod skam kyi dbu rgyan/ mgo phreng phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ de la yid kyis mchod pa phul/ de nyid rang gi snying nang du thim pas/ rang nyid he ru ka'i sku snga ma bzhin du gyur pa la/ spro na go cha'i yi ge rnams dgod de/ mgrin par āḥ rna ba gnyis la a/ mig la oṃ rnams dmar po/ sna la kha dkar po/ dpral bar tsi ser po/ snying gar ra dmar po'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ/ zhes bzlas pa ci nus bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang ci nus su bsgom ste bde chen myur sgrub tu bshad zin to/

/gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes pa skad cig gis mdun du byon pa la/ oṃ a gu h+ya ā bha k+ṣa bhak+ṣai hūṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ de rang la bstim/ byin rlabs ni/ chos 'byung dmar po/ gru gsum gyi dbus su/ thig le dkar po yod pa zhig bri/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/ mngon rtogs bsgoms nas gtor ma gong bzhin 'bul/ mchod pa'ang 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ yid kyis 'bul/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal byas nas/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chang rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sgrub thabs kyi dmigs pa phog nas/ sngags bzlar bcug / bum dbang ngo*/ zhes brda sprad/ snying gar nyi zla kha sbyor rgya sran tsam pa'i dbus su/ thig le yungs 'bru tsam la sems gtod du gzhug /brjod bral gyi nyams myong ngo sprad la gsang dbang ngo*/ / zhes brjod/ lte ba'i a yig 'bar ba'i/ spyi bo'i haṃ zhu bar dmigs la rlung bzung du bcug thur sel bsdams pas bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsam/ shes dbang ngo*/ /chos 'byung ni dbyings spros bral/ thig le ni rig pa bde ba chen po'i brda'o zhes dbang bzhi pa'o/ / 'di la rjes chog mi dgos/ rab zab mahā mā ya'i gzhung*/ /kuna~X gyi zab don dga~X' bas zhus/ yang snyinga~X len tshul 'di 'dra ba/ /gzhan la yod med gsal po~Xr smros/ /mahā mā ya gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ gang zhig tshul 'dir 'jug byed pa/ /de la lhan skyes bde chen po/ /ci yang 'bar bar 'gyur bas te/ /de phyir lhan skyes sgrub thabs so/ /'dir bde mchog lhan skyes sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med sngon du 'gro bar bya/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du rang sems hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/

rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ mgo 'greng dang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang*/ thod pa skam po'i 'phreng ba can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs can gyi yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ gi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad bde mchog yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ/ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ bzlas pas dmigs pa gsal btab la/

oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o/ /gal te shin tu bsdus pa nyams su len par 'dod na/ skad cig gis bskyed cing gnas gsum byin rlabs man chad mi dgos la/ bzlas pa'i mthar rjes gzhig gi rim pas 'od gsal du bsdu'o/ /thun mtshams su dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub du bsngo/ gtor ma sum bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ a las ka pā la'i nang du 'bru gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo phaiṃ/ zhes mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ a ral+li hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol ba'am/ yo ga shud+dha ོ'i sngags kyis rang nyid la bstim pa gang rung byas/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod do/ /'di'i byin brlab ni/ tshes bcu la maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po can/ mdun du mchod gtor bzang ba dang bcas pa/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa bca'/ tshogs 'khor sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar byas/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin bsgoms nas/ mdun bskyed dang bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus dang bum pa'i nang du/ pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin gnyis kar la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/

gong bzhin gtor ma phul/ 'jig rten pa la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi gtor ma btang*/ bar 'dir lhag gtor la thug gi bar tshogs mchod rnams rgyas par bya/ tshogs mchod ye ma grub na yid kyis kyang rung*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol btab dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags bya/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa 'khor lo bde mchog nas/ dbu rgyan gyis bar bdag bskyed bzhin gsal 'debs su 'jug /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /lus kyi dri ma sbyang ba dang*/ /de nyid bde chen bdag la stsol/ / zhes rjes zlos lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyi gnas gsum dang*/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum sgom du bcug la/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po dpag tu med par byung*/ slob ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim pas/ bum dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag par mos shig ces brjod la/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag bum chu ku shas dpral bar gtor ro/ / oṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi mgrin pa yan chad gang bar mos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung zhes dang*/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs ba dang zhes 'don pa spos la gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas/ āḥspros te/ slob ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥl bstim/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /bum chu mgrin par gtor/ snying kha yan chad gang bar mos/ de bzhin du/ rang bzhin thugs dang yid kyis dri ma zhes 'dod pa spos/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las hūṃ spros te/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ la bstim/ sher dbang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag bum chu snying gar gtor/ lte ba yan chad gang bar mos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs zhes dang*/ sgo gsum dri ma zhes 'dod pa spos la gsol btab/

slob dpon gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las/ 'bru gsum char byung*/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /bum chu gnas gsum char du gtor la 'thung du gzhug rkang mthil yan chad gang bar mos/ mngon rtogs kyi dmigs pa phog sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin no/ / rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ mchod pa kha gsos/ byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod/ dngos grub blangs/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams te rjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang 'dra ba yin no/ /yi dam kuna~X las ches lhag pa'i/ /sgrub thabs lhan skyes dga~X' bskyed pa/ /sngon byon rnams kyis rgyas bshad mod/ /'dir ni ngag 'don snyinga~X po~Xr bkol/ /'di'i nyams len bsdus pa skad cig gis bskyed pa ni/ dril bu gzhung chung dang*/ a bh+ya ka ra sogs kyis dgongs pa yin la/ yan lag bzhi bskyed ni dga' rab rdo rje'i lugs yin gsung zhing*/ slob dpon gzhan mang po zhig gi gzhung la yang 'di bzhin du snang ngo*/ /zhes pa 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bstan pa'i le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka dpal la btud nas/ /cho ga'i dpa' bo drug po yi/ /byin rlabs byed tshul snying po tsam/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis bri bar bya/ /maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab lnga la/ lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod/ mañdzi'i steng du/ thod pa nang mchod dang bcas pa bsham/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor bar bde mchog bzhin sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ lū nag lta bu bde mchog gi mngon rtogs mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig rdzogs par bsgom/ mdun bskyed sum bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ thod pa dang maṇ+ḍal gyi gnas su stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/

paṃ las pad+ma 'dab lnga lte ba la/ oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga g.yas gnyis kyis cang te'u dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can zla ba la gnas pa/ mdun nas brtsams te 'dab ma rnams la g.yon bskor gyis/ na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ swāhā hu las pad+ma gar dbang dmar po pad+ma/ bau ṣaṭa he las dpal he ru ka nag po rdo rje/ hūṃ hūṃ ho las rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser rin po che/ phaṭa haṃ las rta mchog ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang rtags dang*/ dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis g.yas ḍa ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs shing*/ stag lpags dang*/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ phyag drug sogs dpal he ru ka nyid dang mtshungs pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ/ zhes ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa bstim/ yo ga shud+dho sa nga rgyal bzung*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab mi dgos/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ yid mchod rnams phul/ rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka /snang mdzad rdo rje nyi ma dang*/ /gar dbang rdo rje rta rgyal po/ /rigs drug 'khor los bsgyur ba ni/ /kun tu bsrung dang byin rlabs dang*/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyi/ /sku la zhugs nas phrin las mdzad/ /go cha'i lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ / ces pas bstod/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swāhā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭa haṃ/ zhes ci nus bya/ gtor ma mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ nas dṛ sh+ya hoḥl go cha 'i sngags btags nas 'bul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/

srid dang zhi ba mnyam dang sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ kha kha sogs kyis mkha' 'gro spyi la 'bul tshul spyi dang 'dra/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs dang*/ don dam smra ba'i sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung*/ dam tshig nyer gnyis bzung ba rnams bya/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed la mos gus dung byas pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste/ lus thams cad bkrus pa'i dmigs pa lan gsum 'bogs/ slob ma bde mchog tu skad cig gis bskyed pa'i lus la go cha'i lha rnams bkod/ sangs rgyas thams cad go cha'i lha'i rnam par bstim pa dang*/ sngags 'bru'i rnam pa bstim pa dang*/ phyag mtshan bstim pa rnams la spos dang rol mo re re mdzad/ maṇ+ḍal gnas rnams su reg pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs de dang de slob ma'i gnas rnams su thim par mos/ bdud rtsis kyang gnas rnams su thig le byed cing*/ lus thams cad la gtor/ cung zad 'thung du bcug pas kyang de bzhin du bsgom/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ deng phyin chan lha'i sku la go cha bkod pa dang*/ go cha'i lha re re bsgom pa dang*/ dpa' bo drug gi dkyil 'khor bsgom yang rung ste/ go cha'i las tshogs rnams sgrub pa la nus mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X tu rnyed dka' rab dga~X'i chos/ /so so'i sgrub thabs nyams len la/ /nyer mkho byin rlabs cho ga yi/ /snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam spel ba yin/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang 'brel ba'i go cha'i dpa' bo drug gi byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i le tshan no// //zhus dag / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rnal 'byor ma dpal la btud nas/ /go cha'i rnal 'byor ma drug gi /byin rlabs bya tshul rab gsal ba/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bshad par bya/ /de la go cha'i dpa' bo drug po'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bya tshul bshad ma thag pa de nyid blo yul du nges par byas nas/

mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad tsam gyi nges par bya ste/ pad+ma'i lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo dmar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum gyis gri gug tshangs mgo lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum gyis thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ mdun nas brtsams te 'dab ma rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas/ haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ las bskyod byed ma ser mo/ hūṃ hūṃ las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi kā gdung kha/ rmongs byed ma zla ba dang gzhan rnams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ de rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang yi dwags kyi gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ khyad par gzhan rnams bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ bstod pa ni/ rigs drug gi ni rnal 'byor ma/ /bar chad bsrung ba'i las mdzad cing//'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med pas/ /dbang bsgyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'o/ /gtor sngags dang*/ byin rlabs kyi go cha'i skabs ni lha dang*/ sngags brjes pa ma gtogs dpa' bo drug gi skabs dang khyad par med do/ /shin tu dkon zhing rnam kuna~X tu/ /dga~X' bar bsngags pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rab gsal go bde'i rim pas te/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam du gsal bar byas/ /go cha'i dpa' bo drug gi byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka dpal 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bla ma rje la gus btud nas/ /byang chub sgrub lam bde mchog gi /sgrub thabs shin tu gsal bar bri/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang nas/ stong pa nyid la cung zad mnyam par bzhag

shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ ka ni gang du mi gnas pa'o/ / bdag nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i dpal he ru ka sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyang ba'i dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ ngos la sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin zhing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang khro sgeg lang tsho la bab cing*/ bde ba rgyas pa'i sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyang rang dang 'dra bar bltas la/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla'o/ /mthar lū yi pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i 'od gsal ldang 'jug la bslab par bya'o/ / gtor ma sum bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ zhes gtor mgron thams cad spyan drangs/ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan bdun gyis 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ / ces bstod/ oṃ kha kha sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor 'bul ba spyi dang 'dra zhing*/

rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang ngo*/ /'di nyid kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang ci nus su bsgom mo/ /de ltar bskyed rim nyams su len tshul 'di ni/ dpyal a mo gha'i khrid yig dang*/ mkhan chen byang chub pa'i yig sna dang*/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba dang*/ mkhan chen rdo rje pa nas brgyud pa thog ston shes rab rdo rjes byas pa thams cad don gyi cha la zhus dag （《dzaṃ》+zer ）ba ltar yod pas/ yid ches skyes nas lugs rnying pa ltar bkod do/ /gang dag 'di la shūn+ya'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs nas/ bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su he ru ka'i sngags don dran pas/ lha sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su bskyed pa ni 'di nyid kyi man ngag khungs ma gang na yang med cing*/ rang gis kyang sngags kyi bskyed tshul med cing*/ ye shes kyi bskyed tshul yin no zhes brjod pa dang yang 'gal ste/ ye shes kyi bskyed tshul yin na/ lus dben dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ zung 'jug gsum gyi bskyed tshul las ma 'das pas so/ /bzlas bya'i sngags kyang yig bdun bor nas/ 'khor lo bsgyur drug gi nang gi rdo rje sems dpa'i sngags bzla ba ni/ man ngag rnying pa sun byung nas chos la dbang za bar byed pa ste/ spyir bde mchog sku mdog dkar po yin pa tsam la de bzhin 'byung du rung yang*/ kha che paṇa chen gyi man ngag 'di'i dbang du byas nas/ 'di nyid lū yi pa'i man ngag yin par rang nyid khas len bzhin du lū yi pa'i sgrub thabs na gtan med pa'i sngags 'di bzlos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di ni lwa wa pa dang bi bhū ti dang*/ pradzñā rak+ṣi ta rnams kyis bshad pa ltar gyi rnal 'byor chen po'i skabs su 'byung ba'i ye shes sems dpa' de nyid logs su phyung ba'i sgrub thabs yin par man ngag rig pa dag gsung zhing*/ don la yang gnas so/ /de'i phyir sems dpa' sum brtsegs byed pa dang*/ snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdu lugs spyi 'gro tsam du sbyor pa yang mi legs shing*/

bi bhū ti dang*/ pradzñā rak+ṣi ta'i lugs dang yang mi mthun no zhes pa cal col tsam mo/ /'di'i rdzogs rim gyi rnam gzhag kyang bi bhū tis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa khyad par gsal byed kyi bshad pa'i rnam grangs rting ma dang shin tu mthun par yod la/ a bha yā kā ras bshad pa'i kha bskang ba yin no zhes zer na yang*/ slob dpon des mdzad pa la/ 'di dang 'brel ba'i bstan bcos ye med pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor lo bsgyur drug gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tsam la bsam pa srid na yang*/ shin tu mi 'dra ba che ba'i phyir phyogs su 'gro ba tsam yang ma yin no/ /zhes pa de tsam zhig lugs snga phyi gnyis kyi khyad par shes shing sgrub thabs gsar pa'i rang mtshang go ba'i phyir mgo smos tsam du zad kyi/ mang du smras pas ci zhig bya/ 'di'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu dkar po can mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs bde mchog spyi dang mthun par bya/ gong bzhin bdag bskyed song ba na/ mdun bskyed kyang bdag bskyed bzhin du bskyed la/

ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa yid kyis phul nas bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ gtor ma phul/ bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ slob ma la byed pa ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blang*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs dang*/ don dam smra ba'i seṅge sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yi/ / sogs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams song ba na/ dam tshig nyer gnyis bzung ba yi ge snga ma rnams na med pas ma byas kyang chog la/ byas kyang 'gal ba med par mngon/ de nas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyangs nas sngar bzhin bskyed pa la ye shes pa bstim/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum gsal btab la/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa thams cad oṃ dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ yang slob dpon gyi dpral ba nas sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa thams cad oṃ dkar po dpag tu med pa'i rnam par byon/ slob ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ rol mo'i bya ste/ bum dbang ngo*/ / de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥlas gsang dbang*/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las sher dbang*/ gsum ka las dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam ste/ gong mas rigs 'gre/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /rab zab rdzogs rim dang 'brel ba'i/ /man ngag mkhas kuna~X dga~X' ba'i phul/ /snyinga~X po~X lhan skyes sgrub thabs 'di/ /zab cing yid ches gnas kyi mchog /bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

// ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bde chen he ru ka dpal ni/ /stong nyid rnal 'byor ma dang sbyor/ /de la gus pas btud byas nas/ /tshe sgrub cung zad bshad par bya/ /'di la sgrub thabs kyi khyad par ni/ byang chub sgrub lam nyid dang 'dra ba las/ rang nyid rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ stag lpags kyis brgyan pa dang*/ yum la thod skam gyi do shal byed/ bzlas pa'i skabs tshe sgrub kyi dmigs pa dang bcas/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ma ma ā yur puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /'di la yig rnying 'ga' na zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs par byas pa'ang yod pas gang mos su bya'o/ /de nas rlung bum can bzung*/ rang yab rkyang du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas lha mo lnga thod pa thogs pa spros/ khams gsum gyi bcud rnams thod par bsdus te/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas blugs pas lus gang*/ lha mo rnams gcig tu 'dres rang la 'khyud sbyor gyis zhugs par bsam/ yang spyi bor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa mgo thur bstan/ de'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das kyi bcud bsdus/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nas brgyud spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'khor lo bzhir dga' bzhi nyams su myong*/ lus thams cad bdud rtsi rlan drod can gy-is gang bar bsam/ 'di'i byin rlabs ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bum thod brtsegs pa bshams/ sdom bzung yan chad bde mchog dkar po byang chub sgrub pa dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi slob ma lhar bskyed/ bzlas lung sbyin/ lha dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa spyi dang 'dra ba'i sgo nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bum dbang ngo*/ /thod pa la brten nas tshe bsring ba'i dmigs pa phog nang mchod sbyin/ gsang dbang ngo*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la brten pa'i dmigs pa phog sher dbang ngo*/ /gnas lugs kyi lta ba skyong du bcug ste/ dbang bzhi pa'o zhes brda sprad/ rjes spyi dang 'dra'o/ /tshe sgrub kuna~X nas zab pa'i phul/ /rgyud don yid ches ches dga~X' ba/

/mi lus snying po len 'dod na/ /'di'am 'di 'dra'i rigs sgoms shig /bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi len tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpa' bo bde mchog he ru ka /spyan ras gzigs dang gnyis med pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs ni/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/ /bsod nams tshogs bsog spyi dang mthun/ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags don bsam/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor hūṃ las bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni sogs sngags drug bde mchog bzhin brjod/ dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa lte bar pad nyi'i gdan la/ ā li las zla ba dkar po/ kā li las zla ba dmar po/ de'i dbus su hūṃ/ 'od zer 'phro 'du las rang nyid dpal chen spyan gzigs sku mdog mthing ka nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdor dril 'dzin pas yum sgeg mo dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis mi lpags stod g.yogs su 'phyar ba/ tha ma gnyis ḍa ma ru dang thod khrag 'dzin zhing*/ mchan khung na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rus dum gyi do shal dang*/ me tog dang rin po ches kyang brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas dbang phyug dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dkar mo mnan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser 'khyil ba la u dum ba ra'i me tog can/ he ru ka'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /rtsibs drug la mdun nas g.yon bskor gyis/ phaṭa hūṃ ha ha hrīḥ.oṃ las he ru ka ma sngon mo/ 'jigs ma ser mo/ drag mo dmar mo/ dbang byed ma ljang khu/ rnam ltas ma dud kha/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ḍa ma ru dang dril bu mi lpags bsnams pa/ nyi ma dang ro gdan la bzhugs shing*/ rnam pa gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ / ye shes pa bsres/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ khaṃ khams lnga yum lngar gyur/ oṃ aṃ hrīḥho hūṃ phung po lnga rigs lngar gyur/ bh+ruṃ hūṃ aṃ khaṃ haṃ haṃ/

skye mched drug la gnas pa sems dpa' drug gi bdag nyid du gyur/ yab kyi gnas rnams su/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swāhā hūṃ/ bau ṣa ṭ+wa he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭa haṃ/ yum gyi gnas rnams su/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla'o/ /thun gyi mthar/ dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus/ rang nyid kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur/ dbyings dang mnyam par ba zhag / gtor chog ni/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa lhan cig tu 'bul ba'i lugs yin pas/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor kho nas chog go /'di'i byin rlabs byed tshul ni/ maṇ+ḍal la 'khor lo ser po rtsibs drug lte ba nyi gdan du bya/ rtsibs rnams la'ang nyi gdan chung ngu re 'god/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du lha rnams kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i rdul tshon gyi tshom bu dang*/ 'khor lo'i phyi rol/ pad rwa/ rdo rwa/ me ris bskor/ nang du gtor ma gnyis dang mchod pa bzang du bshams/ yol bas mtshams bcad/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bgegs gtor gyi tshul du btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ de'i dbus su rang nyid 'dug par bsams la/ gong bzhin bzlas pa yan chad mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom/ gtor ma dang po de bsngos la gtsang sar btang*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ mig dar*/ me tog dga' chen khyod sogs gsol btab/ rgyun bshags/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung*/ zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed mna' chu blud pa rnams bya/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas lha tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros nas/

slob ma la bstim/ yig bdun gyi mthar a be sha ya btags pa mang du bzla/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi sogs kyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hos gtso bo la me tog gtor/ mdun bskyed lha ngo bstan/ dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob ma mngon rtogs bzhin gtso bor bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ mngon rtogs bzhin dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs bum dbang*/ yi ge bdun pas nang mchod sbyin/ gsang dbang*/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar te spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba'i dga' ba bzhi'i don la ngo sprad/ sher dbang*/ sems phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad pa dbang bzhi pa/ de nas bzlas lung sbyin/ slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ mchod bstod song ba'i rjes su gtor ma gnyis pa de bsngo ba yin no/ /kuna~X nas zab pa mi tra'i gsung*/ /lo ts+tsha ba la rjes gnang tshe/ /mchog tu dga~X' bas yi ger bkod/ /de'i snyinga~X po~X 'di tsam lags/ 'jig rten dbang phyug yi ge bdun par grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ /dar rgyas 'phel// // ༄༅/ /na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ dpal ldan rdo rje snying rje'i stobs/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad la btud de/ /shin tu gus shing brtson ldan la/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje lhan skyes sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang ste/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ shū n+ya nas stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rang gi snying nang du nyi ma'i steng du zla ba/ de gnyis kyi bar du sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros lus thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag

rang nyid he ru ka'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar ba mi bskyod pas spyi bo mtshan pa/ hūṃ gis sgras 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs ka'i thad du 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lnga dang thal pas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs sam/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis pad nyi dbugs bral dang bcas pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ / gal te yab rkyang du byed na stag lpags kyi sham thabs can du bya'o/ / dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de nas lha'i sku la yun ring du sems 'dzin/ spro na 'khor lo'i bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ gal te rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par 'dod na/ snying gar mar me mthe bong tsam gyi rtse la 'od zer phra mo rta rnga tsam sor gnyis kyi tshad du 'bar ba'i rtse la nor bu ljang khu gru gsum sran ma tsam la sems gtad/ nyin mo de klad rgya'i steng du bsgom/ bying na spyi bo'i steng dang*/ rgod na lte bar bsgom/ thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i tshe/ lha sku 'od gsal du bsdus te/ slar yang lha skur langs la/ dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma/

phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ ar+gha ཾ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ / sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs su gsol ba sogs gzhan rnams dang mthun par bya/ rnal 'byor gzhan rnams kyang spyi dang mthun pa yin pas rig 'dzin pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya'o/ /'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte bar nyi gdan tshom bu dang bcas pa/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ nang mchod zhig kyang bshams la/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ram/ kyai rdor gyi mngon rtogs ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar du song nas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed la/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar bya/ gtor ma gong bzhin 'bul ba las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje la/ zhes pa'i tshig bor/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar/ bzlas pa ci nus bya/ de nas mchod bstod byas la/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci nus zhig bya'o/ /mthar 'bru gsum lan nyer gcig tsam brjod/ bdud rtsir mos pa tsam las dmigs pa gzhan mi dgos/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis dang*/ rgyun bshags dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung spyi dang mthun/ ye shes 'pho ba sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba zhig byas la/ slob dpon kyai rdo rjer gsal bas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ / zhes sogs brjod cing*/ nang mchog thod pa spyi bor bzhag bdud rtsi srin lag gis gtor bas/ lus gang bas bum dbang thob par mos su gzhug /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/

sogs brjod/ bdud rtsi byin la ji ltar bzlas pa'i sogs brjod pa gsang dbang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje bdag med ma spros te/ slob ma'i lus la 'khyud pas bde stong skyes par mos su 'jug dga' ster gnas der sogs brjod/ shes rab ye shes so/ /stong nyid la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug la/ ye shes 'di ni sogs brjod de dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas bzlas lung sbyin/ dbang gi mtha' brten rnams thob par mos/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X tu zab cing tshig nyung ba/ / rnal 'byor can rnams dga~X' ba'i gnas/ /spros pa kun spangs snyinga~X po~X'i don/ /sgrub thabs 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad/ /ces pa dpal kyai rdo rje'i snying po'i he ru ka lhan skyes kyi sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa'i le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ gang 'dir gnyis med ye shes kyi/ /rigs brgya rnam dag dam pa'i dngos/ /rgyal ba drug 'dus rdo rje sems/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la 'dud do/ /'dir dus 'khor lhan skyes sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bar bya/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dur 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po pad+ma dang*/ /zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor/ / zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa/ /lha'i dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskums pas dbang phyug dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po brkyang ba'i 'dod lha dmar po'i snying gar mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ /rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/

mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe chung ljang khu/ phyag sor rnams kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o/ /rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan zhing*/ me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing*/ dbu skra phyed grol ba'o/ /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥser po/ gtsug gtor du haṃ ljang khu/ gsang bar k+ṣa sngon po rnams su gyur/ oṃ.āḥhūṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ

zhes pa'o/ / snying gar rnam bcu dbang ldan brtsegs par bsams nas/ oṃ swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ thun mtshams su dge ba bsngo/ 'di la gtor bsngo sogs med kyang rung la/ spro na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hrā phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang*/ /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*/ /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ / zhes mdun du spyan drangs/ snying por mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod la/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye 'jigs med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rjes spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma rgyas pa la dga' na/ sgrub thabs chen mo rnams su shes par bya'o/ /'dir rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra la/ thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan bstim pa nyid yin no/ /sgrub thabs kuna~X las ches bsdus pa/ /blo dman dga~X' ba bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /bskyed rim snyinga~X po~X nyung ngu'i ngag / 'di yang 'gro la phan phyir brtsams/ /dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bstan pa'i le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum khro rgyal he ru ka /kun 'dus khro bo'i dbang po ni/ /'jigs byed sna tshogs gzugs 'chang ba/ /dus 'khor khros pa la phyag 'tshal/ /'di la rgyas par na dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsrung 'khor gyi skabs bzhin bsgom pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir bla ma'i man ngag gis mdo tsam du bya ba ni/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje rwa ba'i dbus na/ oṃ paṃ bi shwa badz+ra pad+maṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

de'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan/ oṃ ra badz+ra sūr+ya badz+ra sūr+ya a sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po'i mdog can/ mdun zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ zhal re re zhing spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzais pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de rnams re re la yang mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu'o/ /de rnams re re la yang tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de lta bu'i g.yas kyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri khug /mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ ḍa ma ru/ tho ba/ 'khor lo/ mdung*/ dbyug pa dgra staṃ rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/ rdo rje'i dril bu/ phub/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ dung*/ me long*/ rdo rje'i lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis g.yas pa nag po dang*/ g.yon pa ser po'i sdigs mdzub dang bcas te glang po che'i pags pa stod g.yogs su gyon pa/ bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums/ g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bdud dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ yi dwags kyi rgyal po rnams kyi snying gar mnan pa/ klu'i dbang po rgyal ba ral ba'i cod pan la bcings shing*/

rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings te gnas pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa/ phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i phreng ba 'chang ba/ spyi bor thod pa lnga'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥhi/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar haṃ/ gtsug gtor du k+ṣaḥ de nas spro zhing nus na/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun sngags dbang du blang zhing*/ rgyan bkod rnams kyang rgyas par bya/ bsdu na/ oṃ a i ṛ u l̥ pañtsa dhā tu bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na ma/ zhes pa la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ khro bo'i dbang po kun gyi gtso/ /dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i rigs sngags ci nus su bzla zhing de dag mi shes pa'am/ mi nus na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥbadz+ra be ga hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus su bzla/ oṃ hūṃ kro dha in dro3haṃ/ kro dha naṃ/ a dzñā dā ya ka swāhā/ zhes pa'ang khro bo rnams bskul ba'i don du bzla zhing*/ oṃ a ra ra ra ra/ la la la la/ badz+ra a be sha ya hūṃ zhes pa'ang ye shes dbab pa'i don du bzla'o/ /bzla tshul gzhan yang*/ oṃ hwe phaṭa/

ces 'bum gyis bsnun pa dang*/ oṃ hūṃ/ 'bum gyis dbab pa dang*/ oṃ twai bau ṣaṭa/ 'bum gyis bsreg pa dang*/ oṃ na maḥ 'bum gyis bslang ba dang*/ oṃ swāhā/ 'bum gyis rgyas pa dang*/ oṃ beṃ wa phaṭa/ 'bum gyis mnyes par bya ba rnams thugs kyi bzlas pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra be ga swāhā/ 'bum phrag bcu gsung gi bzlas pa dang*/ gong du bshad pa'i snying po bye ba sku'i bzlas pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang ci rigs par sgom zhing*/ thun mtshams su yang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma ljang khu'i lte bar nyi zla sgra gcan mtshon byed kyi gdan dmar dkar nag gsum brtsegs pa la/ tshom bu ljang khu gcig bkod/ mchod pa bcu gnyis po 'phreng la bsgrigs pa'am/ phyogs phyogs su 'god na/ steng gi gnyis shar dang*/ 'og gi gnyis nub kyi gral la 'god/ de la shar du dri chab dang me tog lho ru spos dang mar me/ byang du zhal zas dang shing tog nub tu sgeg mo dang bzhad ma mtshon pa'i na bza' dang me long*/ steng gi sgra ma'i ting shags sogs rol mo gang rung dang*/ gar ma'i rdor dril lta bu/ 'og gi 'dod ma'i chos 'byung dang*/ glu ma mtshon byed kyi pi waṃ rnams bshams/ dbus su gtor ma zlum gtor dbal can 'god/ 'bul gtor gtso 'khor bdun pa'i zur drug pa bshams/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril cang te'u sogs tshang bar byas la/ nang mchod oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa rnams oṃ āḥhūṃ hra phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang mchod yon dang*/ dri dang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dang*/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs pa'i rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang*/ nang gi dam tshig dang*/ dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyi ngo bor gyur/

oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tits+tsha na maḥ de bzhin du/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ nai wi t+yaṃ/ ak+ṣa t+yaṃ/ lā s+yaṃ/ ha s+yaṃ/ wat+yaṃ/ nir+t+yaṃ/ gir+t+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rol mo byin 'bebs spyi dang mthun pas byin dbab/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ mchod bstod ky-i bar bdag bskyed nyid 'don pa spos pas chog pa las/ gtso bo bskyed zin pa'i mtshams/ ha hā/ yi yī/ /wū wū ll̥ ll̥̄ rnams las byung ba'i khro bo bcu dang*/ nga ngā'*/nyi nyī/ mu mū/ nl̥ nl̥̄ rnams las byung ba'i zad par bcu dang*/ gha ghā/ dzh-i dzhā+-i/ ḍh+ṝ ḍhā+-i/ bhu bhū/ rnams las byung ba'i phyogs skyong bcu dang ga gā/ dzi dzī/ / bu bū/ rnams las byung ba'i gza' bcu dang*/ kha khā/ tshi tshī/ / phu phū/ rnams las byung ba'i klu bcu dang*/ ka kā/ tsi tsī/ / pu pū/ rnams las byung ba'i 'byung po bcu rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ ces dang*/ ye shes spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sde drug bsrung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ bstod pa'i mthar/ khro bo bcu dang zad par bcu/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang gza' mchog bcu/ /klu rgyal bcu dang 'byung po bcu/ /srung ma drug cu'i tshogs la 'dud/ / ces bstod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ sngags tshan bzhi'i byin gyis brlab pa rgyas pa'am/ mi shes pa'am/ mi lcogs na/ oṃ phreṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra dha twī shwa rī ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bya bi shwa dha ni sarba dra bya ṇi bi shwa dha ya hūṃ phreṃ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes lan mang du brjod/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang*/ grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*/ /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/

/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ badz+ra bhai ra wa ya bhis ka ra ya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ uṣ+ṇi ṣa/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bighanān+ta ka nī la dan+ḍa pradzñān+ta ka ṭāk+ki rā dza ya pad+mān+ta ka a tsa la ya mān+ta ka mahā bā le bh+yaḥ zhes rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bstan/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ ā ka sha bā yu/ te dza/ u da ka pri thi bi/ sa dhi te bh+yaḥ zhes gri gug gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ prah+ma/ biṣ+ṇu ni ri t+ya/ wā yu/ yā ma/ ag+ni/ sa mu dra/ ī shwa ra/ in+d+ra/ yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ zhes ral gri'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ rā hu kā lāg+ni/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ budha maṅga la/ shu kra pṝ has pa ti/ ke tu sha ni bh+yaḥ zhes rin po che'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ dza ya bi dza ya/ pad+ma karko ṭa/ ba su ki shaṅka pa la/ ku le ka ā nan+da/ tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+me bh+yaḥ zhes pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ be ta ṭa/ bi kṛ ta mu kha/ shā kā ka su kā ra/ gṛ dha/ bya gh+ra/ ū lu ka dzaṃ bu ga / ga ru ḍa mu khe bh+yaḥ zhes 'khor lo'i phyag rgya rnams kyi so sor spyan drangs shing bzhugs su gsol la/ re re'i mtha' 'am bsdu na/ i daṃ bā ling*/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ dha dā ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā ra shrā gh+raṃ i daṃ ba ling gṛh+nan+tu/ kha dan+tu/ pi wan+tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ trib+ta/ sarba satwa naṃ/ shan+tiṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ rak+ṣaṃ a wa ra ṇa/ gup+tiṃ kur+wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra adzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes thun mong du lan gsum phul/ spro na/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ yul bdag grong bdag rnams la'ang sbyin/ 'di ni mchod gtor lhan cig tu 'bul ba'i tshul yin pas/ gtor ma'i rjes la mchod pa bcu gnyis 'bul ba med kyang chog deng sang gi lag len ltar na/ mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ badz+ra bhai ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha ḍha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes nang mchod phul/

bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa dag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi/ khyod kyis zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ / zhes lan gsum/ srid 'gro nyam ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pa'i rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ dag pa gsum gyis bdag gi dngos 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ / zhes lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin gyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi/ ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa dag ni bskyang bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum gyis rigs drug gi sdom pa bzung*/ 'bru gsum gyis slob ma la bdud rtsi sbyin/ gnas drug byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed rdo rje shugs gtso rkyang de/ sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas par mos su bcug

slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis slob ma'i lus sbyangs/ sgrub thabs bzhin slob ma gtso bor bskyed de/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnas bzhi byin rlabs/ dbang bskur bsdus pa rnams kyang sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i dpral ba nas/ klu bcu dang*/ 'byung po bcu dpag tu med pa spros nas slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /mgrin pa nas phyogs skyong dang gza' bcu spros te/ slob ma'i mgrin par thim/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /thugs ka nas zad par bcu dang khro bo bcu spros te snying gar bstim/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /lte ba nas/ khro bo rdo rje shugs nyid dpag tu med pa spros te/ lte bar thim/ ye shes kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas 'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar

sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du sogs yon phul/ dge ba bsngo/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gsos/ gong bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas phul/ bstod pa bya/ dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gtor mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtsug tor du aṃ yig la zad par 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ dpral bar i yig la phyogs skyong gi 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ mgrin par ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ snying gar ū yig la klu'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ lte bar l̥ yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ 'jug tu smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya'o/ /rab zab sgrub thabs 'di bshad bdag /kuna~X la phan phyir dga~X' bas te/ /snyinga~X nas chos brgyad khur gyis min/ /drang po~Xr brjod la rang yang mgu/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshanano// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang 'dir bdud bzhi las rgyal bar/ /'dod des drag shul bla na med/ /shin tu mchog gyur gshin rje gshed/ /sgom pa'i tshul la 'bad par byos/ /'dir gshed dmar lhan skyes sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ snying gar a las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las dbyug pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis/ bla ma dang gshin rje gshed dmar po mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ shūn+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma/ de'i steng du hūṃ las dbyug pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi can/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs zhing bzhad pa phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dbyug pa dkar po mi mgo rlon pas mtshan pa 'phyar bas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas ma he'i steng du las kyi gshin rje bsgyel nas brdzis pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon gyi do shal/ klu brgyad kyi rgyan dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum skra ser gyen du 'bar ba/ rang mtshungs kyi yum rdo rje ro langs ma/ thod skam gyi 'phreng ba can gyis 'byung ba/ bdud dang gshin rje mtha' dag rlag par mdzad cing*/ sku la 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 'khrugs pa'o/ /snying gar pad nyi la hūṃ las dbyug pa dkar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ hūṃ las yab kyi rdo rje/ a las yum gyi pad+ma/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lha mo'i lte ba'i 'og tu pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ spyi bor haṃ las byung ba'i re ga dmar po 'bab bzhin par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis gshin rje gshed rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur te rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes rang la gnyis su med par thim/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po mthar 'bru gsum gyis phul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / de nas yid kyis stong par bsdus la/ slar yang lha skur langs la/ oṃ hrīṣ+tī bi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/

zhes ci nus bzlas/ 'jug dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma yang a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ hūṃ las thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa'i gtor ma rgyas par sbyin par 'dod na/ mngon rtogs rgyas par shes par bya la/ 'dir ni gtso rkyang la 'bul ba'am/ bsdus pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tī bi kri tā na na rak+ta ya mā ri i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na ma ma bigh+nān ha ra ha ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ hrīḥṣ+tī'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gong bzhin bstod la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs su gsol ba rnams spyi dang mthun/ lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs cung zad rgyas par sgom par 'dod na/ sngar sbyar zin pa'i sgrub thabs su shes par bya'o/ /'di'i byin rlabs ni mdun du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig pa dang*/ mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig bshams/ bdag mdun dbyer med du mngon rtogs sgom/ chos skyong so so dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gcig 'bul/ bum pa gcig bcas pa/ hrīḥṣ+tī mang du bzla/ sgom rgyu ni med/ mdun bskyed rang la/ gtor ma 'bul mi dgos/ slob ma rnams la chos bshad/ maṇ+ḍal/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs gsol btab rgyun bshags rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ slob ma rnams zhal du bcug yum gyi mkha' nang du slob ma gshed mar yab yum du bskyed/ sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs nas dbang bskur/

mkha' nang nas phyir spros pa la sku'i rjes gnang bzhin ye shes pa bstim rol mo bya/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ / sogs gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs kyis bum pas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan te bum dbang ngo*/ / nang mchod byin rlabs bsdus pa cig bya/ gshin rje gshed yab yum de'i steng du gsal btab/ byang sems su zhu nas bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ hrīḥṣ+tī 'bru gsum dang bcas bzlas kyin slob ma la sbyin te/ gsang dbang ngo*/ /yang slob ma lha sku gsal dwangs bdud rtsi'i ro myong ba brjod bral la cung zad mnyam par bzhag shes rab ye shes so/ /spros med ltar sems 'dzin med du bzhag tu bcug skye med du ngo sprad/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ / bzlas lung dam bca' ba'i lung*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / sogs byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung bya/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ / sogs ral gri'i rjes gnang*/ e ma ho bsod pa 'di ni bzang*/ sogs kyis gri gug dang thod pa sbyin/ mngon spyod kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /slob ma gshed dmar du bsgom pa'i lag tu dbyug pa dang tho ba gtad/ gshin rje gshed po'i phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ka pā la/ / dpa' bos yang dag bzung bar bgyi/ / zhes pas gtad/ mdun bskyed slob ma la thim par mos/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs rol chen bya/ mchod pa dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ rjes chog spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gshed skor kuna~X las zab pa'i phul/ /lhan skyes sgrub thabs ches dga~X' ba/ / gzhung dang man ngag la brtan nas/ /rang gis sbyar ba'i snyinga~X po~X'o/ /zhes pa gshed dmar lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bstan pa'i le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs 'di zhugs na/ /drag shul spyod pa mtha' dag ni/ /skad cig gcig gis 'grub 'gyur zhes/ /dus gzhan zhig na bla ma gsung*/ /saṃ bu ṭi nas bshad pa'i 'jigs byed bsdus pa sgom par 'dod pas/

skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang nas/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig tsam gyis bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal ma he'i gdong mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ steng zhal 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal ser po'o/ / phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gtun shing dang*/ ral gri dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ cang te'u 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa dang*/ mda' gzhu dang*/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyang dang gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi mnan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ mgo bo'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug la sogs pa rgyan rnams rdzogs pa/ ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa 'gyed pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna bar dz+riṃ/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gaṃ dpral bar skaṃ/ lte bar saṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rdo rje 'jigs byed mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes rang la dbang bskur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi mdun du raṃ las rdo rje srin po ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa khyi'i gdong can/ de'i g.yas su ya las gshin rje nag po be con thogs pa/ g.yon du ma las dus mtshan ma nag mo rtse gsum 'dzin pa rnams bka' nyan gyi tshul du bsgom la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la myang*/ hūṃ/ dur khrod rgyan gyis sogs kyis bstod/ snying gar rgyu'i 'jam dpal dang*/ ting 'dzin sems dpa' bsgom/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ yi ge bcu pa gtso bo gyur pa'i sngags gsum ka'ang bzla'o/

khyad par oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa bhak+ṣa sa/ i ti phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa/ bh+yoḥkhā la rā tri bh+yoḥ zhes pa rnams kyang ci 'grub bzla/ gtso bo'i sngags hrīḥṣ+tī 'i yi ge bcu bzhi pa bzla bar yang rgyud nas gsungs so/ / 'khor ma gshin gnyis bsgom pa ni/ rgyud na mi gsal yang bla ma'i man ngag yin no/ /rgyud kyi dngos bstan ltar na/ 'khor rdo rje srin po gcig pu'o/ /'jug tu dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni gshed dmar lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bzhin te/ 'khor rnams la rang sngags kyis dbul bar bya'o/ /'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ stegs bu yangs pa la rdul tshon nag po chos 'byung mthing ga bri zhing*/ me ris bskor/ phyi rol zlum skor yang rdo rwa dang me ris bskor zhing*/ gru bcad kha dog dmar pos bya/ dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu nag po lnga dgod/ steng du mañdzi lnga tshom la/ dbus su thod pa dam rdzas dang bcas pa'i dkyil du 'khrul 'khor dang*/ ral gri gtsugs/ phyogs bzhir dmar gtor re 'god/ mdun du 'bul gtor gnyis/ phyi mchod nang mchod/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang*/ sha chen gyi bdug spos/ sha rus kyi zhal zas rnams khyad par du bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed lha bzhi gong bzhin byas la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub zhig bya'o/ /mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ tshom bu dang dam rdzas rnams gnyis su med par dmigs la/ gong bzhin gtso bo bskyed pa'i rjes su/ rang gi mdun du nas/ rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu hūṃ las nag po chen po srin po'i gzugs can/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhes bskyed/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar gong dang 'dra ba las/ 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren pa dang*/ gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa ni khyad par ro/ / phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams byas la/
