bzlas pa cung zad bya/ yi dam gyi gtor ma phul la/ de'i lhag ma rdo rje srin po sogs 'khor gsum la rang sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pas phul/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ mahā kā la rū pa sha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa la/ shā sa na btags la/ nag po chen po la 'bul zhing*/ de'i lhag phyogs skyong bcu la 'bul/ thams cad la spyi mthun du/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab/ rdza'i bum pa zhig khrag dang chang bsres pa'i spos chus bkang*/ nag por byug kha rgyan mi dgos/ thod pa chang gis bkang ba'i kha bcad/ de'i dbus su lha lnga po skad cig gis gsal btab nas sngags brgya brgya bzla'o/ / ka pā la'i myos byed so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ rdo rje phreng ba zhig la gtso bo'i sngags lan brgya bzla zhing*/ hūṃ las byung ba rgyal ba mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid du mos/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'ang brgya brgya bzla'o/ / de nas slob ma rnams la bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ khrus rnams sngon du song nas/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas chos bshad bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu sogs kyis dam la bzhag dkyil chog las 'byung ba ltar ye shes dbab pa bya/ lha ngo bstan/ e ma ho sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi mchog /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob ma gtso bor bskyed/ snying gar gtso bo dang*/ lte bar 'jig rten pa bzhi bsgom/ re re bzhin bzlas lung phog re re bzhin sngags bzlas pa'i bum pa'i chus dbang lan lnga bskur/ gtso bo'i dam rdzas dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi gtor dbang yang rim pa bzhin du bya/ rdo rje 'phreng ba la me tog sna tshogs bcings te/ slob ma'i mgo bor dbang bskur te/ u dum wa ra man+da ra/ /

zhes sogs brjod/ thod pa'i dbus kyi ral gri lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ / sogs rdor dril gtad la/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag / sogs/ bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod sbyin la/ btung ba rin chen sogs brjod/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo lag tu gtad la/ e ma ho gsod pa 'di ni bzang*/ / sogs brjod do/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho gas tshogs btang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba'ang gzhan gyis 'gre'o/ /kuna~X la yongs su ma grags kyang*/ /rgyud don shes pa rnams dga~X' ba/ /mkhas pa'i snyinga~X la zhen pa ltar/ /gsal po~Xr bkod pa 'di nyid do/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs bstan pa'i le tshan no/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnams kyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje zla bar rab chags kun rtog rab spangs phyogs kyi gos can ma/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug mchog tu sbyor bas khro zhing 'dod chags nyams brgya'i ros sgeg

ma/ /bde chen myos byed zlos gar bsgyur mkhas he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i nā ṭa kā /bde gshegs kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal btud nas dpal mo de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di yi bsnyen pa tsam la yang*/ /man ngag gzhan las rtogs bya'i phyir/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i/ /lag len mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /gnas dus bzang por maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung nyis brtsegs rdul tshon gyis bris la/ der mañdzi la ka pā la chang la bdud rtsi sbyar bas bkang*/ me long la sin+dhu ra bkram/ gser gyi thur mas chos 'byung sogs rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'khor ltar 'bri/ steng nas dar dmar pos bkab/ nang gi gtor ma gnyis dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa rnams g.yon bskor du bsham/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ rol mo dang rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod gos zung sogs sgrub mchod kyi yo byad dang*/ bum pa/ dung chos/ zungs thag chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga ste bum sgrub la dgos pa dang*/ mig dar/ me tog ting lo/ maṇ+ḍal/ 'bru nas sogs slob ma la dgos pa rnams tshang bar byas la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas bde mchog ltar btang la mtshams bcad/ de nas bsrung ba ni/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba dang*/ oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gnyis brjod/ se gol phyogs bcur brdab pa'i tsham ngam lag len bzhin byas la/ bsrung 'khor du gyur par mos pa ni gnas bsrung ba'o/ /nang mchod sum bha ni sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung dang*/

raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ a la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ 'dir lag pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi rol mchod pa spro na byas kyang legs mod/ cho ga'i rim pa la mi dgos so/ /de nas spro na zhu 'bul dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams kyang bde mchog gi cho ga bzhin bya/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog ste/ skyabs 'gro ni bla ma bsgom par 'dus/ sems bskyed tshad med du 'dus/ yig brgya mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'i yan lag rang ma yin pas so/ /de nas bdud rtsi myangs la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ tshad med ni/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o/ / lan gsum bya/ de nas bla ma sgom pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyun drug gis brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar e e yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su/

zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po/ de'i mthar g.yon bskor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇā nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas/ rang gi lus thams cad gang bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i skad cig las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gam rdo rje la ḍā ma ru dpyangs pa thur du sdigs pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas gdong gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ mchan khung ngam phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la dril bu g.yer ka dang*/ 'phan lce gsum pa rnams 'phyang bzhin du bsnams pa/ khro chags 'dres pa/ bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can/ bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sgeg cing mdzes la nu 'bur rgyas shing*/ sked skabs phra ba/ klu shing gi me tog sna lngas brgyan pa'i dbu skra/ nag po sil bur grol ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ /snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i rang bzhin no/ / de nas dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa ni/

'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bskor la/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i baṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med pa thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de nas 'gro ba dag pa ni snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ ba spu'i bu ga nas byung*/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ yang 'od 'phros de rnams dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa mnyes par byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsam/ de nas dang por ngag bzlas dang*/ phyi nas yid bzlas bya ste/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor ram gsang ba'am lte bar bsgoms nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /mthar bsam mi khyab ni/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum 'od kyi rnam par gyur/ tshur 'dus gzugs med khams pa thams cad rang lus stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams pa thams cad bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams pa thams cad smad kyi cha la thim/ rang yang snying ga'i zla ba la/ de sngags 'phreng la/ de yang baṃ la/ de yang thig le la/ de yang nā dar gyur/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ de la blo bzhag slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ zhes brjod/ spro na mchod bstod cung zad byas la/ mthar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab te bdag bskyed do/ /de nas mdun bskyed sum bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su/

kaṃ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba nang bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du gnas pa'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba/ drwa ba gur/ bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ e e yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum gnyis brtsegs phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi g.yon du 'khor ba/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ yig dmar po/ de'i mthar g.yon bskor du oṃ oṃ oṃ nas/ swāhā/ zhes pas bskor ba las sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes pa nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ pha ཻཾ nas yo ga shud+dho3 'i bar sngar bzhin byed/ thugs ka'i baṃ yig zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge la thim/ de nas bzlas pa byed/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes mgron spyan drangs/

sum bha ni sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā le ke gan+dhe/ nai wi t+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyas par na/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i mchod 'phreng nyid 'don pa spo/ mdor bsdu na 'di ltar bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu dmar/ /dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /me tog de ring bzhes nas su/ /'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ oṃ tsan+da ga bur dang bcas pas/ /dri zhim spos me dge ba yi/ /mthu dang ldan par bya ba 'di/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gso/ /dhu paṃ/ oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba 'di/ /ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms par byed/ /a yi mig 'byed bkra shis pa'i/ /mar me khyod kyis bzhengs su gsol/ /dī paṃ/ oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs ga bur rnam brgyan pa/ /sna tshogs yi ge hūṃ las byung*/ /dri 'di 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/ /gan+dhaṃ/ oṃ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /nai wi d+ye/ oṃ sarba nas badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa rnams dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra was+t+ra s+ya āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes gos zung dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pā ri wā ra wī ni badz+ri ni pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/

de bzhin du/ bāng se= mṛ taṅge= mu ra dze= ha s+ye= lā s+ye= grirti= nirti= puṣ+pe= dhu pe= ā lo ke= gan+dha= rū pa= ra sa= spar+she= nang mchod ni/ spro na bla ma rnams kyi mtshan gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ snying po'i oṃ gsum gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la phul nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bdud rtsi myangs/ mnyes mchod ni/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ṇī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan lnga tsam byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ de nas bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā rā hī waṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa ra dzi te trai lo kya ma te mahā bid+ya shwa ri ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba bhu ta bha ya wa hai mahā badz+riṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa ra dzi ta wa shi ka ri nai tra bh+ra ma ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma sho ṣa ni ro ṣa ni kro dha ka ra li ne hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥs+t+ra sa ni sār ni pra be de ni a pa rā dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo hā ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī mahā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas gtor ma ni/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma rnams kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa/

dpral ba nang la bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ na go ha da ku las sha lnga/ mu bi ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga rnams hūṃ bruṃ khaṃ badz+riṃ aṃ ye shes lnga'i ngo bos mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar zhu zhing khol/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdun rtsi spyan drangs te bstim pas/ gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twa ta/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan lngas dbul/ badz+ra yo gi ni ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / zhes pa nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa 'di yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor chog go / oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥphaiṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho

zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog go /bum pa'i mchod pa gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa sum bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+ruṃ las bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ e e yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa nas/ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin byed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo ga ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ shap+ta 'i bar brjod/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta nas/ a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas/ de rnyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la zhon nas song bas/ bum nang gi rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ de nas bzlas pa byed/ mthar oṃ : mu mra £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ sum+bha £© sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes pa'ang bzlas/ mchod bstod rnams gong bzhin bya'o/ / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ / dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi rje btsun ma 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ dung chos kyi chu blangs la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/

/lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes khrus byas la/ slob ma la bya ba ltar bdag 'jug rdzogs par blangs/ de nas slob ma rnams la chab btang*/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis chos bshad/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bskul/ slob mas kyang tshom bu g.yon bskor du bkod la/ 'jug pa'i chos 'khor bcas zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas/ 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces rgyun bshags lan gsum brjod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ / zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*/ / zhes lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung*/

oṃ tsak+ṣu ban dha wa rā ma na ye hūṃ/ zhes mig dar btang*/ a khaṃ wi ra hūṃ gis me tog gtad/ bum chus slob ma la gtor la sum bha ni sa bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi sbyin/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ / zhes 'dri/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / zhes rjes zlos bya/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ / zhes 'dri/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / zhes rjes zlos bya/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po bsgom du bcug nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ zhes rjes zlos byar bcug rdo rje snying gar gtugs pas brtan par byas par sgoms shig byas la/ slob ma'i snying gar rdo rjes gtugs la/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / zhes gsang bar gdams/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du mos pa 'di bzhin mdzod byas la/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i baṃ yig las 'od byung*/ khyed rang gi lte bar thim/ 'od 'dus pa las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs baṃ yig zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus thams cad gang*/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i skad cig las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang pas bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/

ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa rnams gsal btab la/ rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su ma mchis pas bdag la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas ting lo slob ma'i khar sbyin la/ mdun bskyed bcom ldam 'das ma'i thugs ka'i baṃ yig las ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnam pa mun sel gyi ting lo 'od gsal ba byung*/ khyed rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud/ lte ba'i baṃ yig dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma tshon gang bar gyur/ des bde ba chen po'i gar mdzad/ chos 'byung gi grwa bzhir yang dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi g.yon du 'khor/ smin mtshams dang gsang sgor yang dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon du 'khor/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon nas khyed rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo dam par byin gyis brlabs/ rol chen bya/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha a/ ye shes dbab pa'i rgyun de spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas brtan par mos mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra lan gnyis/ mdun bskyed rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku la me tog phul bar mos la/ me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos kyis byas la/ oṃpra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ slar yang me tog de nyid rang gi spyi bor bcings par mos shig byas la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/

/mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye ba'i thams cad mthong ba yang*/ rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriṃ traṃ/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig / ces lan gsum rjes zlos kyis gsol ba btab/ rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du/ gdugs dkar po mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyis phung po sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha sprul te dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad par mos shig byas la/ bum pa bzung*/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba/ /ha ha'i gad mos sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bdud kyi klad pa 'gems/ /bde mchog 'khor los bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ /e waṃ mnyam par sbyar ba bde ba'i sku/ /ā li kā li rol pa'i gsung mnga' zhing*/ /aṃ gi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /shes rab phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/ / zha ེ sa shis pa brjod / dbang lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ de nas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis nas/ de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ oṃ tsakra wī ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī ye/ mahā mu ku ṭa hoḥ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu rnam par snang mdza/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ba g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ba g.yon par don yon grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas brtan bzhugs su gsol ba'i mos pa gyis byas la/ rol chen dang bcas slob ma la me tog gtor la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod de nas bzlas lung ni/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i baṃ yig las sngags rnams kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i gzungs sngags la thim pas sngags nus pa mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlab par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ dam bca' ba'i lung 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su ma mchis pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/ de'i gzungs sngags nyin re la ci nus re bzla bar dam bca' lags so/ /slob dpon la me tog gtor la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzungs lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /me tog de nyid slar yang khyed rang rnam pa'i spyi bor gtor bas sngags 'phreng gi rnam pas snying gar thim ste/ rgyud byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod byas la/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bo dang snying gar gtor te/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa khyed kyi rgyud la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung rigs sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa yongs su 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod do/ / des bum dbang thob pas bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so/

/mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang ba nas thon/ ka pā la bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ de nyid lce thog tu bzhag par mos shig ces oṃ gsum ma'i mthar 'bru gsum brjod cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang mchod nas blang la slob ma la sbyin des gsang dbang thob pas/ lam rang lus la brten nas rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i thabs sgom pa la dbang ngo*/ /de nas sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las/ sin+dhu ra slob dpon gyi mtheb srin g.yon pas blangs la/ slob ma'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba rnams su byug 'bru gsum brjod/ de ltar gnas bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis lte ba'i gtur mo 'bar/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba'i dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes bskyed par mos la/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i rjes zlos kyis/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ 'khyud rgya byar bcug des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i zhu bde de nyid dper byas te/ don rang sems bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i don sgom pa ni bzhi pa'i ye shes te/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /stong pa nyid ni rnam par sgom/ /zhes pa yin pas spros bral bde stong la cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ lam de kho na nyid dngos su sgom par byed pa la dbang ba yin no/ / de nas rjes ni/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum dang*/ bka' drin gtang rag gi don du/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūṃ nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su ma mchis pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/

/thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ / zhes yon 'bul lo/ /tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba ni/ bdag 'jug gi snga phyi gnyis dang*/ skabs 'di gsum gang la byas kyang rung ba las/ dang po gnyis ltar gtso che na'ang*/ deng sang phyi ma ltar mdzad de/ lhag gtor dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dus gcig la gtong*/ de nas rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ oṃ sum+bha na ིsa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ zhes pa nas/ de nyid rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar bum bskyed ltar mchod bstod rnams byed/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dam tshig nyams chags thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang 'byor ba dang*/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa tshe 'di nyid la stsal du gsol/ gal te tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i skal ba med na/ 'chi tshe mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/

zhes 'dod don zhu/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs he ru ka 'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa dang*/ yo byad ma tshang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad lhag chad kha bskang zhing*/ bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par zhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rten sku 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa ma byung gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyer dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ khyod kyis sems can don kun sogs sin+dhu ra'i ye shes pa gshegs/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ moṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ sum bha ni/ lan gnyis kyi tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba byed do/ /de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod nas/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/

dran rig rnam rtog thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul du rnam par dag pa yin no/ / de nas smon lam ni/ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*/ /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus brtan/ /rdo rje phag mo'i dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang*/ /zab cing rgya che chos don rtogs pa dang*/ /go ku shu kra la sogs rtags bzang zhing*/ /mthar thug bde chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /bde gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi/ /dam bca' bsrung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol bar/ /thugs dam bcas shing rtag bsrung dngos grub ni/ /rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog / de nas bkra shis ni/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ sogs kyi mthar/ spro na/ bkra shis gang zhing chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+mor rdo rje rol par mdzad/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar/ /sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed gdan la bde bar bzhugs/ /rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /bden pa des kyang = bkra shis gang zhig gsang chen zab mo'i don ston pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro grangs med gsung gi snying po sum cu gnyis/ /sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'du can/ /bden pa des kyang = bkra shis gang zhig 'gyur med lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings/ khams gsum kun la bde ba chen pos khyab pa'i thugs/ /tshad med yon tan 'phrin las sogs kyi nyer 'bar ma/ /bden pa des kyang =

bkra shis gang zhig zhing skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs 'joms zhi rgyas dbang gi las mdzad cing*/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rgya chen rtag tu brtan gyur pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog / dus rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gong du bstan pa rnams dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba ste rnal 'byor bcu gcig gis chog go /byin rlabs kyi cho ga rnying ma yig rnying dang*/ man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ kun gyis rtsa bar rab grags pa/ /lhan cig skyes dga' thob pa'i thabs/ /snyinga~X po~X'i yi ge bla na med/ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge legs 'phel/ ༄༅ /oṃ swā sti/ ye shes bskal pa'i me yi gzi 'od 'bar/ /sgeg 'char du mas rnam brgyan mtshar sdug sku/ /mi phyed sngags kyi de nyid legs 'char ba/ /rdo rje btsun mos bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /dpag yas sgrub pa'i thabs tshul rgya mtsho las/ /nam mkha'i nor bu dang mtshungs snying po ni/ /o rgyan las byung gsang ba'i man ngag ste/ /bden gnyis zhal can sgrub pa'i thabs 'di brtsams/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs nas/ 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i rnal 'byor bas tshul 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ /de la stong pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ gdong nub tu phyogs bzhin pas 'di skad ces bya ste/ bdag nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid chos kyi dbyings chos kyi 'byung gnas o ḍi ya na rdo rje'i gnas su gyur/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma he ru ka dang gnyis su med pa 'dzum bag dang bcas shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ skyabs gnas thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/

/bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyang steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai we te/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ thal mo snying gar sbyor bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /theg chen bdud rtsi rab bshad par/ /'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs/ /ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol bar 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed bgyid nas/ / sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas pa skabs 'dir byas kyang rung la/ bsdu na/ stong pa'i ngang las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis mdun nas brtsams te chos 'byung g.yon bskor du bri tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod/ mthe bong gi rtser oṃ/ mthe chung gi rtser āḥ 'khrig ma'i ngos la hūṃ/ lam mthil du baṃ/

de nyid kyi gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar/ chos 'byung gi nang du yi ge bzhi 'khod par gyur pa las/ 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rnam pa can sbyor mtshams nas spyan drangs la/ thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi la thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs la/ g.yon pa'i mthe chung nas mthe bo'i bar sor mo lnga dang*/ thams cad 'dus pa'i sen mo'i ngos la bdud rtsi'i thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ baṃ nas/ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar brjod/ yi ge 'bru gsum brjod cing*/ de rnams la bdud rtsi gtor/ yang 'bru gsum brjod cing lus thams cad la byugs pas/ go cha drug po rang lus la thim par bsam/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gnas dang*/ rdzas la phyogs kun tu gtor/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ hriḥgha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣ+taṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ bgegs thams cad bskrad/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de nas sgo gsum sbyangs zhing*/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid kyi don dran bzhin pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa ba phra zhing gdengs ka rgyas pa'i steng rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba/

de'i nang du ngag sngags kyi yig 'bru dang*/ sems lha sku'i rnam par gyur pa ni/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar mi ro ser po mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i snying gar oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du baṃ dmar po las 'od 'phros/ sa gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad bsdus shing thim pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing yid tsam smug pa nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i gzi brjid can/ rtsal zhal lha mo'i rnam pa 'dzum khro chags pa'i nyams can mche ba gtsigs shing bzhad pa/ g.yas zhal phag gdong khro zhing gyen du phyogs pas gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po gyen du bsgreng pa/ dbu skra nag po cung zad li ba sil bur grol zhing thur du 'phyang ba/ dmar zhing bkra la zlum por g.yo ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i thod skam lnga'i 'phreng ba can/ sgyu ma'i sbrel ba'i khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu ste mi rus kyi phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab cing*/ nu ma rgyas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa ma lus pa'i sprul pa 'chang ba'i sku can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na sgeg cing rol ba'o/ /lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ dmar po de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor bar spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor bzhin pas/ phaiṃ zhes brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ slar yang baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod thogs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhug pa la/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ rang sngags gsung bzhin pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la thim/ de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ ngag tu ma brjod kyang rung mod kyi/ de ni 'di ltar dran dgos so/ / pad+ma'i gdan ni nyon mongs pa'i ma gos pa'o/ /mi ro'i gdan ni rtogs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid do/ /nyi ma ni bde ba chen po'i snang ba rgyas pa'o/ /sku mdog dmar mo ni thugs rjes sems can la chags pa'o/ /zhabs gnyis ni bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'o/ /gri gug ni dug gsum gcod pa'o/ /thod pa ni bde ba skyong pa'o/ /thod skam lnga ni rigs lnga'o/ /mgo rlon gyi 'phreng ba ni yi ge lnga bcu dag pa'o/ /phyag rgya lnga ni pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyang ba ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /skra grol ba ni mtshan mas ma bcings pa'o/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni thabs dang ma bral ba'o/ /sku gcig pu ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gcer bu ni sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /me dpung 'bar ba ni ye shes kyi snang ba spro ba'o/ / zhes so/ / lte ba'i baṃ yig las sgo mtshams ma brgyad sku mdog ljang sngon cang te'u dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa/

mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spros te/ mchod pa dang bstod pa'i las mdzad par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ / 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ / rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas shing*/ /yid la med cing dran pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ / rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ / zhes pas sam rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ lha mo rnams lte ba'i baṃ la thim/ yi ge 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi lan gsum myangs/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung yi ge bzhi dang bcas pa/ rtsa sngags 'phreng gsum mam/ mdun du bkod la/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa bcas te/

oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra waṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ngag bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas dang*/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa rnams ci rigs par bya'o/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ lha sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu la cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/ suṃ bha 'i sngags kyis bsrung ba byas la dge ba bsngos te 'jug go /thun mtshams su yi ge brgya pa bzla ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ phyag dang*/ skor ba dang*/ sāts+tsha gdab pa la sogs pa bya zhing*/ kha zas dang*/ spyod lam dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor rnams la yang nan tan du bya'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ kha zas bzang dgu las byas pa'i gtor ma sha khrag myos byed kyi rgyu la sogs pas brgyan pa'i mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ gtor ma gcig tu bsdus kyang rung la/ gnyis su byed na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis/ gsum du byed na/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma dang gsum mo/ /gang ltar yang rung ste/ suṃ bha ni sa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa de'i shar du go las ba lang gi sha bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu da las rta'i sha dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ lho ru ku las khyi'i sha aṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su na las mi'i sha hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor baṃ las dri chen laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu raṃ las rak+ta maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du ma las rkang mar paṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang shar du mu las dri chu taṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su shu las byang sems baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo thur du blta ba'i steng du baṃ dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang sems kyi rnam par spyan drangs ste baṃ la thim/

baṃ yig kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa zhu nas rdzas la thim/ rlung gi me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas mang por spel bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum du brjod nas/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel na spyan 'dren mi dgos/ ma 'brel na dgos pas/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas phaiṃ/ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ i daṃ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis ye shes mkha' 'gro la 'bul/ oṃ hriṃ haṃ haṃ he he ha ha hi hi phaiṃ phaiṃ zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pas las kyi mkha' 'gro dang*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsa/ uṣ+man+ta a paṣ+ma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ yang thai ṭaṃ/ bhañdza tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi gha tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sud+su khaṃ bi shud+dha sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ lha yi'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ / sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshigs tshad ma dang*/ / sogs dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya ste/ phal cher nā ro mkha' spyod dang mthun par shes par bya'o/ /'di'i byin rlabs bya bar 'dod na/ yar ngo dang mar ngo'i tshes bcu gang rung la bya ste/

stegs bu'i steng du maṇ+ḍal pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad lte bar chos 'byung dmar po gru bcad ljang khu/ phyi dur khrod dang rdo ra me ris bskor bar bya/ dur khrod ma bris kyang 'gal ba med/ shin tu bsdu na rdo ra dang me ri'ang bor ro/ /de'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bzhag de'i steng du me long la chang gis brlan cing sin+dhu ra snyoms par bkram/ gser gyi snyu gu lag pa g.yon pa mtheb srin gyis bzung la/ chos 'byung gru gsum nang du rtsa sngags 'phreng gsum mam bdun ma dang phyogs bzhir dga' 'khyil re dang bcas pa bri/ steng nas dar dmar po'i gur khang phub ste/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor mi mthong bar bya/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma lnga bshams/ nang mchod/ cang te'u/ rdo rje dril bu/ bsrung skud/ mig dar/ me tog sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams dang*/ khyad par bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin btang*/ mchod pa byin dbab kyang bla med spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par byas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor/ sum bha sa bsangs/ dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma'i lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus su/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi nas/ bskor ba'i dbus su/ mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng*/ a las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ baṃ rnams gnas pa'i 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par spyan drangs la/ bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes rnam pa lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ de'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la zhes pa nas/ rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ dag sngags kyi yig 'bru dang*/ sems lha sku'i rnam par gyur pa ni zhes pa bor/

dbang gi lha thams cad kyang mdun bskyed la thim/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i 'bar dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la bzlas pa bya/ slar yang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba bzla zhing*/ 'thor ba'am/ bzed zhal du 'bul ba lan brgya rtsa sogs ci rigs pa byed pa ni/ khyad par gyi mchod pa bdud rtsi 'bul ba zhes bya ba yin la/ mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa rnams nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra dang bcas pa'am/ med na cang te'u 'khrol bzhin du/ rkang pa brgyad pas thog drangs nas bstod pa ci shes pas bstod par bya'o/ /gtor ma gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ gtor ma dang po gnyis gong bzhin 'bul ba las/ ye shes mkha' 'gro yi dam gyi tshogs la thun mong du 'bul na/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis 'bul/ gtor ma gsum pa nag po chen po dang phyogs skyong sogs la 'bul/ bzhi pa gzhi bdag dang*/ lnga pa rigs drug dang*/ bgegs la kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis sbyin/ gtor ma phyi ma gsum po bsngos tshar rim gyis 'phral du gtong*/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du mi ro'i snying gar gnas pa'i nyi ma'i gdan de'i steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes pa nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo rnams su gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba phreng ma chad par spros/ bum bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/

bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod dang bstod pa bsdus pa tsam bya/ bum pa'i lha bzhu ba dang/ gshegs su gsol ba sogs mi dgos/ bar 'dir tshogs mchod bya/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'ang btang*/ slob ma la ji ltar bya ba ltar bdag 'jug blangs/ dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu dang chos bshad bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bgegs gtor slob ma la phyi bskor la/ sarba bigh+nān bh+yaḥ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos/ bden pa bdar zhing/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor la bgegs bskrad/ suṃ bha drag tu bzla'o/ / slob dpon rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba'i baṃ las me 'od byung*/ dbu ma nas brgyud/ srin lag g.yon gyi rtse nas thon/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ srog rtsa'i nang gang bas/ nang gis bgegs dang dri ma thams cad bsal zhing sbyangs par gyur/ srin lag slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+tā kṛta hūṃ/ zhes bdun bdun brjod cing*/ spyi bor phus btab/ tshangs bug rdo rje rgya gram gyis bkag par gyur/ slob ma rnams kyi gnas rnams su nas/ ngo bo rnams su gyur/ oṃ baṃ nas/ phaṭa phaṭa gyi bar brjod cing*/ gnas de rnams su rdo rje rgya gram reg de nas 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod blud do/ /de nas rgyun bshags dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa byed par spro na yi ge rnying pa rnams su shes par bya'o/ /bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs lan gsum gyis chog go / ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta 'i bar gyis slob ma sems bskyed pa la mchod/ oṃ hṝ bi shud+dha dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa as+ya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes khyor chu sbyin/ sdom bzung gi don du slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma'i sku la skyabs su mchi/ / gsung dang thugs la'ang des 'gre/ sangs rgyas grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ / rnal 'byor ma mchog 'khor lo yi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par mdzod/ / lan gsum/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ / nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god kyi bar lan gsum gyi rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung gi bar bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom bzung bya/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa rā ma na ye hūṃ gis mig dar/ a khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gis me tog bzung*/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bkod la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i nang mchod kyis thig le bya/ zla ba rdo rje'i dmigs pa phog la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi/ brjod du bcug snying gar rdo rje gtugs te/ su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ zhes brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor du bcug par mos la/ yol ba bsal/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod dpal he ru ka dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyis mdun du smra bar ma byed cig smras na dam tshig nyams pa gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ snying gar gtugs te/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ yang spyi bor bzhag la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nas 'gyur ta re/ 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi blud la/

'di ni khyod kyis nas u da ka ṭha ṭha hūṃ/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob ma skyil krung bcas shing rlung bzung du bcug slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bla ma he ru ka'i rnam pa can/ lte bar chos 'byung gi nang du rdo rje phag mo mar me ltar 'bar ba mtshon gang ba gar bsgyur ba zhig bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i baṃ las 'od 'phros/ slob ma'i lte bar gnas pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phog pas/ ye shes kyi me lce'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros shing 'bar te/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang bas/ sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg par mos mdzod/ ces brjod la rol mo'i sgra bya zhing*/ rdul gyi ras dang*/ byi la nag po'i brun dang*/ gu gul sbyar ba'i dud pas bdug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī dzñā na a be sha ya a hrī hrī swāhā/ gnyis pa spog pa'i cho ga ni/ slob ma rnams langs te rkang pa gnyis gshibs brang ba la brjid bskur/ lag pa thal mo sbyar brkyang*/ sna rtse nas sor brgyad gzhal pa'i bar snang la/ g.yung drung ris dkar po me stag 'bar ba gcig bsams la/ rlung phyir song bas g.yung drung ris la phog /g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor ba la shes pa gtad la/ rlung phyir thub tshad zungs shig slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ slob ma'i spyi bor byon/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun chu rgyun ltar babs pas/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde mer re re 'dug pa la sems gtod cig / rtsa sngags kyi mthar pheṃ pheṃ hri hri zhes btags te/ lan brgya rtsa la sogs pas dbab par bya'o/ /gal te ye shes phebs na/ de'i nyams myong skyong du bcug la/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos sogs kyis ngo sprod pa yin la/ ma phebs na de brjod mi dgos so/

/de nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par byin gyis brlabs/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyis/ /lha'i rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /ces slob dpon gyis lha la gsol ba btab la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes slob ma me tog 'bul du bcug pra tī gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa mahā bā la/ zhes pas me tog slob ma'i mgo bor bcings/ mig 'bras gnyis oṃ 'od du 'bar bar gyur/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi nas/ bla na med/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes pas mig dar phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skyes/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rig skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum dngos grub kun/ khyod la myur du mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /gsang sngags sgrub la brtson par gyis/ / zhes blta bar bskul/

dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa bstan la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi chos 'byung ni dus gsum gyi chos nyid/ bdud rtsi'i nang gi chos 'byung ni khams gsum gyi de bzhin nyid/ me long gi chos 'byung ni sku gsum gyi ye shes mtshon no/ /g.yung drung ris ni chos nyid mi 'gyur ba/ bzhi ni dga' ba bzhi/ yig 'bru rnams su sku gsung thugs gcig tu 'dus pa/ zur gsum ni rnam thar gsum/ nang stong pa nyid spros bral/ dmar ba ni snying rje/ rtsa ba phra ba ni nyon mongs spangs pa/ gdengs mche ba ni ye shes dang*/ yon tan rgyas pa mtshon no/ / zhes pa tsam mam rgyas par spro na'ang rgyas par brjod/ slob dpon rdo rje phag mor bsgoms la mos gus dung ba byos shig ces dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i rnam pa mngon rtogs ltar bshad la/ phag zhal don dam rtog med mtshon/ gri gug shes rab stong nyid/ thod pa thabs bde chen/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ snying rje myang 'das la mi gnas pa/ g.yas bskum pa shes pas 'khor ba la mi gnas pa ste/ mdor na thams cad kyang zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid yin no/ / zhes bshad de/ dkyil 'khor dang bla ma dang*/ lha'i de kho na nyid bstan pa'o/ /de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ / sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha dbyer ma mchis pas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar mos shig dbang bskur rdo rje chen po nas/ sbyin par bya/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod la bum pa spyi bor bzhag bum chu blud/ bum pa'i lha slob ma la thim par gyur/ ye shes kyi chus slob ma'i lus thams cad gang*/ spyi bor lud pa las rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ rat+na mu ka ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/

zhes brjod cing*/ dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa bcing ngo*/ /bum dbang ngo*/ /yang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /ngag gi dri ma sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ / zhes gsol gsum gdab/ me long gi 'og gi thod pa nas bdud rtsi blangs la/ oṃ gsum ma bzlas bzhin du slob ma la sbyin/ de ltar bdud rtsi myangs pas rtsa thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ dug gsum gyi rnam rtog 'gags/ bde ba'i ye shes skyes par mos shig ces brjod de gsang dbang ngo*/ /yang maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje la/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bstan pa ltar/ dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ zhes gsol gsum gdab/ sin+dhu ra'i yig 'bru'am/ dga' 'khyil las slob dpon gyi srin lag gis blangs nas/ slob ma'i lte bar byugs pas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa las ye shes pa gnyis pa zhig rgyang gis chad de/ slob ma'i lte ba'i baṃ la thim pas de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur khrong gis gyur par bsam/ da phyin chad phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can gyi yi dam lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgom pa dang ma 'bral bar gyis shig ces brjod la spyi bor byugs shing*/ spyi bor rdo rje slob dpon bsgom pa dang ma bral bar gyis shig ces dang*/ dpral mgrin snying ga gsum du reg la/ lus ngag yid gsum bde stong zung 'jug tu sgoms shig ces brjod/ de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ / yig rnying phal che ba na 'og nas 'byung ba'i rjes gnang drug gi dbang bzhi pa'i dod thub par bzhed kyang*/ 'ga' zhig las bzhi pa logs su byed pa nyid legs pas/ yang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bdag la bka' drin skyob tu gsol/

/ zhes gsol gsum gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod de/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos/ /sems nyid cir yang grub pa med/ /grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la/ /sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che/ /snang tsam nyid kyang sems su 'dug /snang ba sems kyi de nyid ni/ /bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin/ /rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab/ /gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*/ /mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ /thabs rnams sna tshogs kun tu ston/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang thob/ /'di ni rje btsun byin rlabs te/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du/ /skal ldan rnams kyis spyod yul yin/ / ces brjod cing de'i don bshad/ tshig 'di ni grub thob brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun yin gyi/ rgyud tshig min pas mtha' gcig tu 'di kho na brjod dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ dbang bzhi pa'i don ston pa'i rdo rje'i tshig gang yang rung ba zhig brjod na'ang legs pa yin no/ /de ltar na dbang bzhi pa'o/ /des byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi song nas/ rjes la rjes su gnang ba drug las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ rtse lnga pas dbu rgyan gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin dmigs pa phog des lha bsgoms pa'i lung thob pa yin pas thun bzhir sgoms shig gnyis pa gsung bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar chos 'byung sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa dang*/ slob ma'i snying gar chos 'byung tsam gsal btab la/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las sngags 'phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i chos 'byung du spar btab pa bzhin byung bar mos la/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ bcom ldan bdag la rtsal lags te/ / sogs lan gsum/ me tog 'thor bzhin du/

rjes zlos byas pa la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ / sogs brjod cing*/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog gtor/ deng phyin sngags bzlas pa la brtson par gyis shig gsum pa lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ slob mas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod pa sna lnga sngags dang phyag rgyas 'bul du bcug la/ bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi gnas/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ / bdag nyid rnal 'byor ma dpal mchod/ /deng phyin chad lha dang bla ma mchod pa la brtson par gyis shig bzhi pa spyod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga spyod do/ /deng khyod kyi las dang po pa'i spyod pa dang*/ brtan pa thob pa'i spyod pa dang*/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rnams so so'i dus dang 'tshams par ma 'khrul pa'i spyod pa gyis shig lnga pa chos bshad pa la sogs pa gzhan don gyi rjes gnang ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bcas shing*/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ /deng phyin chad rang gi nus pa dang 'tshams par skal bar ldan pa gzhan dag la 'gro ba'i don ci nus par sgrubs shig drug pa bsrung ba'i rjes gnang ni/ gong bzhin slob ma'i lus la go cha bkod nas/ rdo rjes reg par bya/ go cha'i sngags brjod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ sum+bha/ tshar gcig brjod/ man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yod na gdags shing med na bsrung skud dmar po g.yon par spyi dang mthun par bcings/ bsrung ba'i sngags bzla zhing*/ bsrung bar bya'o/ /'di'i gzhan don rjes gnang gi skabs su 'khor lo dung po ti rnams gtad cing*/ chos bshad kyi rjes gnang spyi dang mthun pa ltar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pas spro na de ltar bya'o/

/de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ / sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ / sogs bya ste/ spyi dang mthun no/ /gong du tshogs mchod ma btang na/ skabs 'dir btang ngo*/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa kha gsos/ byin gyis rlabs/ mchod bstod gsol btab yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol/ bdag bsrung tsham rngam smon lam bkra shis rnams bya ste/ rje btsun ma'i chos skor spyi dang mthun pa yin no/ /de'i mchod 'phreng la sogs pa rgyas pa spro na dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga bzhin bya'o/ /de ltar na zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa legs par bshad zin to/ / dbu bcad ma dang don grub kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga la/ 'di na mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ dbu bcad ma la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma bri/ me long la lha mo gsum gyi sngags brtsegs nas 'bri ba dang*/ lhag ma lha sngags sa bon sogs kyi skabs so so'i mngon rtogs bzhin 'don pa bsgyur ba'i chog lha'i de nyid bstan pa'i skabs/ dbu bcad ma'i rtsa gsum bcad de dug gsum bcad pa mtshon/ lha gsum ni sku gsum mtshon pa yin no/ / zhes brjod/ don grub ma la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi bri/ me long la chos 'byung gi dbus su sngags gcig pu dang dga' 'khyil gyi tshab la sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ mdun bskyed dang*/ byin rlabs kyi skabs 'don pa spo/ khyad par dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid bstan pa'i skabs/ rdo rje rgya gram bzhi ni 'phrin las rnam par bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa mtshon zhes pa dang*/ lha'i de nyid kyi skabs/ phag zhal ni/ rtog med de bzhin nyid du chos thams cad ro gcig pa dang*/ phyag bzhi las bzhi sgrub cing*/ sku bzhi 'grub par mtshon zhes 'don pa spo/ bla ma dpyal pa rnams kyi phyag len la/ zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs ma thob pa la dbu bcad ma dang*/

don grub ma'i byin rlabs mi mdzad mod/ bla med kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob phyin chad/ zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs sngon du ma song kyang*/ de dag byin du rung ba kho na'o/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor la/ grub thob kyi gzhung gi khungs dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i legs bshad dang*/ byin rlabs kyi bka' ma nyams pa dang*/ rdzogs rim dang*/ las tshogs su 'dzoms pa sogs sgo thams cad nas/ gzhal na 'di nyid kho na bzang ba yin no/ /dbu bcad ma dang*/ don grub ma'i sgrub thabs ni logs su shes par bya'o/ /mchog gyur sgrub thabs mchog 'di bshad pa las/ /mkha' spyod chen po mkha' khams chos kyi dbyings/ /bde chen dkyil 'khor bde ba'i lam gyis thob/ /bla med byang chub bla ma'i drin thob shog /kuna~X las ngo mtshar che bas chos/ /lhan cig skyes dga~X' 'byung gnas 'di/ /snyinga~X po~X don gnyer bdag 'dras blangs/ /skal bzang yod na da dung long*/ /phag mo zhal gnyis ma dpyal lugs su grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /na mo bid+ya dha ra bi ki li badz+ra yo gī ni maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas bzhengs glog 'phreng gi /ri bong 'dzin bzhu bde ba rgyas gang ma/ /yid 'od 'di yi rnam par brtsen gyur pa/ /nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'dis bsrung*/ /rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma zhes bya ba rdo rje phag mo sgrub par 'dod pas/ gdong nub tu phyogs pa'i mdun du nang mchod bshams/ thun mong du byed na/ thun tha ma ma gtogs pa la gtor ma yid kyis phul bas chog thun tha ma dang thun gcig kho na byed pa'i tshe/ las dang po pa'i ga nas skabs su gtor ma dngos su gshoms pa gal che zhing*/ gang ltar yang bzlas pa'i mthar gtor chog re nges par byed dgos so/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur/ srin lag g.yon pas nang mchod la chos 'byung gru gsum 'bri tshul du byed cing*/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dbus su baṃ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ g.yas pa'i srin lag gis g.yon pa'i lag mthil dang*/ mthe chung la sogs pa'i so so'i rtse mor bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ lag pa phan tshun mnyam zhing yig 'bru rnams rang gnas su 'od du zhu zhing thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bdud rtsi myang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes gnas gsum du thig le bya/ de nas stong par sbyang ba ni gong bu bsdu ba dang*/ rjes su zhig pa gang rung las dang po ltar na/ rang lus sum cu rtsa drug khams kyi tshogs/ /mig rna sna lce lus te dbang po lnga/ /ngag dang rkang lag bshang gci las dbang lnga/ /rang bzhin dag kyang de ltar ma gtogs pa'i/ /ma lus 'gro drug sems can tshogs/ las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal gyi/ /'khor lo bskor ba 'di dag ni/ /nges par byang chub la gzhug bya/ /snying ga'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud 'od du zhu/ /rang lus la thim/ rang gi rkang pa gnyis ni brla gnyis la/ de lto ba la/ de sked pa la/ de yang snying ga la/ lag pa gnyis ni dpung pa la thim/ de yang snying ga la/ de mgrin pa la/ de mgo bo la thim/ de yang sems la thim/ sems nyid kyang nam mkha' la thim/ nam mkha' yang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba la thim/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ bskyed pa'am/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi nang du pad nyi la gnas pa'i baṃ yig las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ dza ba'i me tog ltar rab tu dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mche ba gtsigs shing*/ khro gnyer dang bcas pa'i gdong steng du phyogs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum steng du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol zhing thur du 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung nas zhabs g.yon pa'i sgyid khung nas 'khyud de steng du btegs nas/

bdud rtsi'i rgyun zhal du 'bab pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pas/ zhabs g.yas kyi rting pa'i phyogs su bsnun pa/ zhabs g.yas 'phur stangs su cung zad brkyang ba/ klu shing gi me tog gi 'phreng ba phyag g.yon pa na bsnams pa/ gcer bu rgyan spangs shing ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo'i bar gyis go cha bcings/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs thams cad phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ snying ga'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltam pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ bsdu na dkyus kyi nyams len la lag pa byin rlabs med kyang chog dbu rgyan rang chas su sgom/ mchod bstod kyang bor bas chog go /rdzogs rim ni/

lte bar chos 'byung zur drug pa'i nang du zla ba la baṃ yig sngags 'phreng grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa gsal btab la/ g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor bar dmigs pa dang*/ smin mtshams su dga' 'khyil rkyang pa dang*/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung kho na 'khor ba la dmigs kyang rung*/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung bas rim pa bzhin du drod dang*/ mi rtog pa dang*/ bde ba skye ba la bsngags so/ /de nas spyod yul du rgyu ba ni/ mkha' 'gro du ma'i spro bsdu dang bcas mkha' la 'phur zhing byon nas/ ma na bhaṃ ga dang*/ dpal gyi ri'i rtse mor man+dha ra wa ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang yongs 'du'i shing gis brgyan pa'i ldum ra dang*/ rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi khang pa brtsegs pa rtse mo brgyad pa phan tshun du rgyu zhing 'jug par gyur/ zhabs g.yas g.yon gyi mthil sa la brdabs pas brtan g.yo thams cad bskyod cing*/ sems cad thams cad dngul chu ltar bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ste/ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe g.yon gyi thod par bsdus/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung ba'i tshe/ sna bug g.yon nas brngubs pas lus sems zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ rlung phyir bsal ba'i tshe/ chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar yongs su shes bzhin pas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor spro bar bya'o/ /spyod pa la rgyu ba 'di dmigs pa kho nas chog kyang*/ lan cig don bsam bzhin du ngag tu brjod na/ dmigs pa'i gnad chad mi 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod la/ de rjes rlung gi gnad dang sbyor bzhin du/ ri gnyis kyi rtse mor dmigs pa phar spo tshur spo bya'o/ /gzhan yang ye shes dbab pa'i skabs nas 'byung ba'i dmigs pa rnams las gang yang rung ba zhig sgom mo/ / de nas bzlas pa ni/ thog ma'i gnas su byon par mos la/ snying gar chos 'byung dang sngags 'khor gsal btab/ 'di'i rgyud gzhung la sngags tshan gsum la oṃ re re sbyar ba yod na'ang*/

lag len dang man ngag la/ oṃ gsum ma kho na bzla bar mdzad de/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas bzhin pas/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /thun gyi mthar/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro lnga'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka mahā badz+ra a ka.a ka / pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī naṃ hri da ya yaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces las sngags kyis thugs rgyud bskul la/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā ling hūṃ oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā ling hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā ling hūṃ traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ wā ling hūṃ hriḥ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā ling hūṃ a/ zhes so sor 'bul/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā ling hūṃ hūṃ/ ha ha hi hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sarba badz+ra yo gi nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ho/ zhes re bstab pa'i sngags te/ gtor ma gcig kho na yod na/ thams cad sbrel ba lan gsum gyis 'bul/ lnga yod na/ las sngags dang mkha' 'gro re'i sngags dang*/ spyir bstab pa'i sngags gsum sbrel nas so sor lan gsum gsum 'bul/ mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra/ gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas par spro na/ nā ro mkha' spyod bzhin mdzad pa'i lugs yod na'ang*/

rgya gzhung dang yig rnying gi dgongs don bsdus pa 'di kho nar mngon no/ /cung zad dmigs pa la brtan pa thob nas ni dmigs pa kho nas gtor ma 'bul lo/ /'di'i byin rlabs kyi sgo nas slob ma rjes su bzung bar 'dod pas bris sku la sogs pa'i drung du/ maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum re kha dkar po'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du mañdzi la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i steng du me long la chos 'byung gi dbus su rje btsun ma'i sku ba rnya na me ris dang bcas pa/ ri gnyis dang*/ shing dang*/ khang bzang sogs kyang 'bri/ phyogs bzhir dga' 'khyil bzhi yang bkod/ steng nas dar dmar bo'i gur phub/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga sha khrag gi brgyan pa'i gtor ma brgyad/ ka pā la'am gang yang rung ba'i snod bcu las lnga sha dang lnga chang gis bkang*/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par bcas pa zhig gi phyogs bzhir thod gzugs sam/ dung chos bdud rtsi chus gang ba bzhi bzhag rang gi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ru/ sngon 'gro gtor ma rnams dang*/ de dag la dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang tshang bar byas la/ bde mchog gi cho ga ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs/ zhu 'bul/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams bya/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas bzlas pa'i/ bar du gong du bstan pa bzhin/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed nyid 'dod pa spos la/ lte ba'i sngags 'khor 'od zer spro bsdu la sems gtad de/ bzlas pa bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ mchod bstod nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin song ba na/ gtor ma rnams byin rlabs kyi cho ga rgyas pas byin gyis brlabs nas gtor ma re re bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gsum brjod/ gtor ma dang po bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su med par mos la/

oṃ gsum ma la/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya ho/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod dang*/ lha mo tshad ma sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa nag po chen po sogs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong rnams la 'bul/ de nas gtor ma lnga gong du bstan pa ltar mkha' 'gro sde lnga la 'bul te/ mthar ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang*/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ gtor ma tha ma dang por gzhi bdag la 'bul zhing lhag ma a kā ros rigs drug spyi la bsngo/ spro na phyi rol tu mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas 'byung po'i tshogs la'ang gtor ma sbyin/ de nas spos dang bcas pas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan ye shes rgyal mo mchog /rig 'dzin rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal/ /snying rje bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du/ /slob ma 'jug par 'tshal lags na/ /ji ltar rgyal ba kun gyis khyod/ /ye shes rgya mtshor byin rlabs pa/ /de bzhin du ni ye shes rol/ /sems can 'di la byin rlabs rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gyis slob ma'i don du gsol ba btab/ de nas bum bskyed ni/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs su bshad pa'i cho ga rnams 'di la 'don pa spos pas chog /skabs 'dir tshogs mchod bya zhing*/ lhag gtor dang lhan cig 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma btang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma bsrung ba'i don du bzhag go /de nas slob ma la ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa rnams/ slob dpon nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod sems bskyed gsal btab la/ chos bshad bya/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ mig dar btang*/ me tog gtad/ sum bhas bgegs bskrad/ zla ba rdo rje sems bskyed dang*/ gsang gdams nā ro mkha' spyod bzhin bya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug

de nas slob mas bla ma la maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul te/ gsol ba btab pa ni/ ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /'gro ba byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs/ /ye shes dpal rdor rnal 'byor ma/ /thams cad rig pa rang gis sbyin/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang mgon po kyai/ /da ltar nyid du sbyin par rigs/ / zhes lan gsum/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas maṇ+ḍal re re dang*/ gsol ba re gdab tu 'jug ste/ lha mo lus ngag yid kyis su/ /ye shes rgya mtsho khyod phyag 'tshal/ ji ltar sangs rgyas stobs chen gyis/ /thams cad ye shes byin rlabs pa/ /de bzhin bdag rgyud dag pa la/ /ye shes rgyun gyis mdzad du gsol/ / zhes so/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi bzhugs tshul rnams lha ngo bstan la/ me tog 'bul gnang dang*/ mig dar bkrol ba nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs bzhin bya/ de nas slob ma la yungs kar brab/ gu gul bdug bum chu gtor zhing*/ sum bha bzlas pas bgegs bskrad/ chos thams cad mi dmigs par sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las mngon rtogs bzhin gtso mor bskyed la/ go cha bgo /gnas gsum byin rlabs bya/ mig sogs bu ga thams cad la hūṃ re re gsal btab/ mngon rtogs ltar dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi dmigs pa phog la/ dngos su bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ de nas mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ni bum dbang gi dod yin/ sha chen nam ma rnyed na sha phal pa mar du btsos pa lag pa g.yas su gtad/ chang la bdud rtsi sbyar ba g.yon du gtad de/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ 'bru gsum gtags pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ za zhing 'thung du bcug gsang dbang gi dod yin/ byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du bltas pa 'dug la/ snying ga'i baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud 'od du zhu/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa po 'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dmigs pa phog slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yon pa slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag ste se gol gtogs la rkang brgyad tshar gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/

mdun bskyed kyi thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ slob ma'i lus la gtor/ lus thams cad gang bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyas par bsam/ de nas rim pa lngas byin gyis brlabs par bya ba las/ thams cad kyang slob dpon rig ma dang bcas pa yin na/ slob dpon yab yum gnyis kar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam du mos gus bskyed/ min na slob dpon nyid dpal he ru ka'i yum du mos la mos gus dung dung byed pa dang*/ chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pa re re bzhin sbyar nas/ dang po ni gong bu bsdu ba ste/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ rang lus sum cu rtsa drug sogs tshigs bcad kyi don bshad nas/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba thim pa'i bar dmigs pa sgom du bcug la mthar 'dzin med du 'jog go /gnyis pa ni rjes su gzhig pa ste/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid baṃ yig chen po gcig tu gyur pa bsam/ de je che je che la mthar nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i stong pa la sems 'jog go / gsum pa ni/ gtum mo ste/ lte bar chos 'byung zur drug pa'i dbus su 'khor lo sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa/ chos 'byung g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtod du bcug dar cig bzhag yang sngags 'khor aṃ du gyur/ de las gtum mo 'bar ba/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba'i 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad nas rlung 'dzin du 'jug pa'o/ / bzhi pa ni mi rtog pa ste/ sna sgor dga' ba 'khyil ba drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtod du gzhug lnga pa ni bde ba ste/ gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtod pa'o/ / de rnams re re'i mthar slob dpon gyis rtsa sngags drag tu bzlas shing*/ rol mo'i sgra rdzas kyi dud pa dang bcas pas byin dbab pa'o/ /de rnams shes rab ye shes bzhi par bcas pa'i dod yin no/ /de las ye shes phebs pa'i rtags gang yang rung ba byung ba dang*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya'o/
