/rjes la gsum las/ dang po spyod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ dmigs pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdag nyid khang bzang dang ldum ra rtse mo brgyad pa'i dbus na gnas pa las/ de'i mdun na rin po che'i brag ri shin tu mtho ba/ rtse mo mig gis kyang bltar mi bzod pa gsum yod par bsam/ rang nyid je mtho je mthor 'phur bas/ ri'i steng gi nam mkhar sleb nas/ ri gsum gyi rtse mo la rkang pa reg tsam reg tsam 'dug pa la sems gtod du bzhug gnyis pa ni yang de bas kyang mtho bar phyin te/ rang gi lus las rigs lnga dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi dwangs ma rnams dngul chu ltar bsdus te rang la thim pas rgyud bde bas gang*/ yang spros yang thim pa lan mang du bya/ mthar de nas kyang je mtho je mthor 'phur te/ mkha' dbyings su thim pa snyam byed/ yang lha skur shar ba snyam byed pa la sems gtong du bcug de gnyis la'ang rol mo'i sgra bya/ gsum pa ni/ slob ma lha mo'i 'dug stangs byar bcug lag g.yas su hūṃ zhes ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje rtse lnga gtad/ g.yon du dkyil 'khor gyi ka pā la gtad la/ nang mchod cung zad 'thung du bcug la/ mngon rtogs su bshad pa'i 'khor 'das kyi bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs/ gnyis pa man ngag sbyin pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag 'chad pa yin na'ang*/ lag len la mi mdzad/ deng khyod kyis byin rlabs legs par thob pa yin pas/ bsnyen pa dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub dang*/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang*/ 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces brjod nas/ rje btsun ma'i gnas gsum nas slob ma'i gnas gsum du thig le bya/ gsum pa mnyes par bya ba ni/ dam tshig khas blang ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang yon 'bul ba ste spyi dang 'dra la/

'grub na slar yang gtor ma dang*/ 'khor lo'i mchod pa rgya cher bya zhing*/ rjes chog ni nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rim pa de dag ni rgya gzhung dang*/ yig rnying ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa yin la/ mig dar me tog gi bya ba med kyang chog ces bla ma gsung zhing*/ spru lung pa'i yi ge ltar na cho ga'i gzhi rnams nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra bar mdzad nas/ gsol btab thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang*/ dngos gzhi'i gsol btab byang chub rdo rje sogs dang*/ ye shes dbab pa'i skabs gtum mo'i rim pa gsum po kho na dang*/ spyod pa'i rjes gnang gsum pa kho na dang*/ sha chen sbyin pa gsang dbang dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i mthar sgrub thabs kyi lung sbyin pa sogs mdzad cing*/ deng sang phal cher lag len de mdzad kyang gzhung dang mi mthun la/ kho bo'i rnam rtog ltar na bum chog kyang mi dgos par mngon mod/ byin rlabs can gyi lag len yin pas dkyus nyid bya'o/ /kuna~X las ngo mtshar che ba yi/ /byin rlabs cho ga ches dga~X' ba/ /snyinga~X po~X'i lag len cho ga tsam/ /'di yang bdag gi yid bde'i gnas/ /mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /

༈ oṃ swā sti/ rgyud sde kun gyi nges gsang phyag rgya yi/ /dngos grub dam pa 'gyur med sgrub byed ni/ /rdo rje 'chang gis rim gnyis lam du gsungs/ /de dag las kyang snying po cung zad brjod/ / 'dir phag mo zhal gnyis ma in+d+ra mkha' spyod du grags pa'i sgrub thabs nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ nang mchod bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs par mos ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ der chos 'byung 'bri tshul byed cing*/ dbus kyi baṃ las 'od 'phros/ dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i char phab pas thod pa gang*/ gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil dang*/ mthe'u chung nas brtsams pa'i sor mo rnams la bdud rtsis gtor zhing*/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lag pa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus dang khams gsum rnam par dag pa gzhal yas khang gi ngo bo chos 'byung*/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du aṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las baṃ/ rang sems dang lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i ngo bo/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ bskyed pa na dpyal lugs zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar bsgom/ sku mdog dmar ser ram dmar ba kho na las/ se 'bru'i me tog ltar dmar smug tu mi bzhed de nas go cha dgod pa dang*/ ye shes pa bstim pa dang*/ mchod bstod rnams kyang de dang 'dra ba las/ bstod pa'i skabs/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kho na mdzad/ yig rnying rnams las 'byung ba ltar rdzogs rim kyang cung zad bsgom/ oṃ gsum ma'i bzlas pa'ang ci 'grub bya/ mthar nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar gyi gsol btab/

dag pa gsum dran pa smon lam rnams bya/ gtor chog ni gtor ma gnyis nā ro mkha' spyod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ phaiṃ/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya ho/ zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ mchod bstod gsol btab gsum bya/ yang a ral+li sngags kyis 'jig rten pa rnams spyan drangs la/ oṃ kha kha sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gsol btab bzod gsol/ gshegs su gsol ba rnams kyang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /slob ma rjes bzung gi bya ba la/ shoms dang yo byad thams cad nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ 'og gzhi'i dkyil 'khor la chos 'byung gi lte bar tshom bu dkar po/ rtsibs drug la go cha'i sngags drug de'i phyi skor la tshom bu ljang khu brgyad bkod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ lag len bzhin oṃ gsum ma 'phreng bdun la tshang ba bkod/ zur drug la go cha'i sngags drug bkod/ phyogs bzhir dga' 'khyil bri/ slob ma'i skabs ting lo mi dgos/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod gtor bum bskyed rnams nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs nyid la gong du bshad pa rnams 'don pa spos pas chog pa las/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo grub tsam na/ 'khor go cha'i dpa' mo drug dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyang skad cig gis grub par gyur/ zhes pa tsam brjod/ go cha mi 'god/ mdun bskyed la bris pa kho na bzhin bskyed pa cig bshad kyang*/ lag len lhar bskyed pa kho na mdzad do/ /de nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bdag 'jug kyang blang*/

slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ a khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gis mig dar bcings shing*/ me tog gtad/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs nas byung ba ltar/ gsol btab dang yan lag bdun pa byed/ de nas slob ma rnams lag sbrel/ slob ma'i gtso bo'i lag pa'i mthe bong nas slob dpon gyis bzung ste/ rtog pas g.yogs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /legs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir bzlog ste/ /dwangs pa'i chu yis bkrus pa'i sems/ /phan pa'i sems kyis 'dir 'jug bya/ /dad pa med pa'i sems can la/ /dkar po'i chos nas mi 'gyur te/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po skye mi srid/ khyod rnams rnam rtog thams cad spongs la lha dang bla ma la mos gus drag po bskyed cig ces brjod la/ bum chu dang*/ sum bha sa bsangs/ yang tshe baṃ gyi phyag rgya dang*/ suṃ bha sa bsrung ba bya/ gu gul sogs kyi dud pas 'dug cing*/ rkang mthil gyi rlung gis sum mdo'i me sbar/ phung khams skye mched thams cad bsregs te stong par sbyangs bar mos la/ dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod/ skad cig gis slob ma rje btsun mar bskyed/ lte bar sngags 'khor gsal btab/ de las 'od zer 'phros g.yas ro ma nas song*/ spyi bo nas thon/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs spyi bor thim/ haṃ yig zhu ba'i rgyun dbu ma nas byung*/ lte bar babs pa la sems gtod du bcug la/ oṃ gsum ma 'don cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ yang lte ba nas 'od 'phros/ ro ma'i lam rgyud/ phag gdong gi smin mtshams thon/ g.yung drung g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtod du bcug la/ rol chen dang sngags bzla/ yang lte ba'i sngags 'khor de nyid gsang gnas su phab la/ g.yon bskor du 'khor ba la sems gtod du bcug la/ rol chen dang sngags bzlas/ de nas ye shes phab pa brtan byed dang*/ me tog 'bul ba/ mig dar 'grol ba/ lha ngo bstan pa rnams kyang nā ro mkha' spyod bzhin/

de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba nas/ rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa'i bar nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra ba las/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ / sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ mi bskyod pa kho nas dbu rgyan/ de ni bum dbang yin la/ gsang dbang yang nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra ba las/ dmigs pa'i gsal kha med/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ sngags 'phreng nas sin+dhu ra blangs te lte bar byugs/ oṃ gsum ma bzlas/ sngags rnams lte bar thim/ dga' 'khyil las blangs te dpral bar byugs/ sngags bzlas/ dga' 'khyil dpral bar thim/ zur drug las blangs ste/ spyi gtsug tu gtugs/ go cha'i lha tshogs mang po byon te/ spyi gtsug tu thim par bsam/ dbang bzhi pa yang nā ro mkha' spyod dang 'dra/ 'di la dbang bzhi'i rtogs pa bskyed pa mi mdzad/ slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skabs su bstan pa bzhin bya'o/ /dpyal lugs kyi zhal gnyis ma'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi ngo bo gcig cing*/ bal po phan chad kyi brgyud pa'i bka' babs kyang gcig pas de thob na 'di yang don gyis thob pa yin mod/ lots+tsha ba'i man ngag rgyas bsdus dang*/ phyag len mi 'dra ba la brten pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par dang*/ slob ma rjes bzung gi cho ga la/ mi 'dra ba cher yod pa dang*/ brgyud pa tha dad kyi mos zhen can rnams mgu ba'i don dang*/ sa lugs kyi mkha' spyod skor gsum zhes yongs su grags rkang grangs tshang ba'i don du/ khyad par 'byed pa'i yi ge gsal po bkod pa yin no/ /'di'i sngon du sa lugs kyi nā ro mkha' spyod dang*/ dpyang lugs kyi zhal gnyis ma'i cho ga shes pa shin tu gal che'o/ phag mo'o chos skor kuna~X las kyang*/ mchog tu dga~X' zhes rab bsngags pa/ mi dbang gzhung gsum lag len gyi/

snyinga~X po~X dril ba 'di tsam lags/ /in+d+ra mkha' spyod du grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //bkra shis/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ gang gi zhal gyi bka' drin gyis/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par mdzad/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs btud nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rang bzhin/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal mchog /sgrub pa'i thabs ni bdag gis bshad/ /de la 'dir rnal 'byor pa dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ 'di nyid kyi gsang ba'i ras bris bkram ste/ de'i spyan sngar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa brtsams te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas la/ dam tshig gis bkang ba'i ka pā la/ sum bha 'am/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha 'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa'i nang du/ hūṃ bhūṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ las sha lnga/ paṃ baṃ laṃ maṃ taṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gi lte bar hrīḥzur gsum la g.yon bskor gyi/ oṃ hūṃ ha/ de'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad dang khyad par rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi byang chub sems su spyan drangs nas thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ bdud rtsi bdag dang gnas la gtor te/ oṃ hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+taṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ khro mo rnams kyis bgegs rnams tshar bcad/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor grub par gyur/ rang gi gnas rnams su/ oṃ baṃ sogs go cha drug dgod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar 'od stong bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i dbugs bral gyi snying gar rang sems hrīḥyig dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar snang ba/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo li khri'i mdangs ltar dmar ba'i mdog can pad+ma dang nyi ma yi dwags kyi gdan la g.yas brkyang ba'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis sa gsum gnon pa/ zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa khro gnyer bsdus pa/ drag mo chen mo/ 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal phag gi gdong can shin tu khros pa rdo rje'i me 'od 'bar zhing ljags bskyod pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'khyil ba/ ba spu dang*/ gsang ba'i spu gyen du 'phreng ba/ thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ thod skam lngas dpral bar brgyan pa/ khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i 'phreng bas sku la brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lngas mdzes pa/ gcer bu phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rdo rje dang rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon na thod khrag dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gdug pa can thams cad kyis bzod par dka' ba'i gad mo rgod pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ zhes ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs/ lte ba oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo sogs go cha bkod/ lte ba'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha he ru ka yab yum 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur ba las rigs lnga'i ngo bo sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod pa rnal 'byor ma spyi dang mthun par byas la/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myangs/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ / zhes bstod/ gsang bar rgyal ba'i pho brang dmar po zur gsum pa'i nang du/

oṃ hrīḥhūṃ ha/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba spro bsdu dang bcas par yid gtad nas/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī a be sha ya sarba duṣ+taṃ hrīḥswāhā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /thun bsdu ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs shing*/ phaiṃ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ hrīḥhaṃ haṃ he he ha ha hi hi/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul nas/ mchod bstod sogs spyi dang mthun pa las/ sha chen gyi bdug pa 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhri hūṃ ha ha/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'bul lo/ / don kun grub pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ / 'bad pas sbyar la lha mo yis/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /he ru ka nyid 'grub par mdzod/ / 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma dpyal lugs kyi cho ga nyid 'don pa spos pas chog go /las rnams kuna~X la mthu ldan pa/ /rab dga~X'i sgrub thabs yid ches can/ /grags pa che yang deng dus ni/ /nub la nye bas snyinga~X po~Xr dril/ /rdo rje phag mo don grub ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /na mo badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ ye shes bskal pa'i me 'od kyis/ /gzung 'dzin 'jig rten gsum yang bsreg /slar yang ye shes rlung bskyod nas/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i char phab ste/ /zung 'jug khams gsum grub mdzad ma/ /srid zhi rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas/ /bskyed dang bsdu mdzad ma la 'dud/ /bdag la thugs brtser mdzad du gsol/ /'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbu bcad ma sgrub par 'dod pas/ dben pa'i gnas su tsan dan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gsum pa mchod pa dang bcas pa 'dus byas la/ gdong lho'am nub tu phyogs pas skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste/ dag pa gsum dran pa'i bar don grub ma dang 'dra ba las/ nang mchod byin rlabs kyi skabs/ chos 'byung gi dbus su hrīḥzur gsum la g.yon skor gyi oṃ āḥhūṃ/

zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ / stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lte bar raṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang gi lus chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum du gyur pa'i dbus su/ chu skyes dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa las/ rang sems zla ba'i steng du nyi ma/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hrīḥgasum las gri gug hrīḥs mtshan pa gsum/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod khrag steng phyogs su 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po/ g.yon du rdo rje rabs bsngags ma ljang khu zhabs g.yon brkyang*/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su rnam snang ma ser mo zhabs g.yas brkyang*/ phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ gsum ka'ang thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ gcer mo spyan gsum dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ mi zad pa'i zhal khro zhing 'dzum pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad cing me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa rnams kyi gsang gnas su chos 'byung re re/ dbus kyi nang du/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ g.yon gyi la/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa/ g.yas kyi la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge rnams yongs su brtsegs pa gtso mo'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis nyid kyi dbu bcad nas/ thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag gis dbu skra'i phyed bzung spyan gsum thur du gzigs/ rtsa gsum bcad mtshams nas dbus nas byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa'i rgyun byung ba rang nyid kyi zhal du 'bab par gyur/ g.yon brkyang ma nas mi bskyod pa dang 'dres pa'i kun da'i rgyun g.yon gyi zhal du babs/ g.yas ro ma nas khrag phal ba dang 'dres pa'i rdul g.yas kyi zhal du babs/

yun ci rigs par gsal la drag par bsgom/ de nas thur sel gyen du drangs pas/ gsang gnas kyi sngags las 'od zer steng du 'phros/ lam gsum nas byung*/ g.yas g.yon gyi lha mo gnyis 'od zer gyis drangs/ ro rkyang gi lam brgyud/ lha mo gnyis chos 'byung dang bcas pa bdag nyid chos 'byung dang bcas pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ sngags gnyis chos 'byung gi nang g.yas g.yon du brtsegs te gnas pa'i gsum bsgrigs su gnas par bsam/ maṇ+ḍal mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum/

zhes pa nas/ yi ge rnams yongs su brtsegs/ zhes pas bar bdag bskyed bzhin las rang sems zhes dor/ spyi dang mthun par go cha bkod la/ phaiṃ zhes pas spyan 'dren pa nas/ yo ga shud+dho 'i bar spyi dang mthun/ rang rang gi sngags gsum gyis mthar oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ zhes btags la me tog 'bul/ de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rnams sngags kyi 'bul zhing*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang*/ o ḍi ya/ pul+li ra ma la gi ri ka ma k+ṣi shī han+ṭa zhes lam dang*/ dharma sam+bho ga nirma ṇa mahā su kha ka ya/ zhes 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstod/ spro na skabs 'dir gtor ma phul kyang rung*/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe/ mdun bskyed kyi gsang bar bkod pa'i sngags gsum dang*/ nang du 'ong ba dang bstun nas rang gi gsang ba'i sngags gsum slar yang gsal btab thur sel bskyod pas sngags gsum gyi dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ sna bug g.yas nas thon/ mdun bskyed lha mo gsum gyi shangs kyi bu ga g.yon pa nas zhugs/ gsang ba'i sngags las 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams spyan drangs te/ rang rang gi shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ dhū tī'i lam brgyud/ gsang ba'i sngags la thim/ de nas sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ dmigs pa de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pa las sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla zhing*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ bzlas pa dang dmigs pa lha mo gsum rim can du byed pa'ang snang ngo*/ /bsdu ba'i dmigs pa ni spyi dang 'dra/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ gzhan kun rnal 'byor ma spyi dang 'dra ba las/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+la ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho

zhes lan gcig dang rtsa sngags kyi hūṃ gsum gyi sngon du/ puṣ+pe/ dhu be/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ bā ling gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma rak+sha rak+sha zhes pa bcug pa'i sngags lan bdun gyis 'bul/ phyi mchod dgos su 'bul mi dgos nang mchod dang bstod pa sngar bzhin/ 'di la mngon byang lnga bskyed dang*/ sa bon las bskyed pa dang*/ sa bon yang hrīḥdang baṃ sgrub thabs tha dad nas 'byung ba'i gdam nga can no/ /de bzhin du lte bar chos 'byung dang lus chos 'byung sgom pa yang gdam nga can no/ /lte ba'i dbus nas nyi byed 'od brgya yis/ /rab gsal 'jig rten gsum po bde chen gyi/ /dpyid ka'i dga' ston nam yang spel ba las/ /zung 'jug rgyal srid thob pa gang 'di mtshar/ / 'di'i byin rlabs byed tshul zhal gnyis ma'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X tu dpal mor grags pa'i gzhung*/ bir+wa chung ngus kyang mdzad pa'i/ gzhung dang rab dga~X'i sdebs nas ni/ zab mo'i sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~Xr bkod/ /rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༈ oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba thams cad bskyed byed yum/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa nyid/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mor sku bstan pa/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dud/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa sngags dang*/ shū n+ya ta sa sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e waṃ gyi yi ge shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ aṃ dkar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du rang sems hūṃ dkar po/ de thams cad las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ ban+dhu ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ shin tu gtum pa'i tshul can/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gam/

rdo rje sdigs pas lha min gyi gdon thams cad skrag par mdzad pa/ g.yon zhabs g.yon pa la yongs su 'khril zhing*/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ba la zhal gyen du phyogs pas bdud rtsi gsol ba/ nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms pa zhugs pa'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar thod par 'bebs shing bum pa'i dbang bskur ba/ phrag pa la rdo rje mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bkal ba/ zhabs g.yas pa sa 'og bdun gyi 'jig rten du brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ g.yon steng phyogs tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du brkyang bas tshangs pa dang brgya byin steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten la mnan pa/ rgyan spangs pa/ zhal nas bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ sku las rang mtshungs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo khro mo dpag tu med pa 'gyed pa/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ phyi rol bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'o/ /rang gi lte ba nas hūṃ gcig spros pas mdun du sprul pa'i pho nya phyag na rdo rje he ru ka'i cha byad can/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon phur bu thogs pa/ yang sprul lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ khyab 'jug chen po mi yi seng ge la sogs pa bgegs thams cad bkug hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i khron par bcug phur bus btab cing rdo rje'i rdul tsam du brlag par byas/ oṃ hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes nyer gcig tsam drag tu bzla/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo'i bar spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho ྅ ho/ ye shes 'khor lo phaiṃ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/

chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i sgo nas rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag ste/ oṃ pra kṛ ta pa ri shud+dhaḥsarba dharma pra kṛ ta pa ri shud+dho3haṃ/ lte bar chos 'byung g.yon du 'khor ba'i dbus su nyi ma la hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rtsa sngags so/ / oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hrī hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po'o/ / oṃ baṃ hūṃ/ sa bon gyi sngags so/ /de ltar yid rtse gcig pas ci nus su bzla'o/ /bdag bskyed kyi lha la mchod par mos nas/ añtsa ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ de bzhin du/ pro k+ṣa naṃ/ pād+yaṃ ar+ghaṃ ste chu bzhi dang*/ puṣ+pe/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod/ thod pa'i nang du gtor ma kha zas bzang dgu las byas pa sha chang gis brgyan pa cig dang*/ nya khrag sha chang la phug 'bru sna dang*/ kha zas sna tshogs kyi gtor ma kham phor gang bshams/ gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas pa pradzñā rak+ṣi ta'i gtor chog ltar bya bar bzhed na'ang bde mchog gang rung gcig dang bstun pas chog bsdu na sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ thod pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bcu brjod/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswāhā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te phaiṃ/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs/ gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī i maṃ bha ling gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ru ru/ kha kha kha kha/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ a a a a/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi pra yats+tsha hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun la sogs pas phul/ gtor ma gnyis pa la dmigs te/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor spyi dang mthun par btang*/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ de nas slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/

srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ de nas lha gsum la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi gdon rnams la gsungs pa/ chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu la/ / gang zhig gnon cing gang gis gnon/ /gang zhing gsod cing gang gis gsod/ /thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin/ /bcing ba med cing bsad pa med/ /rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul la/ /bdag dang gzhan du snang ba dang*/ /'joms bya 'joms byed snang bar gyur/ /bdag dang khyod dag rang bzhin gcig /gcig min du ma rnams las grol/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i ngang du ltos/ /kye lags dbang po ltos shig dang*/ /ngas ni ci yang ma mthong ngo*/ /bsam du med cing brjod du med/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma kun dang bral/ / zhes pa'i don bsam zhing mnyam par bzhag go /lha skur snang ba yang dmigs pa med pa'i ngang du stong nyid du bsgom/ de nas go cha bkod nas dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /thun mang du nyams su len na/ srod thun ma gtogs gtor chog de mi dgos so/ /nyin re bzhin bya ba ma 'grub na/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis dang*/ brgyad dang bcu bzhi rnams la bya/ 'grub na tshes de rnams la phyi rol mchod pa dang*/ gtor tshogs gal che'o/ /'di'i byin rlabs byed thabs ni/ tshes brgyad dang bcu gcig gang rigs la nyin phyed man chad nas/ tho rangs tshun chod kyi dus la bya ste/ stegs bu la chang gis chos 'byung zhig bris/ de'i steng du me tog dmar po bkram/ dbus su phye mar gyi ting lo gcig bzhag de steng mañdzi la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ steng du me long la sin+d+yu ra brdal la/ chos 'byung sngags bzhi dga' 'khyil dang bcas pa zhig bris/ logs gcig tu snod chung ngu gnyis su sha chen mar la btsos pa dang*/ chang la rak+ta cung zad bsres pa zhig bzhag mchod gtor bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ gtor chog ma gtogs bdag bskyed gong bzhin/

mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e waṃ gi zhes pa nas bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin bya/ mchod bstod rgyas pa byed par spro na'ang byed/ bsdu na/ phyi mchod kyi mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ a nu rā gas gsang mchod phul la bstod pa bya'o/ /gong gi gtor chog gis gtor ma cha gcig phul/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas rtsa sngags dang bdud rtsi la dmigs nas nye snying dang*/ ting lo la dmigs nas snying po dang*/ sha chang la dmigs nas sa bon rnams brgya rtsa re bzla'o/ /bar 'dir gzhon nu ma'i ston mo dang tshogs 'khor bya/ slob mas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ sogs kyis gsol pa gdab/ rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ lte ba'i chos 'byung 'khor ba dang*/ tha mal gyi lus 'od du zhu ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ lte ba'i yig 'bru la bstim pa'i dmigs pa rnams phog la re re bzhin du rol mo'i sgra bya/ ye shes dbab/ yol ba bsal/ mdun bskyed kyi lha ngo bstan/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ me long spyi bor bzhag la/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags brjod/ dpral bar sin+dhu ra byugs/ rtsa sngags brjod/ me long gi lha bstim/ lha skur gyur/ bum dbang ngo*/ /nang mchod sbyin nye snying brjod pas gsang dbang ngo*/ /snying pos ting lo sbyin la/ gtum mo 'bar haṃ yig zhu ba'i bde stong bsgom/ sher dbang ngo*/ /sa bon gyi sngags kyis sha chang lag pa g.yas g.yon du sbyin/ zung 'jug gi brda'o/ /zhes byas la ming du gzhug dbang bzhi pa'o/ /slob dpon gyis slob ma'i lag tu me tog dmar po gtad/ slob mas gzhon nu ma chung ngu zhig gi lag tu gtad nas/ dkyil 'khor la 'bul du gzhug rtsa sngags kyi mthar puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes brjod/ de nas sgrub thabs nyams su len tshul rdzogs par bshad la/ sngags la bzlas lung bya'o/

/rjes kyi bya ba ni phag mo spyi dang 'dra'o/ / rin chen lhar bskyed mchod pa 'bul/ /bum dbang 'dzin byed gsang dbang chang*/ /snying ga shes rab bzhi pa ni/ /sgo gnyis bcing ba yin no zhes/ / zhes pa ltar gyi dbang ni zhal las shes so/ /'di'i bris sku 'bri na rgyan rnal 'byor ma spyi dang mthun par 'bri'o/ /gsung ngo*/ /'di dus ma yin pa dang*/ slob ma gnyis la dus gcig tu mi bya/ 'di'i gdams pa/ bskyed rim rdzogs rim phyi rol mchod/ /gtor ma gzhon nu ma mchod dang*/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin sbyin bsreg dang*/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bdud gcod de/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i man ngag dgu /drag po'i las sbyor chung ngu gnyis/ /de ltar na man ngag bcu gcig po de dag las/ 'dir ma bstan pa rnams yi ge rnying pa na gsal zhing*/ 'ga' zhig phag mo spyi dang yang mtshungs so/ /in+d+ra bhū dhi'i bzhed gzhung ste/ /dpal ldan rwa lo'i gdams pa yin/ /kuna~X las khyad 'phags dga~X' bskyed 'di/ /snyinga~X po~X'i don ston rnams kyi chos/ /rdo rje phag mo gnam zhabs mar grags pa/ /phas rgol 'dzoms pa'i in+d+ra mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa/ /gang gi ye shes mthu las sprul/ / 'khor lo'i dbang phyug mar btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa rnams song rjes/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lte bar baṃ yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/

zhabs gnyis rus sbal gyi 'dug stangs kyis pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma la bhai ra ba nag po gri thod can/ stag sham dang*/ mi lpags gyon pa kha bub tu mnan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar chos 'byung gi dbus su/ baṃ phaiṃ zhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bca'/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ gtor ma 'bul na/ thod pa'i nang du gtor ma bshams/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ rje btsun ma mdun du dmigs la/ snying po'i mthar kha kha hūṃ btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul/ oṃ āḥhrī hūṃ ha ha lan bdun gyi sha chen btags pa'i spos 'bul/ gtor ma'i lhag ma de mkha' 'gro spyi gtor du btang*/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams bya/ tshul 'di nyid kyi snying po 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzla'o/ /des bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yin la/ de phyin chad 'di'i 'khrid tshul kho na bsgom/ bzlas pa dang gtor ma'ang ci rigs par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi 'og gzhi'i chos 'byung dang*/ mañdzu+i'i steng du thod pa dang sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sogs phag mo spyi dang mtshungs pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs baṃ yig snying pos bskor ba/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje rgya gram re re dang bcas pa bri/ mdun du thod pa'i snod du dmar gtor dang*/ sha chen gyi spos sogs mchod pa rnams ci bder bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas nas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du/ chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du baṃ ser po sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje nas bzhugs pa'o 'i bar gong bzhin/ phaiṃ zhes pa nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang pa yan chad kyang gong bzhin/ bum pa zhig bcas la snying po brgya tsam bzlas/ dmigs pa sogs gang yang mi dgos/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ sogs kyis gsol btab/ rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang dam tshig nyer gnyis bzung bar bya/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed lhar sgom du gzhug byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ / sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni nas/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib dag rnam smin gyi lus sbyangs bar mos/ shū n+ya ta nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin dmigs pa phog yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ steng phyogs nas char bzhin babs/ lte bar baṃ yig la thim par mos su bcug la/ snying po'i mthar a be sha ya a zhes btags pas ye shes pa dang gcig /cang te'u'i sgra bya/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi sbyin/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum brjod de/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don yin/ chos 'byung gi zur gsum nas sin+dhu ra blangs te/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du byugs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs brtan par mos/ 'og gzhi chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor ram/ bri sku yod na slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ kun rtog 'jig par byed cing rlung bcom nas/

/ye shes me lce 'bar ba'i lus can ma/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog gi gnas nas bzhengs/ lha mo mchog gis 'di la dges par mdzod/ / ces brjod pas/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas zhugs lte ba'i sa bon la thim par mos/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba yang gal che'o/ /kuna~X nas zab par bsngags pa yi/ /phag mo'i sgrub thabs dga~X' ba'i tog /dpyal dang phyag lo'i bzhed pa 'di/ /snyinga~X po~X bsdus te bkol ba lags/ /phag mo kurma bā tī'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal la/ /btud nas 'jigs khros phag mo yis/ /sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gzhung bzhin du/ /snying po las kyang snying por bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lus ngag yid gsum dag par gyur/ lte bar pad+ma dkar po'i steng du chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du rang sems hrīḥyig gi 'phro 'du las gri gug hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo dmar mo phag zhal can shin tu khros pa/ g.yas su snyan grags ma sngon mo sgeg cing khros pa/ g.yon du rnam snang ma ser mo cung zad zhi ba/ de gnyis lha zhal can gsum kar zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis ro gdan gcig la bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /phaiṃ zhes ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ rigs bdag rgyas 'debs ni med do/ / ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs shing myangs/ bde chen dkyil 'khor dbus ma nyid/

/gtso bo 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /stong nyid snying rje thig le mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal bstod/ /snying gar pad+ma la sa bon sngags 'phreng gsal btab/ de las me 'bar bas sdig sgrib bsreg par bsams la/ oṃ sarba kro dhā bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas la mthar lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs la dge ba bsngo/ 'dir gtor chog ni/ thod pa'i nang du zlum gtor shas brgyan pa la chang blugs te/ thod pa khengs pa tsam bya/ bde mchog gi mngon rtogs gang rung zhig dang bstun nas byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ zhes 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor mgron thams cad spyan drangs te/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags yongs rdzogs lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bya ba lhag ma yang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor nyid yin no/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed na mdun bskyed mi dgos pas/ mngon rtogs tshar gcig blangs/ gtor ma gnyis bcas la gcig gtsang sar btang*/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge sogs kyis gsol btab dang/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la/ lte ba la pad+ma 'dab gsum hrīḥ'abar ba dang bcas pa la sems gtad de/ rlung bzung du bcug pas/ de las gtum mo 'bar/ spyi bo'i thig le zhu bas bde stong sgom du bcug gzhan mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i dmigs pa rnams bor nas rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba'ang 'dra zhing*/ rjes chog ni mi dgos/ gtor ma gnyis pa de gtor chog gis btang ngo*/ /bud+dha shrī thugs dam gyi/ /lha rnams kuna~X gyi snying po 'di/ /byams pa'i dpal la dga~X' bas snang*/ snyinga~X po~X gzhung don tsam zhig bris/ /bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi mdzad pa'i sgrus thabs dang 'brel ba/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ bde chen rdo rje phag mo ni/

he ru ka dang gnyis med la/ /btud nas de'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mda' bsnun chen po'i gzhung bzhin bshad/ /skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas sngon du 'gro bas/ bsod nams tshogs bsog spyi dang mthun par bya/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las bsrung 'khor/ bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang*/ dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ baṃ dang hūṃ gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dkar mo phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bus mtshan pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ pang na bde mchog dkar po g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis stob pa/ pad+ma'i skyil krung*/ gnyis ka'ang ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ me dpung dang 'od phung 'khrigs shing*/ rgyan dang na bza' spangs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci 'grub zla/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las sgyed pu a las thod pa/ de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ ye shes lnga/ dam rdzas zhu ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs te bstim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lhag pa'i lha mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos/ sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab/ gtor mgron mi dmigs par sbyangs/ kha zas byin rlabs kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ bdag bskyed gtor bsngo dang bcas pa gong bzhin bya/ bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas myangs/ tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad kyang gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la bzhag /slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kyai ston pa 'gro ba'i bla/

/bdag cag 'khor ba las bsgral phyir/ /he ru ka dpal go 'phang mchog /dpa' bo chen pos deng 'dir stsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ bla med mchog la khyod dga' 'am/ zhes dris/ bdag dga'o/ / zhes lan gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum bzla ru gzhug rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ slob ma gong bzhin lhar bskyed/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum bkod/ ye shes pa bstim/ ye shes pa dbab pa'o/ /slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas yi ge 'bru gsum dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pas bstim pa dbang gsum/ gsum kar cig car bstim pas/ bzhi pa thob par mos/ 'jug tu rang sems spros bral lhan cig skyes par ngo sprad/ rjes tshogs la longs spyad/ mdun bskyed med pa'i phyir rjes chog la sogs pa mi dgos so/ /kuna~X las go bzlog yab yum sku/ /lhan cig skyes dga~X' lha mo yi/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X shākya shrīs/ /mtshur phur ba la gnang bar grags/ /go zlog lhan cig skyes mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i dngos/ /rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /lha mo de la gus btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /'di la bsnyen pa nyams su blang tshul dang*/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba gnyis las/ dang po la maṇ+ḍal thod pa/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rnams brtsegs mar bshams/ mtha' mchod gtod gyis bskor/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ dam rdzas 'bar ba'i snod du srin lag g.yon pa'i chos 'byung 'bri tshul byas la/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi la a ha ri ni sa zhes pa yid kyis bkod/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bkug ste/ de la bstims pas zhu zhing bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon par blug

/lus thams cad la gtor khrus bya zhing 'bru gsum mang du brjod/ phyogs mtshams rnams su gtor zhing snying po brjod pas bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam/ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags brjod cing stong pa nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag stong pa'i ngang las rang lus bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ rang sems lha'i 'khor lo rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das ma dus kyi mun pa'i sku can cher khros shing 'khrigs pa mchan khung du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba/ rtsa zhal kun rdzob rnam par dag pa rab khros lha mo'i zhal/ steng zhal don dam rnam par dag pa phag gdong g.yas phyogs nas gyen du phyogs pa/ spyan gsum stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ sprul dang rus pas brgyan pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyi mi ro'i snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa/ lang tsho la bab cing*/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / yang mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs byed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ / 'dab ma bzhi la bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba ka pā la khrag gis gang ba'i kha gcod can sgo 'tshams brgyad la/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ lhor ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu/ shar lho dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma g.yas dkar/ g.yor ser/ lho nub tu sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du thams cad mkha' 'gro ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma g.yas ljang g.yon dkar ba/ de rnams zhal gcig ma nyi gdan spangs shing*/

rnam pa gzhan rnams gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /spyi bor bla ma he ru ka snying gar ye shes sems dpa' zhal gcig pa/ gsus par dpa' bo sde bzhi/ lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa la 'khor lo'i lte bar bcom ldan 'das ma/ rtsibs bzhi pa la mkha' 'gro sde bzhi/ spyi bor āḥ dpung pa g.yas pa la ha/ g.yas kyi bol gong la ri/ g.yon gyi bol gong la ni/ dpung pa g.yon pa la sa/ snying ga'i 'khor lo la a/ spyi bor ha/ mgrin par ni/ lte bar ri/ gsang bar sa yig rnams kyis rgyas btab/ snying gar yang pad+ma dang sa bon lnga gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hī kro dhā kā lī a ha ri ni sa a be sha ya/ sarba karma hriṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa nyid ci 'grub tu bzla zhing*/ 'khor rnams la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ ces pa la sogs pa mtshan sngags nyid gang 'grub tu bzla ba yin no/ /nye snying bzla na/ sa bon lnga dang*/ sarba karma bor bas chog thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rang nyid lha sku snang stong la mnyam par bzhag la/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgrub pa'i lugs yin pas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs la bskyed chog la sogs pa mi dgos so/ /gtor chog ni gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i steng du a las thod pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ steng du zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phaiṃ zhais spyan drangs pa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hī mahā yo gi nī i dam bā ling ta gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa bhu dza ho pi pa ho/ ma ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ye/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtso mo dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī phaiṃ/ bud+dha ḍā ki nī phaiṃ/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī phaiṃ/ karma ḍā ki nī phaiṃ/ sa ma ya ḍā ki nī phaiṃ/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī phaiṃ/

sarba ḍā ki nī phaiṃ/ lo ka ḍā ki nī phaiṃ/ i daṃ bā ling sogs btags pas 'khor rnams la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo chen mo ni/ / 'jig rten gsum yum phyogs gzhan rgol ba 'joms/ /rmongs byed skrag byed rengs par byed pa mo/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu chen sde brgyad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bud med stong phrag nyi shu gcig /sum cu rtsa bdun rigs bdag nyid/ /mdor bsdus rdo rje phag mo'i rigs/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu dang ldan/ /re re bye ba'i 'khor bcas la/ /phyag 'tshal bstod cing gus pas mchod/ /rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma 'bul/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs spyi dang mthun par 'dod don gsol ba btab/ mthar yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi par chos 'byung dmar po nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa la lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng du bum pa la gtor ma nag po zur gsum pa bkod/ shar du thod sku'am ma 'byor na tsa ka li/ lho ru bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ nub tu me long la sin+dhu ra bkram ste/ chos 'byung gi nang du sa bon lnga rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba zhig bri/ byang du sngags byang rnams bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi tshogs btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi tshul gyi bzlas pa yan chad song ba na/ spro na mchod bstod rgyas pa dang*/ bsdu na

ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa/ nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa bya/ gtor chog ltar gtor ma phul/ 'og gi slob ma'i bya ba rnams bdag 'jug ting nge 'dzin dbang bskur gyi tshul du blangs/ slob ma'i bya ba ni maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags dang sdom pa bzung*/ a khaṃ wī ra hūṃ/ lan gnyis kyis me tog dang*/ mig dar btang*/ zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed bya/ gsang bar gdams te dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa yol ba'i nang du bcug 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / sogs kyis dam la bzhag u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas slob ma la bstim par mos shing*/ snying po'i mthar a be sha ya aḥ zhes pas ye shes dbab/ rdo rje phag mo deng khyod kyi mthar/ oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣu maṇ+ḍa la dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces pas mig dar phye/ me tog 'bul/ thod sku lag tu thogs te lha ngo bstan la/ lus 'di lta bu sgoms shig ces pa ni bum dbang ngo*/ / bdud rtsi ye shes rnam pa lnga'i ngo bor mos la/ 'bru gsum gyis myang du bcug la gsang dbang ngo*/ /sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dpral mgrin snying ga spyi bo rnams su gtugs la/ snying po brjod cing gnas bzhir thig le bya ste/ sher dbang ngo*/ /sems spros bral du ngo sprad de/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de rnams brda'i dbang bzhi'o/ /mngon rtogs ltar bsgom lung rgyas bsdus gang rung 'bogs te/ bum dbang sngags byang gtad/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin te gsang dbang*/ gtor ma gnas bzhir gtugs la/ lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon zhing*/ gnas bzhir thim par bsams la snying po tshar re re brjod pa sher dbang*/ lte bar sngags kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba la sems gtod du 'jug pa ni bzhi pa ste/

'phrin las bsgrub pa'i dbang bzhi'o/ / ji ltar bltams pa sogs bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba ni bum dbang dang*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs/ byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ gsang dbang dang*/ he ru ka yab yum kyi rjes chags bsgom du gzhug pa ni sher dbang ngo*/ /sems spros bral la slar yang ngo sprad pa ni/ bzhi pa ste ye shes bskyed pa'i dbang bzhi'o/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di shin tu bka' nyan pas/ bka' lung sbyin pa'i tshogs dang gtor ma bzang du byed dgos zhes gsung la/ khros ma nag mo'i gter chos su grags pa shin tu mang pas/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyi lugs 'di la yang*/ khros nag gi las byang dang*/ tshogs kyi ming can rnying ma'i rgyas bkab shin tu mang ba zhig dang*/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga yang*/ de dag dang bsres pa'i yig tshogs chen po mang du yod la/ de'i phyir chos skor 'di la gsar ma lhad med cung zad dkon pa tsam snang zhing*/ 'di ni nyang sgom rgod po nas brgyud pa bcos med khungs can du snang*/ chos skor yang*/ zhal gdams dgu dang*/ gnad kyi gdams pa chen mo dang*/ rde'u skor re bzhi dang*/ gnad bzhi dang*/ rlung gnad drug pa zhes bya ba rnams yod cing*/ de bas lhag pa tshad med par bshad do/ /kuna~X nas dam pa'i yi dam du/ /grags shing shin tu dga~X' ba'i chos/ /thab mo 'di yi lag len gyis/ /snyinga~X po~X khol byung tsam zhig lags/ /rjes btsun rdo rje phag mo khros nag lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //bkra shis/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ sgeg 'chang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sku/ /gzhom med brjod pa bral ba'i gsung*/ /zag med lhan skyes bde chen thugs/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun du bla ma yi dam dbyer ma mchis pa phaiṃ/

zhes spyan drangs/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i dpa' mo nyi shu rtsa bzhis mchod par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gis nang mchod 'bul/ gur nas byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dmar po dang*/ aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang sems slar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma shes rab gsal byed skur gyur pa ni lo bcu drug log pa'i lang tsho can/ ban+dhu lta bu'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa ba dan gsum gyis mtshan pa 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa'i ka pā la bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas pad+ma nyi ma dbugs bral gyi gdan la 'gying ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ slar yang dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi mgrin par hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar lce hūṃ las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar/

oṃ badz+ra dzi hā rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ 'dab ma bcu drug pa la dbyangs kyi yi ge rnams kun da ltar dkar ba/ lce chung gi rtse mor yang hrīḥde las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par gyur/ lte bar chos 'byung gi nang du/ pad nyi la hrīḥyig de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje dang*/ snod bcud thams cad kyi bcud bsdus te hrīḥl thim/ do li'i dmigs pa gsal btab te/ hrīḥ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /bar 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang cung zad bsgom/ mthar lha sku 'od gsal du bsdus te cung zad mnyam par bzhag slar yang chu las nya ldang gi tshul snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i lha mor gsal btab la dge ba bsngo/ thun 'tshams su gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor ma sum bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ lha mo tshad ma sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs man chad mkha' 'gro spyi gtor spyi dang mthun par btang*/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol mgron gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i byin rlabs byed tshul ni maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po/ gru bcad ljang khu zlum bskor sngon po can 'bri/ de steng mañdzi la thod pa ma da nas gang ba'i steng du/ me long la li khri brdal te/ chos 'byung gru gsum gyis dbus su hrīḥ

phyi'i phyogs bzhir dga' 'khyil bzhi dang bcas pa 'bri/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ sha chang gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang bcas pa bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod cang te'u sogs tshogs par bya/ spro na sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ nang mchod dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bde mchog bzhin bya/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar song ba na/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las nas/ bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed nyid 'dod pa spos pas chog/mchod pa rgyas par bde mchog gi mchod 'phreng bzhin 'bul ba'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ a nu ra ga 'i sngags kyis gsang mchod dang*/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig gis bstod/ gong bzhin gtor ma phul/ 'og nas 'byung ba rnams dmigs pa'i sgo nas bdag 'jug blangs/ 'grub na tshogs 'khor ram gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa nges par bya/ de nas bar chad bsrung ba'i don du sum+bha ci rigs par bzla'o/ /slob ma rnams la sngon 'gro'i chos bshad sogs byas nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ / sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ slob dpon gyis thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ slob ma la phog pa'i rkyen gyis 'od gsal du sbyangs/ swa bhā wa nas dbu brgyan gyi bar gong ltar las/ slob dpon gyi lte ba'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros zhes dang*/ phaiṃ slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim par gyur/ rol mo bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī a be sha ya hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ zhes bzla/ bum dbang dang sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /ka pā la'i bdud rtsi'i steng na hrīḥ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim/ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ

zhes nang mchod sbyin/ sgrub thabs kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa phog la/ hrīḥ brgya rtsa dang*/ dbyangs yig dang*/ ngag bsrung lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhugabyin gyis brlab pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ gsang dbang dang gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /lte ba'i hrīḥyig las gtum mo 'bar/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ste/ dga' bzhi skyes par mos su bcug la/ slob dpon gyis 'bru gsum brjod cing gnas gsum du sin+dhu ra'i thig le bya'o/ / sher dbang dang thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas rnam rtog gi spros pa bcad la/ 'dzin med khyab brdal gyi ngang du 'jog tu bcug ste/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /'di yon tan gyi rjes gnang yin gsung*/ thod le kor la sgrub pa zhag bdun byas te/ slar yang sngags rnams lan brgya brgya bzlas te/ slob ma'i lag tu gtad/ shing gleg la hrīḥyig dbyangs gsal gyis bskor ba lag len ltar 'brir bcug la/ de la ye shes pa bstim zhing mchod nas/ slar yang bkrus te thung du gzhug pa ni 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang yin mod kyang*/ re re tsam ma gtogs lag len mi mdzad do/ /de bzhin du gi hang gis lce la yi ge 'bri ba'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /rjes slob mas khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal/ yon 'bul/ smon lam gdab pa rnams bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa kha gsos/ byin gyis brlabs mchod bstod dngos grub blangs la/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ yo ga shud+dho 'i sngags kyis dam tshig pa bsdus/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa nyams su len par spro na/ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags yan chad bor te/ gtum mo'i me'i 'od kyis snang ba 'od gsal du bsdus/ de las pad nyi'i gdan sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgom pas lha dbang bskur ba mi dgos so/ / 'di gnyis ni paṇ+ḍi ta nags rin gyi man ngag ltar yin la/ rnying pa ltar na phal cher sngar gyi rgyas pa dang 'dra ba las/

rnal 'byor ma drug gi go cha 'god/ rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs kyi mthar mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba gsum rgyas par mdzad/ mgrin pa'i dbyangs kyi 'khor lo mi bsgom/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs bum pa spyi dang mthun par bca' zhing*/ bum sgrub kyang mdzad/ byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi yang nā ro mkha' spyod dang phal cher 'dra ba las ye shes dbab pa'i skabs kyi gsol btab de mi mdzad/ ting lo thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ lte ba'i hrīḥyig las gtum mo 'bar te 'od kyis snang ba thams cad khyab par bsgom/ chu dbang gi bkra shis la/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs mdzad/ cod pan gyi skabs dbu rgyan mgo bor 'jogalag len 'ga' zhig la rig pa'i dbang lnga char bskur ba yod/ de nas bzlas lung man chad byed de/ lugs 'di gnyis ma 'dres pa bya la/ rang re'i brgyud pa 'di la snga ma byin rlabs kyi bka' babs mchog go / yang g.yag sde paṇa chen nas brgyud pa rjes gnang gi lag len gzhan zhig kyang thob mod kyi/ 'dir ma bris so/ /shes rab sgrub 'dod skye bo kuna~X/ dga~X' chen lha mo 'di sgrubs na/ /snyinga~X ga pad+ma kha bye nas/ /blo gros chen po~Xr nges par 'gyur/ /rje btsun ma phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge legs 'phel/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o/ /zhus dag/ ༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ ma lus 'jig rten thams cad la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis rab gzigs nas/ /sdug bsngal nyer zhi 'jig rten mgon/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ / dang por/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ / sogs lan gsum/ rang spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas/ nai be te 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyi phyag g.yas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung*/ spyi bo nas brtsams te lus thams cad bkrus pas sgrib gnyis dag par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ya a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ bum pa'am dung chos kyi chus gdong dang kha lan gsum du bkrus/ gtso bo 'od du zhu rang gi spyi bo nas thim bum dbang thob/ yi ge drug ma yang thim pas gsang dbang thob/ nor bu 'dzin pa'ang thim pas shes rab ye shes bzhi pa bcas pa thob ste/ lha sku snang stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du gyur/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi mthil du a las zla ba la hrīḥ de la bdud rtsi'i chu blug pas hrīḥyig bkrus te 'o ma'i rgyun du gyur nas/ yi dwags rnams kyis 'thungs pas tshim zhing*/ chos sku'i bde ba dang ldan pas rang gi gnas su dengs par gyur/ hrīḥ bzla zhing lag pa bkru/ de nas skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang 'dra bar bya/

oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las snying ga'i thad tsam gyi nam mkhar hrīḥdakar po zhu ba las dbus su thig le dkar po chen po/ g.yas g.yon du thig le dkar po chung ngu re re dang bcas par gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba lta bu ston zla 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbug por sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba dang bcas pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba 'dzin pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis sa la 'dom gang tsam du gzigs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i phyed dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du 'khyil zhing*/ rtse mo rlung gis bskyod pa ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dmar po'i smad dkris gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs shing*/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing pad zla rgyas pa'i gdan la rol pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar bas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon gnyis pas rin po che'i lcug phran gyi yal ga 'bras bu'i snye ma lhung bar 'gyur ba'i ngang tshul can bsnams pa/ g.yon du yi ge drug ma gtso bo dang mtshungs pa las lha mo'i cha byad 'jo sgeg gi rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa/

'khor gnyis kar gtso bo'i zhal ras la lta zhing*/ pus mo phyogs gcig sa la btsugs pa'o/ / yang na pad+ma dkar po'i tshab tu ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa dang*/ gtso 'khor gsum char gdan can nam/ gsum kar gdan med byas kyang rung ngo*/ / rang gi snying gar a las zla ba nya gang ba'i steng du/ hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod pa lan gsum bya/ thugs rje chen pos bdag la sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ lha gsum po dam tshig pa so so'i spyi bo nas gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ snying gar zla ba la hrīḥyig sngags 'phreng dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes ci nus bzla zhing*/ sku snang stong*/ ngag grag stong*/ sems stong nyid snying rje'i rang bzhin sngags kyi sgras sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa dag pa'i 'phrin las rnams yid la bya'o/ / thun 'jog khar/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥyig gi 'od zer gyis/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu/ bcud kyi sems can la thim/ de rnams gtso 'khor gsum la thim/ 'khor gnyis kyang bdag nyid la thim/ rang yang snying ga'i hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥthig le yungs 'bru tsam du gyur/ de mtha' nas yal te stong nyid du gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhagastong pa'i ngang las thig le las hrīḥde las gtso 'khor gsum/ de las bcud lha dang*/ snod gzhal yas khang du gyur gnyis po rang nyid la thim/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ thun mtshams su byams snying rje dang ma bral bar bya zhing*/ brul gtor ci nus gtor/ gtor chog ni dkar gtor cha gnyis dang*/ mchod pa gtsang sbra can du bsham/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ rin po che'i snod du gtor ma 'dod yon gyi rgya mtsho oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan pa/

hūṃ gis skyon sbyangs/ āḥs bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ gyis mang por spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ lan bdun dang*/ yi ge 'bru gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod de 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun gyi gzhi/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon gyi ma gos sogs dang*/ mtshan dpe cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur/ /ston ka'i zla ba 'bum khrag 'khrigs pa'i gzi/ /rin chen bye ba'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gtor ma gnyis pa'ang sngar bzhin gyis byin gyis brlabs/ klu sman dang*/ 'bru chan btab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po nas/ klu rgyal wa ru ṇa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan nyer gcig gis phul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ gdengs ka bdun ni phyir bstan sprul 'jug can/ / thugs kar thal sbyar sangs rgyas kun la 'dud/ /lhag ma'i phyag gis rin chen dbang rgyal gyi/ /char 'bebs klu rgyal khyod la bstod pa 'bul/ / gsol btab lhan gcig tu bya ste/ 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal spyan ras gzigs/ /sras dang btsun mor bcas pa ni/ /phyugs bdag chen pos zhabs bsten pa/ /rgya chen gtor mas dgyes par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ khyod kyi sems can sogs/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad gsum sgrigs shig rdul tshon dkar pos bris/ dbus ma'i steng du mañdzi la bum pa bcud dang kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'god/

phyis kyi phyag len ltar na/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gsum pa tsam la brten kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas nas/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa med na tshom bu'i steng du dang*/ yod na bum pa'i steng du hrīḥdakar po zhu ba las zhes pa nas/ sa la btsugs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar gong bzhin las/ bdag la zhes pa/ slob ma 'di rnams la zhes 'don pa spo/ bar 'dir bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nas/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar gong bzhin/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad lo rgyus dang bcas pa bshad cing*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ji srid byang chung snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi dam du 'tshal gyi/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa 'bogs pa'am/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum bya/ rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi mngon rtogs bzhin/ sku'i rjes gnang dang*/ gsung la bzlas lung*/ dam bca' byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung*/ thugs phyag mtshan 'phreng ba dang*/ pad dkar bstim pa rnams te spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ bum pa bcas na/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ gi bar gyi bum pa mgo thog tu bzhagayig drug brjod bzhin 'thung ba dang*/ khrus byed du 'jugarjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /sgrub thabs 'di ni a ti shā'i bzhed pa/ nag tsho dang*/ phyag sor ba nas brgyud/ skyer sgang pa la bka' babs pa zhal gzigs kho na'i brgyud pa yin la/

de la phyi sgrub gsang sgrub gnyis las phyi sgrub bo/ /yig drug kuna~X la grags mod kyang*/ /gzhan pas dga~X' ba'i nyams len ni/ /grub thob rnams kyi snyinga~X gi bcud/ /lhad med gsal por bkod pa yin/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi yi ge drug pa jo bo'i lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan yid 'ong po ṭa la/ /mdzes byed 'jig rten khams gsum gyi/ /ston pa gnyis pa 'jig rten dbang*/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de'i 'od kyi lus gang*/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba g.yas gnyis pas shel gyi 'phreng ba/ g.yon gnyis pas ut+pal dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la 'od dpag med dang bcas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ ba spu'i bu ga re re bzhin yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa dang bcas pa/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥde la 'od zer 'phros/ spyan ras gzigs ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yid kyi phyag mchod bya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la dmigs shing*/ sems can la snying rje chen po bsgom bzhin pas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ thun 'jog khar/ ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dge ba bsngo/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang sgrol ma'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/

/spyan gzigs sems dpa' kun 'dus kyi/ /sgrub thabs ngo mtshar yid dga~X'i gnas/ /bka' gdams pa yi yi dam lha/ /kun gyi snyinga~X po~X yin par grags/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi las 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ thugs rje chen po'i mnga' bdag ni/ /thugs rje chen po'i mtshan 'chang ba/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /nyung bsdus shin tu gsal por bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas phyag mchod yan lag bdud pa ci 'grub zhig bya/ mdor bsdus kyi tshe med kyang rung*/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ swa bhā wa sa stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las gser gyi pad+ma'i lte bar hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal bcu gcig gi rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ljang ba g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng gi zhal gsum ljang dmar dkar ba/ de'i steng gi zhal gsum dmar dkar ljang ba/ de rnams zhi ba'i zhal sgeg pa'i rnam pa can/ de'i steng du khro bo'i zhal nag po skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhal dmar po gtsug gtor dang bcas pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas 'phreng ba/ gsum pas mchog sbyin gyi mthil nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'babs pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ bzhi pas 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis pas pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ gsum pas ril pa spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu bsnams pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rnam par brkyang ba/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re dang bcas pa/

zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs shing*/ rang gsar pa'i sham thabs dang*/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par spras pa/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i sku can/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ lho phyogs po ṭa la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ki te ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ spyi bor 'od dpag med/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ba g.yas par rin 'byung*/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ltag g.yon par don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya dzñā na sā ga re/ bai ro tsa na/ bhu ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo d+dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭ+ṭe waṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su me wa re/ i li mi li tsi tī dz+wa la ma sa na ya swāhā/ zhes pa gtso bor bzla ba yin zhing*/ mi nus na gzungs nyid cung zad bzlas nas yig drug gtso bor bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/

/'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya'i mthar badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ rang phyag gnyis par gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su phyag mchod smon lam mdo bklags pa sogs gang 'grub bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir zla gdan la dbus su tshom bu dmar po/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dkar/ byang ljang khu rnams bkod/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la tshom bu ser po re bya/ gtor ma 'das gtor gcig bya/ cha gsum gtor ma dang*/ klu gtor la sogs gang 'os bshams/ mchod pa yang ci bder bsgrigs/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥlas bh+ruṃ chad de/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas su babs pa/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus dang pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyogs bzhir zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus su hrīḥyig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba

zhes pa nas/ 'phro ba'i sku can zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ de'i dbu gtsug tu sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can/ lhor traṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ nub tu oṃ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ byang du a las don yod grub pa ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ gshegs pa gzhan gsum g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can no/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir bum pa bzhi grub par gyur/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ zhes pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ dbang bskur bar gyur/ zhes brjod kyi rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs mi dgos so/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ spro na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad brjod cing*/ bsdu na/ ar+ghaṃ nas*/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi sngags dang phyag rgya kho nas chog go /bstod pa'ang spro na rgyas pa dang*/ bsdu na gong bzhin bstod/ 'das gtor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ru?ṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khī hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dir bzhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ chos skyong dang cha gsum sogs rang rang gi cho gas btang*/ bum pa drug gam gnyis bca'/ gtso bum gyi dbus su skad cig gis thugs rje chen po dang*/ bzhir rgyal ba rigs bzhi/ las bum du rta mgrin dbyug pa dang zhags pa thogs pa skad cig gis bskyed/

yang na rnam rgyal bum par mdun bskyed ltar lha lnga dang*/ las bum du rta mgrin bskyed nas gzungs 'don/ oṃ ha ya gri wa hūṃ/ zhes gang 'os su bzla/ mthar mchod bstod byas/ de 'od du zhu ba'i bum chur mos/ slob ma'i bya ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ / sogs dang*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsung rjes su bzlas pa/ dam bca' byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gsum/ thugs phyag mtshan bskyed bstim rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes ba bstim pa song mtshams/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang rgyal ba rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ slob ma gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos byed du 'jug khyed ni mgon po thugs rje can/ /kun nas khyab pa'i ye shes kyis/ /thams cad ma lus sgrol mdzad pa/ /bdag sogs byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / ces lan gsum/ rta mgrin gyi sngags bzla zhing*/ las bum gyi chu gtor bas bgegs bskrad/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'od dpag med/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ltag g.yas su rin 'byung*/ ltag par rnam snang*/ rna ltag g.yon du don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal kuna~X gyi gtso/ /dpa' mo'i bzhed gzhung rab dga~X' ba/ /tshig tshogs mang po'i cho ga las/ /snyinga~X po~Xr dril ba 'di tsam lags/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dpa' mo'i lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅgalaṃ/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ las dang dngos grub ma lus pa/ /sgrub la thogs med mthu thob can/ /don yod zhags pa rigs sngags rgyal/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/

rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang don yod zhags pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ gang gis drin gyis bde chen nyid/ / sogs dang*/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ don yod zhags pa khro rgyal rta mgrin dang*/ /ral gcig ma dang khro gnyer can ma ste/ 'phags pa lha lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hrīḥyig nam mkhar gnas pa de las 'og tu chad pa'i raṃ las nyi ma/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa'i bsrung 'khor/ bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su paṃ lnga las pad+ma lha rnams kyi kha dog dang mtshungs pa lnga tshom/ de rnams kyi steng lho dang nub tu raṃ las nyi ma/ gzhan rnams su a las zla ba/ nam mkha'i hrīḥyig dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las/ pad+ma dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phraus 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ ri dwags kyi pags pas smad dkris pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyugs bdag gis cha lugs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis dbu la brgyan pa/ g.yon gyi lha mo la gzigs pa'o/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du pad+ma dkar po hrīḥyig gis mtshan par gyur/ shar du ha las zhags pa has mtshan pa las don yod zhags pa dmar po phyag g.yas gnyis na zhags pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na lcags kyu dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

mnyam par bzhengs pa'o/ /lhor hūṃ las dbyug pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las rta mgrin dbu'i steng du rta mgo ljang khu can/ phyag g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo ser po dang*/ pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang gi stabs can no/ /nub tu pha las ral gri phas mtshan pa las/ ral gcig ma sngon mo phyag g.yas pa bzhis ral gri zhags pa pad+ma mda'/ g.yon pa bzhis 'khor lo dbyug pa rtse gsum gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs can/ de gnyis ka yang stag lpags dang*/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ shin tu khros pa'o/ /byang du ṭa las dbyug to ṭas mtshan pa las khro gnyer can ma dkar sham/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dbyug pa dang*/ pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas rol gyi stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ gtso bo'i zhal la blta ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nas don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med/ don yon zhags pa la rnam snang*/ rta mgrin la rin 'byung*/ ral gcig ma la mi bskyod pa/ khro gnyer can ma la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa nyid gtso bor bya bar 'dod na skabs 'dir bya'o/ /mdun bskyed bzlas pa gtso bor byed na/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad lnga tshom la/ mngon rtogs dang mthun pa'i gdan dang lha'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod/

bsdu na/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba dang 'dab ma la bkod kyang rung*/ gru bcad/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ mtha' mchod gtor gtsang mas bskor/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang*/ zhes pa nas/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan gyi bar gong bzhin la 'don pa bsgyur/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du rol mo nas/ shap+ta 'i bar du 'don pa spo/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa bya zhing*/ bstod pa ci shes kyis bstod/ dkar gtor gcig bsangs sbyangs/ gtor snod bh+ruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhu ba las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ lo ki shwa ra a mo gha pā sha ha ya gṛ wa e ka dza ṭi sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sogs lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ dmigs pa gsal btab la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te kā ru ṇa ma ya/ murta ye hūṃ dza swāhā/ spyan ras gzigs kyi'o/ / oṃ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥha hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ don zhags kyi'o/ / na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ haṃ kha ta bhuñdza satwa ya swāhā/ rta mgrin gyi'o/ / oṃ e ka dza ṭī mahā ro ṣa ṇa/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ sa ma sa ma/
