pra shra ma ṇa ya swāhā/ ral gcig ma'i 'o/ / na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ sarba bha wa paṇ+ḍa ra ṇī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa pa ta ya swāhā/ khro gnyer can ma'i 'o/ /bzlas pa'i snying po don yod zhags pa nyid la bya zhing*/ de bcu cha gtso bo dang*/ de'i lnga cha tsam lha gzhan gsum la bzla bar bla ma rnams bzhed do/ /'jug tu slar yang mchod bstod bya zhing*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma cha gsum mam/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma tsam bya'o/ /'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ mdun bskyed gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ yang mchod bstod gshegs gsol rnams byas la/ smon lam gdab/ bkra shis rnams bya'o/ / ༈ yang don zhags ser po sgom par 'dod na/ khyad par ni gtso bo sku mdog ser por bsgyur/ sa bon gyi mdog dkar po yin/ gnas gsum byin rlabs mi dgos/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bdag bskyed kho na la brten nas byed/ bzlas pa thon pa dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa la mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams byed/ gtor chog mi dgos/ 'di rgya gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi lugs yin no/ /gnyis ka ltar yang*/ bzlas pa'i skabs gzungs ring bzla nus na shin tu yang legs so/ /rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gong du bshad pa de kho nas 'grub cing*/ slob mas 'di ltar gsol ba gdab ste/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can skye ba dang*/ 'phel ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes lan gsum gyis gnang ba thob par bsam/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas par blang ba'am/ bsdu na gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ sku'i rjes gnang gi gsol btab/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ lus gyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ lus bde ba dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ de bzhin du gsung gi= ngag gi= ngag nus pa dang ldan par= thugs kyi= sems kyi= sems ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par= zhes 'don pa spos la lan gsum gsum/ sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par byas nas/ thog mar/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / zhes byin gyis brlab pa'i lung bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par bya/ 'di skabs sngags thung rnams kyi bzlas lung grub mtshams/ don zhags kyi gzungs mdo chung ba 'di nyid tshar gyis bklags/ gzungs ring la rjes bzlos lan gsum grub na shin tu legs/ bshad tshod kyang yin mod kyi/ phyis lag len la mi byed par snang ngo*/ /de nas dam bca' ba'i lung yang spyi dang mthun no/ /thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ sems mi rtog pa spros bral du ngo sprod pa tsam las gzhan mi mdzad do/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba gong du bshad pa nyid yin no/ /don zhags ser po'i rjes gnang gi slob ma'i bya ba rnams sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lag len kho na bzhin yin no/ /sgrib kuna~X sbyangs dang dngos grub kyi/ /dga~X' ston 'gyed pa'i ngo mtshar rgyud/ /cho ga zhib mo'i snyinga~X po~X ni/ /bsdus pa 'di yin nyams su long*/ /ba ri lo ts+tsha ba'i lugs su grags shing*/ don yod zhags pa'i gzungs las byung ba 'phags pa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /don zhags lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ bsam pa ji bzhin 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /don yod zhags pa la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs shākya shrī'i lugs/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bshad par bya/ /'di rgyas par grags pa dpal bzang po'i yi ge las shes par bya zhing*/ mdor bsdus tsam ni/ skyabs sems sngon du song bas/ snying gar hrīḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po/ de'i steng du a las zla ba la a dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nas don zhags lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po hrīḥyig las byung zhing*/ /thugs ni bde ba ches brlan pa/ /don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba'i/ /'jig rten mgon la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /oṃ a mo gha pā sha lo ke shwa rā ya/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ pad+yāṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sngags kyi sgyu ma lta bur sbyangs/ snying ga'i hrīḥyig gi 'od kyis rjes gzhig gis stong par bsdus la/ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hrīḥyig 'od kyis 'phro 'du las lha lnga'i rnam par gyur pa ni/ rang nyid dbus su don yod zhags pa dkar po zhal gcig phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas pa rnams rim pas/ skyabs sbyin/ mchog sbyin/ zhags pa/ bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon rnams rim pas dbyug gu rtse gsum/ glegs bam/ pad+ma/ spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po'i na bza' dang*/ stag gi lpags pa'i smad dkris can/ dka' thub kyi cha byad dang ldan pa/ de'i g.yas su nor bzang gzhon nu ser po mchan khung g.yon par po ti bcug nas thal mo sbyar ba/ de'i g.yas zur du sgrol ma ljang khu/ g.yon pas ut+pal bsnams shing g.yas pas kha 'byed pa/ de gnyis dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/

gtso bo'i g.yon ngos su rta mgrin dmar po mi'u thung gi rnam pa can/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra ser gyen du brdzais pa sogs khro bo'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon dbyug pa dkar po la brten pa/ de nyid kyi g.yon ngos su khro gnyer can dmar ser phyag g.yon gnyis na spyi blug dang dbyug gu rtse gsum/ g.yas gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang phyag byed pa'i tshul/ dka' thub kyi cha byad 'dzin pa/ 'khor rnams gtso bo'i zhal la lta ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad mnyam par bzhengs pa/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥde las 'od 'phros po ṭa la nas lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ de dang stabs gcig tu byon pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /

sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ a mo gha pā sha hrīḥswāhā/ zhes bzlas so/ /spro na 'khor rnams kyi sngags kyang bzla ste/ oṃ suṃ su dha na ku ma ra ya swāhā/ oṃ taṃ ta ra ye swāhā/ oṃ haṃ ha ya gṛ wa ya swāhā/ oṃ bh+riṃ bhi kuṭ+yai swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor rnams rang la thim/ rang nyid phyag gnyis par gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su gzungs kyi mdo bklag par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad zla gdan tshom bu dkar po dang bcas pa zhig bkod/ de'i g.yas g.yon du dri bzang gi thig le gnyis gnyis la tshom bu re dgod/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa bshams/ snod gtsang mar dkar gtor zhig dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma cha gsum yang bshams/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du mañdzi la bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngas las hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma zhes pa nas/ bzhengs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ gtso bo'i dbu la 'od dpag med/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu mi bskyod pa/ byang du don yod grub pa/ shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma kī nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du dam tshig sgrol ma rnams bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nas zhes pa nas bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi bzlas pa cud zad bya/ de nas chu gsum gong ltar phul/ de man chad so sor 'bul te/ oṃ hrīḥ.a mo gha pā sha badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swāhā/

oṃ hrīḥ.a mi ta bha ya badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ suṃ su dha na ku ma rā ya badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swāhā/ des 'khor gzhan gsum ka'ang 'gre/ de bzhin du/ bh+ruṃ bai ro tsa na ya = traṃ rat+na saṃ bha wa ya= hūṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya ya= khaṃ a mo gha sid+dhi ya= laṃ lo tsa na ye= maṃ mā ma kī ye= paṃ paṇ+ḍa ri ye= oṃ taṃ ta ra yai badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar ro/ / sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /yon tan dam pa kun gyis brgyan/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po hrīḥyig sogs dang*/ nor bzang 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ /rta mchog khro gnyer ldan ma ste/ /rgyas dang dbang dang drag po dang*/ /zhi bas gzhan don mdzad la 'dud/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ / sogs dang*/ spyan ma rdo rje mā ma kī /gos dkar mo dang sgrol ma ni/ /'byung ba bzhi po rnam dag cing*/ /tshad med bzhi'i dngos la 'dud/ / dkar gtor/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ā mo gha pā sha lo ki te shwa ra i daṃ bā ling*/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma sarba bigh+nān shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ lan lngas 'bul/ gzungs thag nas bzung zhing*/ bum pa'i nang sngags kyi yig 'brus gang bar dmigs la/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ gzhan rnams nyer gcig re bzla/ bar 'dir cha gsum gtor ma gtong*/ grub na gzungs mdo 'don zhing*/ gzungs ring kyang mang du bzla'o/ /slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ / sogs kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ bdag bskyed ltar rgyun bshags kyang bya/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs mngon rtogs bzhin bstan la/ slob ma la sku'i rjes gnang ni/ stong par sbyangs pa nas/

rigs bdag gi bar mngon rtogs bzhin 'bogs pa las/ gtso rkyang ma gtogs 'khor mi bskyed/ dbang bskur gyi tshe bum chu sbyin/ oṃ pad+mo d+dha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes pad+ma kha 'bus kyi phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs/ gsung gi rjes gnang la rjes su bzlas pa'i lung*/ dam bca' ba'i lung*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gsum spyi dang 'dra/ slar yang bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas blug cing 'thung du bcug ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang zhing sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bde bas khyab par mos/ de ni thugs kyi rjes gnang gi dod yin no/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod/ dngos grub blang ba/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis rnams kyang spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /mkhas kuna~X dga~X' ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /shākya shrīs zhal gzigs nas/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig mdzad/ /lots+tsha rab mchog dpal gyis bsgyur/ don zhags kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ gang gis rgyal ba thams cad kyang*/ /byang chub mchog sems bskyed pa po/ /mgon po de la gus btud nas/ /sgrub thabs cung zad tsam zhig bri/ /khrus byas skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun spyan ras gzigs gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams can spyan drangs te bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad 'bul bar bsam/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis gang bgyis pa'i/ /sdig rnams rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /'jig rten gsum gyi dge ba thams cad la/

/ rab tu dga' bas rtag tu rjes yi rang*/ /dkon mchog gsum la rtag tu bdag skyabs mchi/ /rgyal bas gsungs la skyabs shing brten par bgyi/ /ji srid srid pa brtan gyur de srid du/ /skye dgu'i yab rnams mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*/ /'dir yang rtag tu sems can don mdzad pas/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas de rnams bzhugs su gsol/ /the tshom mthar byed ji lta ba yi chos/ /kye kye mthu chen khyod kyis bstan du gsol/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'gro rnams lhan cig der/ /gang gis pha rol 'gro zhing dge bsags pa/ /bsod nams rab tu gang bsags 'di kun kyang*/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bdag gis bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba rnams dang de yi sras/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dag bcas la/ /bdag gis dngos po thams cad ni/ /thams cad du ni dbul bar bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum rgyun bshags bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa'i spyan ras gzigs dpal ldan mkha' spyod kyi skur gyur pa ni/ zla ba dri ma med pa'i mdog can/ rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pas dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pa srid pa can mtha' dag tshim par mdzad pa/ snyan gyi thad kar kha 'bus pa'i pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu'i rtsa ba phyag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol bas bzhugs pa/ 'dzum bag dang bcas shing*/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar rab tu yangs ba'i spyan zung rnam par bkra ba la sogs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing*/ dar dkar gyis smad dkris pa/

rgyan thams cad kyis spras shing 'od dang 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i sku can/ shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar/ ri dwags kyis rnyog pa dang bral ba'i bsil zer can gyi gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yas su sgrol ma ljang khu mchog sbyin dang ut+pal 'dzin pa/ lang tsho la bab cing*/ nu ma rgyas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su nor bzang gzhon nu gser gyi mdog can thal mo sbyar ba/ mchan khung g.yon du po ti bcug pa/ byis pa'i rgyan dang cha lugs kyis spras pa/ gtso bo'i g.yon du khro gnyer can ma gser mdog rgyan spangs pa ral ba'i cod pan can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug gu rtse gsum dang*/ spyi blugs bsnams pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ na bza' dmar po gsol ba'o/ /de'i g.yon du rta mgrin dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ lho ba 'phyang zhing*/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing*/ sma ra/ smin ma/ dbu skra gyen du brdzais pa/ dbu'i steng du rta mgo ljang khu dang bcas pa/ g.yas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon pas rdo rje'i dbyug pa dkar po oṃ tshugs su 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'khor bzhi po rnams bzhengs pa dang bzhugs pa sogs zhabs kyi bzhugs stangs ci bde bar bsgom par bya'o/ /rang gi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin par zla ba dmar skya la aḥ snying gar pad+ma dkar po la gnas pa'i zla ba la hūṃ/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'jig rten mgon po'i go 'phang la bkod/ gdod nas grub pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/

thal mo sbug por sbyar ba las gung mo gnyis rtse mor byas shing*/ sor mo gzhan rnams kyang rtse mo cung zad ma reg pa pad+ma kha 'bus pa'i phyag rgya byas la spyan 'dren pa dang*/ mnyes par byed pa dang*/ dam ye bsre ba rnams bya'o/ /slar yang yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ snying ga'i hrīḥyig las rje btsun gyi sku dpag tu med pa spros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rin po che dang*/ bdud rtsi'i char phab/ sems can rnams la chos bstan te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ thams cad kyi thugs kar yang hrīḥyig bsgoms la/ yang de rnams sprul pa dang bcas pa snying gar bsdu ba'i spro bsdu bsgom bzhin du/ oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla bar bya'o/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ 'khor bzhi po rang gi snying gar bsdu zhing*/ rang nyid lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la mnyam par bzhag nas dge ba bsngo/ ci ste mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod na/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /mchod gtor 'bul bar 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi thig le me tog gi tshom bu lnga dang bcas pa/ mdun du mchod yon gyi dung chos/ me tog gi phor ba/ mchod pa sna lnga sogs mchod rdzas rnams dang*/ gtsang zhing bzang ba'i dkar gtor dang bcas pa bshams/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun pa las/ byin dbab kyi sngags/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza me gha pra sa ra sa mu dre hūṃ/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi mahā pra ti sa re rak+ṣa maṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas bsrung ba bya/ oṃ badz+ra re ge hūṃ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri pad+ma dkar po dang*/ zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan bzhi la/

g.yon gyi tha ma la nyi ma/ gzhan rnams la zla ba dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lha lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥgats+tsha bha ga wan maṇ+ḍa la ka singha a sa ne oṃ a/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ taṃ suṃ bh+riṃ haṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes sa bon gyi sngags lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza la li ta na ma mi trer na na mi bha ga wan taṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ pra tīts+tsha ku su ma añdza li na tha ho/ zhes me tog 'thor zhing phyag 'tshal/ sa bon gyi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ lan lngas mchod yon dang*/ yang sa bon kyi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a hā re hūṃ/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang*/ rol mo'i sgras mchod/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa bon gyi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sarba bhu ti kā/ i daṃ bā ling ta swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis 'bul/ bstod pa ci shes pas bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun pa las/ oṃ mu swāhā/ zhes gshegs su gsol sngags so/ /'di'i slob ma rjes bzung ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i cho ga de rnams tshang bar byas nas/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra/ mthar bum pa dang*/ thod pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ me long gi steng du sin+dhu ra bkram pa la chos 'byung hrīḥyig dang bcas pa bris pa rnams/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs lha lngar dpon slob gnyis kar gyis bskyed/ yi ge 'bru gsum mang du bzlas/ slob ma la bum chu sbyin te/ khrus byed du gzhugadri ma rags pa 'khru ba bum dbang gi brda'o/ /thod pa mgo bor gtugs shing*/

bu ram la sogs pa'i ro mngar ba sbyin/ thod pa mi rtog pa dang*/ ro nyams myong mtshon te/ gsang dbang gi brda'o/ /rdo rje snying gar gtugs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod/ kun rdzob kyi rkyen gyis don dam 'gyur ba med pa'i gnas la 'khrid pa/ shes rab ye shes kyi brda'o/ /me long snying gar gtugs la/ sin+dhu ras spyi bor byugs/ me long la gzugs brnyan 'char ba ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa/ chos 'byung stong pa nyid/ hrīḥyig bde ba chen po mtshon te/ dbang bzhi pa'i brda'o/ /zhes slob ma la ngo sprod pa ni khyad par ro/ /dpe med mtsho yi gzhung kuna~X las/ /dga~X' ba'i snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bsdus/ /bdag nyid kyi ni lhag pa'i lhar/ /mos pas cung zad rgyas par phye/ /sgrub thabs 'di sgrub thabs rgya mtsho na'ang bzhugs mod/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lag len dang bcas pa 'di grub chen a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ti'i lugs kyi sbyor drug dang brgyud pa gcig pa'i zur bka' khyad par can lags so/ /spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pa ṇa lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༈ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga yi/ /tshogs bcas gus pas btud bcas te/ /a ti sha yi gzhung bzhin bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ spro na gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs te/ bdun rnam dag bya/

shū n+ya ta sa stongs par sbyangs/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ/ suṃ las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba der hrīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ phyag dang po gnyis pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin zhing kha 'byed pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis bgrang 'phreng dang*/ ghun+dhe 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa dang*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje'i lte bar pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las lha mo bzhi spros te phyogs kyi 'dab mar 'khod pa ni/ shar du ha las rdo rje zhags pa ma zhags pa dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ lho ru traṃ las rdo rje rin chen ma nor bu dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub tu hrīḥlas ral gcig ma pad+ma dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ byang du ṭa las khro gnyer ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang/ ghun+dhe bsnams pa/ sku mdog cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /ye shes dgug gzhug spyi dang 'dra/ dbang bskur yang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ yum bzhi'i dbang bskur/ rigs bdag rgyas gdab mi dgos/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dran par byas nas bzlas pa bya ste/ snying gar 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte ba dang rtsibs la nye snying bkod/ mu khyud la rtsa ba'i sngags bsgom ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ke te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tsakra warti tsin+ta ma ṇi mahā pad+ma ru ru tiṣ+ṭha dz+wa la/ a kar+ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ bha ra ta pad+me hūṃ/ zhes nye snying gang nus bzlas la/ snying po bzla ba la mos na/ oṃ pad+ma tsin+ta ma ṇi dz+wa la hūṃ/ zhes bzla'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ji lta ba bzhin yin la/ sngon sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i nang na bzhugs pa/

bar skabs su logs su gar ba yin gsung*/ sa steng kuna~X tu rnyed dka' ba/ /rab dga~X' 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /snyinga~X nas gus pa chen po~X yis/ /bsgrubs na 'phral du don chen 'grub/ /spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon po thugs rje'i gter/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /de sras mi tra dzo gi'i bzhed/ /mdor bsdus byin rlabs bla med bri/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang skad cig gi jo bo kha sar+pa ni sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon gdan la brten pas pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ sku las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis don byas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mjug tu dge ba bsngos la/ thun mtshams lha'i nga rgyal bya/ gtor chog ni/ mdun du skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs bzhugs par gyur/ gtor snod rin po che'i snod du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum brjod pas gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ shrī lo ka nā tha sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ 'dod don gsol ba btab la/ mi dmigs par sbyangs/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ tsan+da dkar po'i sa dkar gyi byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su me tog dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ gzhan sgrub tshul rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra/ bstod pa'ang spyan ras gzigs spyi'i rigs 'gre/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs gsol btab dang*/ rgyun bshags gur bzhin bya/ slob ma kha sar+pa ṇir bskyed pa la/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas/

jo bo dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pas spros nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bstim pa nyid/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang yin no/ /de nas bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin la rjes zlos lan brgya rtsa bya'o/ /rjes sogs spyi dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs kuna~X las zab pa yi/ /sems nyid ngal gso dga~X' bskyed 'di/ /snyinga~X nas spro med la dga' ba'i/ /lha'i rnal 'byor zab por snang*/ sems nyid ngal gso'i sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /btud nas gsang ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mi tra dzo ga'i man ngag bzhin/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig ye ger 'god/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung 'khor gyi nang chos 'byung gi dbus su 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor gzhal yas khang*/ dbus su pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jig rten mgon po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis yid tsam khro ba spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang*/ g.yon pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs*/ de la 'khyud pa'i yum gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo ḍa ma ru dang thod khrag 'dzin pa rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ phyi skor du/ thub pa 'jam dpal 'od dpag med/ /phyag rdor shes rab pha rol phyin/ /sgrol ma dang ni rig byed ma/ khro gnyer can sogs dpag yas bzhugs/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ yab yum gnyis ka la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ rang gi lte ba dang*/ yum gyi mkha' nang du dga' 'khyil gyi lte bar gtso bo yab yum/

lag bzhi la mkha' 'gro ma bzhi/ de g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems gtad de 'gog pa'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūṃ/ 'bum phrag bcu bzhi bzla'o/ / ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ / sogs dang*/ bde stong gnyis su med pa yi/ /gsang ba ye shes la 'dud do/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mthar snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor la bsdu/ de yang 'od gsal du bstim/ thun 'tshams su lha skur langs te dge ba bsngo/ gtor chog ni/ bla med spyi dang 'dra ba las/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pas 'bul/ 'di la dbang chog rgyas pa sbyor ba'i srol yang byung zhing*/ rgya ston gyis kyang byin rlabs kyi cho ga rgyas pa zhig mdzad na'ang*/ de dag rnying ma sogs gzhan nas bsres par gda'/ 'di'i rang lugs byin rlabs ni/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge bdun pa mi tri'i lugs nyid 'dod pa spos pas bya ba nyid do/ /kun tu zab par rab bsngags shing*/ /rab dga~X'i dang pa skyed byed pa/ /'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /yang snyinga~X gsal po~Xr bkod 'di mtshar/ /rje btsun mi tra dzo gi'i lugs 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal stong rtsa dang*/ /sangs rgyas stong gi sprul pa'i gzhi/ /nam mkha'i rgyal por rab grags pa/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun/ stong nyid bsam zhing swa bhā wa brjod cing*/ snying rje dung ba bsgom/ pad zla la hrīḥlas rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nam mkha'i rgyal po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/

rtsa zhal gsum dkar la zhi ba/ de steng gsum ser la bzhad pa/ de'i steng gnyis mthing nag khros pa/ de'i steng gnyis dmar smug mche ba gtsigs pa/ de rnams spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ kun gyi steng na 'od dpag med kyi zhal lo/ /chos sku'i rtsa phyag bcu las dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma g.yas pa'i mu tig gi 'phreng ba/ 'khor lo/ mchog sbyin/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs/ g.yon pas pad+ma spyi blugs/ rin po che/ mda' gzhu sbrags pa'o/ /yan lag gi phyag sum cu rtsa brgyad las/ g.yas rnams rin chen zhags pa lhung bzed ral gri rdo rje rgya gram chu shel me shel gzhu ser po/ /lcug ma rnga yab phub dang bum pa dgra sta 'phreng ba pad sngon ghun+dhe'i nyi ma dkar po'o/ /g.yon rnams sprin dkar ral pa pad ser ral gri dung dang thod dbyug 'phreng ba dril bu rdo rje dang*/ /lcags kyu bsil yab sprul sku khang bzang glegs bam 'khor lo sbrul gzugs dgun 'bru pad dmar nor bu'o/ /nying lag gi phyag stong rtsa gnyis mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan mnga' ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa/ phrag pa la gzar ba/ dar dang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar gyur/ longs sku dang sprul sku'i zhing khams thams cad du 'gro don mdzad par bsam/ bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ mgrin sngon can gyi gzungs ci rigs par 'don/ de 'dzin dka' na/ phal cher bod skad du ston kyang rung la/ de yang ma grags pas mi shes na/ yig drug kho nas kyang chog ste/ 'di'i sngags kyi gtso bo'ang yin pas/ ma ṇi nyid ci nus su 'don no/ /mthar rtsa bral gyi ngang la blo bzhagathun 'tshams thams cad du sku gsung thugs kyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar bya/ mchod pa byed par 'dod na khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/

bris sku'am lugs sku'i mdun du mchod gtor gtsang sbra rgya cher bshams/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ ma lus sems can sogs kyi spyan 'dren/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa sogs mchod yon/ khrus gsol bzhugs gsol rnams bya/ mchod yon phal cher sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs dang*/ dus gsum bde bar sogs kyis bstod cing*/ gzhan yang mtshan brgya sogs ci nus su klog go /gtor ma nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes phud gtso bo la zur tsam bsngos la/ lhag ma a kā ra ོ'i sngags kyis 'byung po thams cad la sbyin/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ sku gzugs la ye dharmas rab gnas bya/ mgron rnams ya hi zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i bdag bskyed mdun bskyed sngon du song nas/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ bzang spyod ltar yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gang 'os phog nas/ sgom lung sbyin pa kho nas chog go /'di'i sgrub thabs rgyal po bka' 'bum na'ang bzhugs mod kyi/ deng sang de'i srol 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ 'di'i lag len cung mi 'dra bar snang ngo*/ /'phrul snang 'phags pa'i chos skor 'di/ /bod chos kuna~X gyi thog mar grags/ /'di la dga~X' mgu yi rang bas/ /bsgrubs na snyinga~X po~X'i don mchog 'grub/ /spyan ras gzigs nam mkha'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi /sgrub thabs ngo mtshar dga' ba'i tog/yid bzhin nor bu 'khor los bsgyur/ /'don thabs bdag gis bshad par bya/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus su nyams su len par 'dod pas/

sangs rgyas chos dang sogs lan gsum bya/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rang sems hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ de'i steng du khro zhal sngon po/ steng zhal 'od dpag med kyi zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ g.yon gyi 'khor lo thugs kar gtod pa/ zhabs mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥde las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥyig gi mthar/ gzungs sngags gsal btab ste/ gzungs bzlas pas de'i 'od zer gyis mdun du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs brgyud bskul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas phyir 'phros/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i gzungs la thim par bsam/ oṃ tsin+ta ma ṇi tsakra warti ma ṇi pad+me a hrīḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rtsa sngags so/ / oṃ pad+ma bha ra ta ke āḥhrīḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po'o/ /de ltar ci nus su bzlas nas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams rang la bstim pa'am/ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs su gsol/ dge ba bsngo/ shin tu bsdus par na/ rang spyan ras gzigs su gsal btab nas/ sngags bzlas pas kyang rung ngo*/ /'di'i bzlas lung la sngon du maṇ+ḍal mchod pa grub na legs/ ma grub kyang 'gal ba med do/ /dngos gzhi ni maṇ+ḍal phul/ gong du bshad pa'i mngon rtogs kyi dmigs pa rnams 'bogs pa yin pa la/ slob ma spyan ras gzigs su sgom du bcugaspyan 'dren gdan 'bul/ mchod bstod rnams la rjes zlos byed/ bzlas pa'i dod du bzlas lung ster ba yin no/

/sgrub thabs kuna~X las ches dkon pa'i/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo dga~X' ba'i tog/mchog gyur snyinga~X po~X'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /byin rlabs bla na med pa yin/ /spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /bcu gcig zhal 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrub thabs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ snying rje chen po kun dngos grub/ /mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshul/ /de la gus pas btud byas nas/ /'jigs pa kun sel sgrub thabs bshad/ /'phags pa bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi sgrub thabs dang 'dra ba las/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs bzhin las/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la hrīḥyig re re las/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs brgyad du gyur pa ni/ shar du me'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa dkar po/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang rnga yab/ g.yon pad+ma dang chu shel 'dzin pa/ lho ru chu'i 'jigs skyob dkar po/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang rin po che/ g.yon pad+ma dang 'khor lo/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang*/ phyag dang po gnyis skyabs sbyin dang pad+ma kho nar shes pa/ nub tu seṅge 'jigs skyob ser po nor bu dang po ti/ byang du glang po'i 'jigs skyob dmar ser ut+pal dang me shel/ shar lhor chad pa'i 'jigs skyob dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ lho nub tu klu'i 'jigs skyob ljang khu rgyal mtshan dang ghun+dhe can chu srin la gnas pa/ nub byang du mkha' 'gro'i 'jigs skyob nag po rtse gsum dang ba dan can/ byang shar du mi rgod 'jigs skyob dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu/ de thams cad kyang khro bo'i nyams can/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs can no/ /

mngon rtogs kyi lhag ma dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi dpal mo lugs ji lta ba bzhin du bya/ 'di la gtor chog mi dgos/ rjes gnang yang mi dgos te lung tsam gyis 'grub bo/ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go ma'i bzhed par grags pa/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i lugs kyi man ngag go /'jigs pa kuna~X las skyob pa yi/ /sgrub thabs mchog tu nyams dga~X'i gnas/ /yig snying rgyas pa'i tshigs chen gyis/ /snyinga~X po~X bsdus pa 'di tsam lags/ /bcu gcig zhal 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang zhig bsgoms shing bzlos pa yis/ /dkor dang sbags pa'i nyes pa sogs/ /kun 'joms spyan ras gzigs kyi ni/ /sgrub thabs dam pa bshad par bya/ /thun gyi mgor sdig bshags gang 'grub dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis jo bo spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar la zhal dbus ma lnga brtsegs shin tu khros pa sngon po/ g.yas gsum brtsegs dkar ba dang*/ g.yon gsum brtsegs dmar ba zhi ba/ phyag dang po gnyis sngon po thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ gzhan rnams dkar ba'i gnyis pa gnyis rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang pad+ma dmar po/ gsum pa gnyis 'khor lo dang mda' gzhu/ bzhi pa gnyis lcags kyu dang me dpung bsnams pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na mnyam par bzhengs pa/ mtshan nyid gzhan spyi dang mthun/ snying gar hrīḥyig la sngags gsum rim du bskor bar bsams nas/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ dang*/ na mo rat+na trā yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ badz+ra sa ra pra mar+dha ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭ+ṭe/ waṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ sarba kle sha sarba karma a wa ra ṇa ni/ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bi shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ ga ga na swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe swāhā/

zhes pa rnams ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /'jug tu stong pa nyid kyi don bsgom/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di ni mi tra dzo gi'i gdams ngag ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor gzhan thob pa la lung gis 'grub pa'o/ /sdig sgrib sbyang bar kun tu bsngags/ /bsrung ba kuna~X las dga~X' ba'i tog/'di la nyams len snyinga~X po~Xr bgyis/ /byin rlabs bla med yod par nges/ /spyan ras gzigs rdo rje snying po rab tu 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la btud nas/ /nad kun sel mdzad seng ge'i sgra'i/ /sgrub thabs cung zad bri bar bya/ /'dir slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i gzhung dang*/ gzungs mdo chung ngu la brten pa'i lag len zur bkar grags pa/ sa lugs dang*/ dpyal lugs so sor thob mod kyi/ don gcig tu 'du zhing*/ sa lugs la yang lo chen rin bzang nas brgyud pa la thun mong ba zer zhing*/ hang du dkar po la mal los zhus pa'i lugs tshogs bsags bcu gsum sogs byed pa 'di la thun mong ma yin pa zer ba'i brda chad mdzad kyin 'dug cing*/ rjes gnang yang so sor ma byas na mi rung ba ltar byed mod/ lha sngags dang cho ga'i dngos gzhi la mi 'dra ba cang med pas/ 'dir gcig tu bsdom ste bshad par bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥde'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ phyir 'phros te rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma dang*/ rje btsun seng ge sgra 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka singha na de bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twe bh+yaḥ oṃ sidha na da sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs lan gsum/

tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du/ ming las seng ge dkar po nyal stabs mgo g.yas su phyogs shing*/ gdong pa gyen du phyogs pa ral pa dmar ser thur du 'phyang zhing rin po che'i dra bas g.yogs pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba la hrīḥdakar po re las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥthim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas kyi steng du brkyang zhing*/ g.yon rgyab kyi char gdan la brten pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis zhugs pa/ rgyan spangs pa dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang ldan pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs dang*/ ri dwags nag po'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ sku'i g.yas logs su tri shu la ljang khu la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa dang*/ g.yon logs su pad+ma'i steng du thod pa me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang*/ pad dkar gyi sdong po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi ral gri me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la hrīḥde las 'od 'phros/ rjes btsun seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / zhes pa nas/

shrī ye hūṃ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ spyi gtsug tu rnam snang*/ dpung pa g.yas la mi bskyod pa/ g.yon la 'od dpag med/ dpyi g.yas par rin 'byung*/ g.yon par don grub rnams sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing bzhugs par gyur/ bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsidha na da hūṃ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā sa twāya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭe ka ro ṭe/ bid+ye swāhā/ zhes pa gzungs te/ ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /mthar lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs te stong pa la mnyam par gzhagaslar yang lha'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba bsngos nas/ thun 'tshams la 'jug go /'di la bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mchod nas gshegs gsol byed pa ni/ grub mtha'i zhen du dmigs nas byas par zad kyi/ 'di nyid kyi man ngag rnying pa rnams la'ang med la/ don la dgos pa'ang ma yin no/ /rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ nā ro pa'i man ngag gi lugs de dang mthun par byas na gcig shos zhor la thob par 'gyur ba yin pas/ de bzhin bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po tshom bu can zhig bya/ phyogs gang yang rung bar bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ mchod pa dang dkar gtor gang 'os sgrigabadag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bum pa dang bcas pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal gyi steng dang*/ bum pa'i nang du paṃ las zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar gong bzhin ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi 'jigs thogs med seng ge'i khri steng du/ /rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes/ /sku mdog dkar gsal gangs ri'i phung po 'dra/ /rje btsun seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/

/bdud kyi g.yul bzlog spyan dmar mtshan dpes spras/ /chos sku stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu la/ /gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don du cir yang sprul/ /dpa' bo seng ge sgra la= 'gre/ phyag g.yas rtse gsum rgyal rigs sbrul gyis dkris/ /g.yon na thod pa ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub blo stsol ba'i/ /dam pa skyes mchog khyod la= sku las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga spro zhing*/ /slob dpon 'od dpag med pas dbu la brgyan/ /spyan gsum gzigs pas sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad/ /rje btsun thugs rje can la= skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /grong gi cha dang yul ljongs spangs pa'i sar/ /bag med nyal dang spyod lam thams cad du/ /rje btsun khyed kyis thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ / ces bstod cing gsol ba btab nas/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ bum pa'i lha la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de gnyis la thun mong du/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gzungs ring gi swāhā'i gong du bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi bcug pa lan lngas mdun bskyed dang bum pa gnyis char la dmigs nas 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ chos sku mnyam nyid ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi ba'i phyir/ /klu 'dul byams pa'i rang bzhin gzugs skur bstan/ /'phags pa seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ mchod yon phul bas bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu bar bsam/ spro na klu gtor/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma cha gsum dang bcas pa rnams btang*/ slob ma'i bya ba ni rjes gnang gi ngo bo sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i chings de nyid dang mthun pa las/ thog mar bgegs gtor btang*/ bkru byabs bsrung gsum byed sku'i rjes gnang gi mthar mngon rtogs ltar dbang bskur/ slob dpon gyi sku'i rigs lnga las rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spros te bstim/

bzlas lung gis skabs snying gar sa bon gyi mthar snying po dang*/ de'i mthar gzungs kyis bskor ba/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas slob ma'i snying gar spro ba'i dmigs pa byed/ cho ga lhag ma spyi dang 'dra/ thun mong bar grags pa'i rjes gnang ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang du ming 'dogs bsgyur ba ma gtogs/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings kho na bzhin no/ /zab mor grags shing grub pa yi/ /man ngag yi ge kuna~X mthong nas/ /dga~X' ba'i yid kyis snyinga~X po~X tsam/ /bsdus la nyes skyon med par sems/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs seng ge'i sgra'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon la btud byas te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i chos skor ni/ /shin tu mang yang de'i snying po/ /zab la 'dril ba cung zad bshad/ /skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa dang bcas sngon du btang*/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs nas/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /snying rje dung ba bsgom ste/ kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /pad zla la rang sems hrīḥyig bsgom ste/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de las rang nyid spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og ma mu tig dmar po'i 'phreng ba/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dmar po bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ spyi bor sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ thugs kar rta mgrin rdo rje 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lte bar gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan can no/ / lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur tsam byed/ rgyas btab rang chas su yod pas byed mi dgos so/

/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ dhu ma gha ye na ma ha ri ni sa/ ra tsa hrīḥya/ zhes bzlas pa bya/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis/ bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ a kā ro sa 'bul/ bdag bskyed la yang gtor 'bul dgos gsung*/ 'di'i byin brlab ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rten pad+ma 'dab bzhi tshom bu can la bum pa bcud ldan dang thod pa chang gis gang ba/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sngags can/ rdo rje rnams brtsegs te bzhagabadag mdun dbyer med bzlas pa dang bcas pa song nas/ gtor ma 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po ni/ /'od dpag med pas dbu la brgyan/ khro bo'i mkha' 'gro las la bskul/ /phyag 'tshal byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / ces bstod/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ maṇ+ḍal dbus kyi lhas bum pa'i dbang bskur bar bsam la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod/ thod pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyis byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes nang mchod sbyin/ sin+dhu ra 'i lhas rig ma gtad cing*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma hūṃ zhes me long snying gar gtugs/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya zhes brjod cing*/ sin+dhu ra gnas bzhir byugs rdo rje bstan te/ sems snang stong brjod bral dbang bzhi pa'i don du ngo sprad/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ byin rlabs kyi rjes su bsgom/ lung re gnang ba'i srol kyang gda'o/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang chog chen mo yang thos mod kyi/ snying po 'di kho na ngo mtshar che ba yin gsung*/ sgrub thabs 'di'i lugs tha dad pa phal cher gyi yi ge sna re re snang zhing*/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni bla ma'i gsung las byung ba'o/

/dbang sdud lha rnams kuna~X gyi phul/ /rab dga~X' sems kyis 'bad nas zhus/ /gzhan la med pa snyinga~X po~X'i don/ /sgang ste dril nas gnang ba yin/ /spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho bde gshegs bzhi sgril du grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te drug pa'o/ /zhus dag/maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi las sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ 'jigs pa kun las skyob mdzad cing*/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /yid la bsam pa'i don kun stsol/ /sgrol ma de la phyag 'tshal bdud/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur pa/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du tāṃ ljang khu/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ rnam smin brdos bcas dang sdig sgrib lhan cig tu sbyangs/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i rtsa ba bzung ba snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pa'i bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tāṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

phyag dang mchod pa yid la bya zhing ngag nas mi brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ lha sku la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la mnyam par bzhagabazlas pa ni/ tāṃ gi mthar skor du yi ge bcu pas bskor bar bsgom la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyis bskor ba gsal btab la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bho dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re sarba duṣ+taṃ/ pra duṣ+taṃ/ ma ma kṛ te/ dzaṃ bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+taṃ staṃ bha ni tā re swāhā/ zhes pa'ang ci 'grub tu bzla/ thun 'jog khar/ ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dge ba bsngo/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o/ /yang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'don na/ dam tshig pa gong ltar bskyed pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis ye shes lha mo mdun du spyan drangs phyag mchod 'bul/ skyabs sbyin gyi 'og tu bdag dang bsrung bya rnams tshud par byas la/ phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i skabs su yid kyis phyag 'tshal bar mos/ bstod pa gang nus 'don/ rjes gong dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i bzlas lung byed thabs ni/ sgrol ma'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang rung zhig gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ chos skyong dang cha gsum sogs 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'ang ci rigs su bsham mo/ /mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas kyang rung*/ skad cig gis oṃ las byung ba'i mchod par mos pa tsam byas nas/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis chog/stong par sbyangs pa nas/ bzlas pa grub kyi bar bya/ mdun bskyed kyang bdag bskyed 'don pa spos pas chog

ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sogs bstod pa gang shes kyis bstod/ gsol btab ci shes kyis gsol ba btab/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa bya/ 'grub na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas par 'bogs/ ma 'grub na sangs rgyas chos dang ma lan gsum bya/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ / zhes sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ mngon rtogs bzhin sgom lung phogasngags kyis bzlas lung tsam sbyin pa nyid kyis 'grub par yin no/ /'di ni bzlas lung la brten pa'i sgrub thabs zhes gsung ngo*/ /sngon dus kuna~X nas ches dar yang*/ /deng sang phal cher nub pa dang*/ /gzhan gyi rigs 'gres slad mthong nas/ /dga~X' bas snyinga~X po~Xr sgril 'di'o/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi las sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ maṅgalaṃ/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'phongs skyob 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ /gus pas btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /gzhung bzhin mdor bsdus bri bar bya/ /'di la paṇa chen shrī'i gsung rgyun gyi man ngag khro phu bas mdzad pa dang*/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad po gung spros pa'i snying po ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la tāṃ/ de'i 'od kyis 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ mchod 'os thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'phags ma'i dbu gtsugs tu bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pa can du bzhugs par gyur/ yid kyis mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ dngos su nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ swa bhā wa sa sngags 'don dang*/ shū n+ya ta 'i sngags 'don bsam/ pad zla la rang sems tāṃ las ut+pal taṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu/

mchog sbyin/ ut+pal can/ g.yas brkyang ba'i phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' tāṃ/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab spyi dang 'dra ste/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ ye shes sems dpa' nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ mchod bstod ma byas na/ skabs 'dir mchod bstod bya/ snying ga'i tāṃ gi 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par bsgyur/ 'od zer spro bsdu dang snang stong sgyu ma lta bu la mnyam par bzhagayi ge bcu pa do li'i bzlas pas bya'o/ /thun 'jog pa na mchod bstod kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dge ba bsngo zhing dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams la 'jug go /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ phal cher spyi dang 'dra ba las/ bum pa zhig bca'/ mdun bskyed kyi mthar/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa'i dbus su sgrol ma bdag bskyed ltar bskyed/ gzungs thag btags te sngags bzlas pas/ sku las bdud rtsi dang sngags kyi yig 'bru'i tshogs byung*/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang gcig tu 'dres par gyur par bsam/ 'jug tu mchod bstod/ mchod yon phul bas/ sgrol ma sngags kyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa 'od du zhu/ dag pa ye shes kyi chur gyur par bsam/ de nas slob ma'i bya ba ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol btab dang*/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ sku'i rjes gnang gi gzhug tu/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur dmigs pa mngon rtogs bzhin 'bogs/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi phyag mtshan bstim pa'i rjes la/ mngon rtogs ltar gzhan don snod bcud sbyangs pa dang*/ 'od zer spro bsdu dang*/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bu la mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug

go /sgrol ma kuna~X tu zhal gzigs pa/ /shākya shrī'i man ngag ni/ /mchog tu dga~X' ba lugs gnyis kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X bsdus pa 'di ltar lags/ /sgrol ma sngo ljang kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'chi med rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe/ /gang la brten nas myur 'grub pa/ /sgrol ma dkar mo la btud de/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bri bar bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po/ dbus su pad dkar 'dab brgyad rab tu rgyas pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ las rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sku can du gyur/ 'dab ma brgyad la lus dang grib ma'i tshul du rang dang 'dra ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo brgyad zhal nang du bstan pa/ 'khor gyi tshul can/ rang gi thugs kar a las zla ba la taṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzi wan+tā ye swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla/ 'khor thams cad kyi sngags kyang bzlos par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe'i bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/

kha che paṇa chen nyid kyi lugs sgrol ma ljang khu'i rjes gnang nyid 'dod pa spos pas chog go/ /kuna~X dang thun mong ma yin pa/ /paṇa chen bzhed tshul dga~X' ba'i tog/sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X mdor bsdus 'di/ tshe sgrub zab pa'i mthar thug lags/ /sgrol dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*/ / sgrol ma zhi khro la btud nas/ /nyin zhi mtshan khro sgrub pa'i thabs/ /lag len ngag 'don gsal bor bkod/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi mdun du sdong po dang bcas pa'i pad gdan dang*/ zla ba la hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ pad+ma thugs kar kha phye ba'i steng du tāṃ las rje btsun ma sgrol ma zhi ba/ rang nyid la dgyes pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa/ puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi te 'i bar gyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags tshar gsum/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gcigayid kyis gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rje btsun ma rang nyid la thim/ rang nyid sgrol ma zhi ba ljang sngon/ g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dbu skra phyed g.yon par bcings shing g.yas cung zad 'phyang ba/ spyi bo na zla ba tshes pa'i steng du 'od dpag med kyis mtshan pa'o/ / bstod pa tshar gnyis bton te/ rang nyid lhar gsal drag tu btab/ bstod sgrub tu byed na/ lha la dmigs nas slar tshar lnga bton pas mdun du 'gyur la/ de nyid thun bzhi la sogs par sgom pa ni ma mtha' yin la/ bstod pa ji tsam mang ba de bzang ba yin no/ /bzlas pa la mos na man ngag ltar dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /rjes spyan ras gzigs la mchod bstod zhig byas la dge ba bsngo/ mtshan mo gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las/

pad+ma thugs kar kha phye ba'i steng du/ hūṃ las rje btsun ma sgrol ma khro ma ོ zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun ma bdag la thim pas/ rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo lhag par khros pa spyan gsum skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sa la brdeb cing thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ gzigs lpags kyi sha 'gag can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul ljang khu'i se ral kha 'phyang ba/ spyi bo na zla tshes kyi steng du 'od dpag med kyis mtshan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na pad nyi la/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes dang*/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ oṃ na ma tā re/ na maḥha re hūṃ ha re swāhā/ zhes bzla ba rnams khyad par ro/ /gtor ma ji ltar 'byor ba zhig bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs tāṃ las sgrol ma zhi ba/ hūṃ las sgrol ma khro mo rnams skad cig tsam gyis gsal btab ste/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ zhi khro'i sngags gnyis po sbrel ba'i mthar/ a ka ro btags pa/ lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab ste badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gsum mchod gtor dang bcas pa bsham/ slob dpon gyis gong du bshad pa ltar zhi khro gnyis kar gyi sgrub pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa bya/ slob ma rjes gnang 'bogs pa'i ngo bo sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang dang 'dra ba las/ thog mar sgrol ma zhi ba'i mngon rtogs gong ltar phogade nas sgrol ma khro mo'i mngon rtogs phogade bzhin du rjes su bzlas ba'i lung gnyis rim pas phogadam bca' ba'i lung man chad gcig gis chog par bya'o/ /chos skor kuna~X la ches bsdus shing*/ /ma tshang med pa yid dga~X'i gnas/ /bdag snyinga~X ya mtshan cher skyes te/ /gsal po~Xr bskyigs pa e ma ho/

/sgrol ma nyi zhi mtshan khro'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ srid gsum sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*/ /zhing gi dbang phyug dpa' mo'i tshul/ /sgrol ma la 'dud de'i sgrub thabs/ /o rgyan las byung rim pa bshad/ /'di la sngon 'gro rgyas par bsgom na/ tshogs bsog rnam gnyis spyi dang mthun par bya/ bsdu na skyabs sems sngon du song ste/ shū n+ya ta sa stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ de'i nang du e las chos 'byung gi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma/ de'i steng du tāṃ las ut+pal dmar po tāṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas nag g.yon ljang*/ steng zhal ser ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis cang te/ thod khragaral gri/ rdo rje/ g.yon rnams kyis ut+pa la/ nor bu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gadril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ phyag rgya lnga rnams kyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ sgeg cing khro la skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /spyi bor bh+ruṃ dkar po/ mgrin par hrīḥdamar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar a ser po/brla gnyis la khaṃ ljang khu/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis u rgyan gyi gnas nas/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ nai we ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra u da kaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ pu ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ nang gi dbang bzhi thob/

rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra dha tī shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ*/ oṃ satwa badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa bh+ruṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ oṃ dharma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūṃ phaṭa ces ci 'grub bzla/ thun 'jug tu lha sku 'od gsal du bcug ste dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma bde mchog ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ u rgyan gyis gnas nas/ rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha sarba duṣ+taṃ i maṃ bā ling gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma sarba kar+yan sādha ya sādha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes lan bdun gyis 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ o ḍi ya ṇar rnam 'phrul zhing/ /rab 'phrul gzhan du'ang kun 'phrul la/ /gnas rnams kun la dbang mdzad ma/ /gnas kyi dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /sku las rgyal ba'i sprul pa 'phro/ /gsung gi rig sngags 'brug ltar sgrog/kun tu khyab pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ / don kun yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub kun/ / bdag la nye bar stsal du gsol/ /

yig brgya bzla/ bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i rgya gzhung rnams na/ phyi dkyil dang*/ lus dkyil gyi dbang chog sogs sna tshogs pa yod kyang*/ da ltar bka' mi bzhugs so/ /dpa' mo gcig pa 'di la brda'i dbang gi byin rlabs tsam yin te/ de yang maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa/ mchod gtor nang mchod sogs bsham/ bum pa/ thod chang*/ chos 'byung*/ me long ste rdzas bzhi po de stegs bu gzhan zhig la bkod/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar song nas/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ bzlas pa ci grub zhig byas nas/ gtor ma 'bul tshul yang gong bzhin rdzas bzhi po de la gzungs thag btags nas/ bum pa la dmigs nas snying po brgya rtsa/ gzhan gsum la dmigs nas 'bru gsum brgya rtsa re re bzla/ dmigs pa cang mi dgos/ de nas bum pa sogs rdzas bzhi po de la dar ram ras dmar po bkab bo/ /slob ma'i bya ba ni/ 'di la rjes gnang gi tha snyad ni mi mdzad na'ang*/ gsol btab yan lag bdun pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung*/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung rnams rjes gnang dkyus dang 'dra ba zhig bya/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul la rdzas bzhi po'i khebs bsal te/ mngon rtogs kyi dbang bskur gyi dmigs pa de phog la/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ khrus kyang byar bcugabum dbang ngo*/ /nang mchod sbyin/ gsang dbang gi brda'o/ /chos 'byung bstan/ sher dbang gi brda'o/ /me long bstan te/ dbang bzhi pa'i brda'o/ /lhag ma rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X las khyad 'phags sgrub thabs 'di/ /rab dga~X'i zhing mchog u rgyan nas/ /byung zhing mtshan yang de ltar grags/ /snyinga~X po~X'i sgrub thabs mdo tsam spel/ /u rgyan sgrol ma gnas kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /sgrol ma/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje ldan ma/

grub thob pa ra he ta/ bin te bha tra/ saṃ gha ma shrī/ sgeg pa rdo rje/ shākya rdo rje/ mngon pa dbang phyugabartson 'grus/ 'phags pa/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gser mdog gser gyi 'od 'phro ba/ /nor sbyin nor gyi dbang mo'i tshul/ /sgrol mdzad 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ /bdag cag bdag don min par 'dud/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying gar tāṃ/ de'i 'od kyis rje btsun ma 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ swa bhā wa brjod pas de thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgom/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du briṃ las dpag bsam shing gi yal ga briṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu sku mdog ser mo lang tsho la bab pa/ g.yon ngos su brten pa'i dpag bsam shing gi yal ga las phyag g.yon pas yid bzhin nor bu'i 'bras bu 'thog par mdzad cing*/ g.yas pas sems can la sbyin pa'i tshul gyis bsnams pa/ pad zla'i gdan la sgeg pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ snying gar zla ba la briṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ briṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa dbang gi lha dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes gsungs shing*/ dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ rang mtshungs kyi sku dpag tu med par sprul nas/ sems can rnams kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /'jug tu dge ba bsngo zhing*/ oṃ muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam bya'o/ /mchod chog ni/

maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa tshom bu can mchod gtor gtsang mas bskor ba zhig bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i ri rab lhun por gyur/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma nas dbu brgyan kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin lha mo bskyed/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar nas phul/ sna tshogs chu skyes bsil zer can steng briṃ las byung ba'i lha mo ni/ /dpag med gzi ldan gzhon sgeg nyi ma'i 'od 'dra rgyan rnams kyis spras pa/ /nyes pa'i skyon spangs srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol zhing de'i re skong phyir/ /'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu zhes grags de yis sgrub po bdag skyongs shig/ gzhan yang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sogs bstod pa ci shes kyis bstod/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re dha naṃ me de hi swāhā/ zhes gang 'os bzla zhing 'dod don gsol ba drag tu btab/ dha naṃ gi gnas su dmigs gsal yod na de'i ming 'jugagator ma bsang sbyangs/ skad cig gis pad+ma'i dbyibs can rin po che'i gtor snod yangs par gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'phags ma 'khor 'jig rten skyong ba dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod yul gyi gtso bo dang 'phags ma gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ a kā ro lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ gong gi sngags dang bcas pas 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ bsnyen pa song nas gong gi las sngags dang bcas pa'i rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg kyang ci 'grub bya'o/ /rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas sgrub tshul ni/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i bdag mdun de nyid yin la/ las sngags kyis gsol ba 'debs pa lan gnyis po de mi dgos/

rjes gnang dngos gzhi ni sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung*/ thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa rnams yin te/ rjes gnang spyi dang khyad par med la/ rjes chog kyang spyi dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /mi kuna~X nor sgrub la dga~X' yang*/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog sgrub pa nyung*/ /paṇa chen rat+na rak+ṣi ta'i/ /'tsho ba'i snyinga~X po~X e ma ho/ sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //der rgyas 'phel/ 'di'i brgyud pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ su tsa ri ta/ ā nan+dā ka ra gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ ti kirti shrī bha dra bod/ / ༄༅/ /oṃswā sti/ rgyal ba thams cad bskyed mdzad yum/ /lha mo sgrol ma la btud nas/ /dmar mo dbang bsdud sgrub thabs ni/ /cung zad bdag gis bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang ste/ shū n+ya ta sa stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems a las zla ba dmar po'i steng du tāṃ las ut+pal tāṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid sgrol ma dmar mo bzhad cing chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yas lcags kyu pus mo'i steng du 'dzin zhing*/ g.yo ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu snyan gyi thad kar kha bye zhing rtsa ba zhags pa'i rnam pa can thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /snying gar zla ba la hrīḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ snying gar ut+pal dang zla ba la sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re saṃ tā re ṇī hriḥswā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla zhing 'bum phrag bco lngas bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas oṃ tā re tut+tā re saṃ tā re ṇī ye che ge mo dbang du bsdus shigarat+na sid+dhi wa shaṃ ku ru hrīḥswāhā/

zhes las sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas te/ bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yin no/ / thun mtshams su lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs te dge ba bsngo/ dkar gtor dang me tog dmar po la sogs pa'i mchod pa bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du oṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sgrol ma 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod/ 'dod chags rnam dag lha mo ni/ /dbang gi lha mo dpal chen mo/ / 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma de la gus pas 'dud/ / ces bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ rnams spyi dang 'dra/ tshul de'i sgo nas bsnyen pa mthar phyin na/ 'khor lo 'ba' zhig la brten pa dang*/ mchod rten bca' ba la sogs pa dbang gi las tshogs sgrub par bya ste/ dbang bsdud gzhan las stobs che zhing bkra shis pa yin no/ /yang lugs gcig la gtor sngags gnyan sgrol gyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba dang 'dra ba las/ sarba pi saṃ ri 'i tshab tu/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re che ge mo wa shaṃ ma na ya swāhā/ zhes btags pa'i lugs kyang yod/ ngag dbang grags pa'i man ngag la skad cig gis bskyed pa dang*/ rdo rje'i skyil krung phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon me tog dmar po 'od rnon po can 'dzin par bsgom pa ni khyad par ro/ / 'di rdo rje gdan pa bsod nams 'byung gnas dang*/ ngag dbang grags pa'i man ngag gung spros pa/ gnyan lots+tsha ba'i gdams pa'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ rjes gnang gi bya ba spyi dang mtshungs shing*/ khyad par rje gnang gi gzhi 'god pa dang*/

lung gsum sbyin pa sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin yin la/ snying po dang las sngags gnyis kar la bzlas lung byed/ thugs kyi rjes gnang mi dgos so/ /rgyud kuna~X las ni dbang bsdud lha/ /sgrol ma kho na dga~X' bar bsngags/ /rgyud las 'byung ba'i snyinga~X po~X las/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga de tsam lags/ /sgrol ma dmar mo sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rje btsun sgrol ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ khyad 'phags shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /nor sbyin ma yi rim pa ni/ /mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad pa bya/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong bar sbyangs/ bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar tāṃ/ de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las sgrol ma nor sbyin ma ljang khu phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang 'phreng ba can/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang*/ po ti bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /spyi bo dpral ba spyan dang mgrin/ /dpung pa snying ga lte ba gsang*/ /pus mo gnyis dang zhabs dag la/ /gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge bcu'i/ /yi ge re re bkod par bya/ shar du rdo rje sgrol ma nag mo/ lho ru rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ /nub tu pad+ma sgrol ma dmar mo/ byang du sangs rgyas sgrol ma dkar mo rnams rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ me sogs mtshams bzhir me tog sgrol ma dkar mo/ bdug pa sgrol ma nag mo/ mar me sgrol ma ser mo/ dri'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ de rnams zla ba la gnas shing*/ zhi ba'i nyams can no/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma nag mo/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor dril bu ma ser mo/ 'di rnams g.yas brkyang gi nyi ma la gnas shing khro mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab spyi dang 'dra ba las/

gtso mo la don grub pas dbu brgyan/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyi ngo bor gyur pa rin po che re res dbu brgyan/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re da naṃ me da da swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla'o/ / snying ga'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rang gi snying gar bsdu/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ut+pa la'i phyag rgya bcas te/ a kā ro lan bcu gcig gis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol sogs spyi dang mthun pa'i mthar/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba yang kha che paṇa chen gyi lugs kyi sgrol ljang dkyus ma nyid kyis rigs 'gre'o/ /kuna~X nas rnyed dka' ches dkon pa/ /phun tshogs dga~X' ston dpag med cing*/ /nor sbyin sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X 'di tsam bdag gis spel/ kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa sgrol ma nor sbyin gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa'i/ /dpal gyi lha mo sgrol ma la/ /btud nas de'i sgrub thabs rim/ /shin tu rnyed dka' bri bar bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la tāṃ ser po'i 'od kyis tha mal gyis lus sbyangs te/ sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid sgrol ma ser mo/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon rin po ches mtshan pa'i ut+pal la ser po bsnams pa/ pad zla la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su dzam+bha la ser po/

gter gyi bum pa la gnas pa bi dza pu ra ka dang*/ ne'u le 'dzin pa/ g.yon du rnam thos sras ser po seng ge la chibs pa/ nor bus mtshan pa'i be con dang*/ ne'u le 'dzin pa/ thugs kar zla ba la tāṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par gsol ba btab/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ dzam+bhe mo he swāhā/ zhes 'bum phrag bcu bzla'o/ / oṃ dzaṃ bhe mo he ba su ma ma ku ru swāhā/ zhes 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa'o/ /bris sku la stod g.yogs ser po dang*/ me tog ser pos mchod/ gtor ma 'bul tshul sgrol ma nor sbyin dang 'dra'o/ /'di la bzlas lung phog pas chog/rjes gnang mi dgos so/ /longs spyod sgrub pa'i gdams ngag ni/ /kuna~X las khyad 'phags bkra shis pa/ /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rab dga~X' 'di/ /bsgrubs na snyinga~X po~X'i don dang mjal/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs sgrol ma ser mo gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang zhig bsgrubs ba'i rmi lam du/ /zhal ston lung ston thob 'gyur ba'i/ /sgrub thabs zla ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /gzhung bzhin cung zad bshad par bya/ /su ga ta shrī las brgyud pa'i man ngag 'di la gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa spyi dang mthun par bya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na sarba bigh+wā tā ṭa ha/ sarba pa paṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes drag tu bzlas pas bgegs bsal/ nam mkha' sngon po'i dbus su paṃ las pad dkar dang zla ba la tāṃ las rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhag gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs can/ dar mthing ka'i stod g.yogs dang*/ mu tig gi rgyan can don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa/ khyad par gzhan sgrol ma spyi dang mtshungs pa'o/ / ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su sgrol ma skad cig gis bzhugs par mos la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ swap+na tā re swāhā/ 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bsnyen pa'o/ /thun 'jog khar dge ba bsngo/ las sbyor ni/ gzhon nu ma'i ston mo sngon du song nas/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi zhal zas/ gu gul mar me rnams mang du bshams la/ maṇ+ḍal mchod pa gsol btab dang bcas pa rgyas par byas nas/ oṃ swap+na tā ra/ swap+na a wa lo ki ni/ trai lo kya ni/ dar+sha ni/ trai lo kya gir dza ni/ bhu taṃ bha waṃ/ bha wi shaṃ shu bha shu bhaṃ taṃ maṃ/ sa d+ya ka ta ya swāhā / zhes brgya rtsa bzlas pas gsal snang ston par 'gyur ro/ /'di la rjes gnang sogs ni mi dgos sgom lung tsam gyis chog pa yin no/ khro phu'i man ngag kuna~X tu dga~X'/ /rgya gzhung snyinga~X po~X'i yid brtan bcas/ /mngon shes 'dod pas 'di sgrub bya/

/lha 'dre sgrub rnams shin tu smad/ /rmi lam sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sdug bsngal thams cad spangs nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ster ma/ /sgrol ma 'khor bcas la btud nas/ /lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /'di la rgyas par tshogs bsog sogs bshad kyang*/ bsdu na skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du a las zla ba la tāṃ zhu ba las thig le dkar po/ de las ut+pal tāṃ gis mtshan pa 'od kyi 'phro 'du can/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid sgrol ma ljang sngon phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i shar du so sor 'brang ma dkar mo/ nor bu dang bum pas mtshan pa'i pad dkar 'dzin pa/ lhor 'od zer can ma ser mo rdo rje dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ nub tu phag mo dmar mo phag gdong can/ byang du ral gcig ma nag mo shin tu khros pa/ de gnyis ka'ang stag lpags dang bcas shing gri thod 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum ma/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ / tsan+d+ra go mi'i sgrub thabs ltar na/ g.yas su 'od zer can ma/ phag mo/ g.yon du khro gnyer can ma/ ral gcig ma lta bu dang*/ nor bu 'dzin ma ser mo nor bu dang*/ pad+ma bum pas mtshan pa bsnams pa'o/ /dang po gnyis cung zad khro/ tha ma zhi ba'o/ /gang ltar yang snying gar pad zla la tāṃ/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab spyi dang 'dra ba las gtso mo la don grub/ 'khor rnams la rim pas rnam snang*/ rin 'byung*/ snang mtha'/ mi bskyod pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mchod bstod sgrol ma spyi dang mthun par bya/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/

yi ge bcu pa nyid bzla zhing*/ bsnyen pa song nas grub pa'i tshe yi ge brgyad la/ ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes zhu ba dang*/ ma ma puṣ+tiṃ ku ru bau ṣaṭa/ ces rgyas pa dang*/ wa ṣaṭa trai lo kya wa shaṃ ku ru wa ṣaṭa/ ces dbang dang*/ hūṃ phaṭa shā trun mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces drag po ste/ sham bu de rnams btags pa 'bum phrag re re bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar 'khor rnams rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rang nyid mi dmigs par bsam ste dge ba bsngo/ 'dir gtor chog ni gnyan sgrol gyi skabs dang 'dra la/ rjes gnang ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra'o/ /klu sgrub zhal lung jo bo las/ /brgyud par grags pa kuna~X dang ni/ /gzhung <lo tsa ba g.yu mtsho dngos grub sogs/ / >gzhan gzhan gyis bsgyur ba rnams/ /mthun phyir dga~X' bas snyinga~X po~Xr dril/ /sgrol ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'phrin las lha mo sgrol ma dang*/ /skyabs kyi dam pa rin chen gsum/ /kun 'dus bla ma la btud nas/ /phyag brgyad sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du tāṃ las ut+pa la tāṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sgrol ma sku lus dang zhal bzhi ljang ba la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag dang po gnyis ut+pa la'i phyag rgya thugs kar 'chang ba/ lhag ma g.yas gsum/ bgrang 'phreng*/ mda'/ 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum rgyal mtshan/ gzhu/ bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs shing dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa'o/ / de nas gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs kyi lha mo spros nas/ sems can rnams skyob par mos shing*/

yi ge bcu pa ci nus su bzlas/ rtsa sngags kyang nyer gcig re bzla'o/ /rjes mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su mtshan brgya dang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig ci nus su 'don/ gtor chog gnyan sgrol gyi skabs dang 'dra zhing*/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul yang bka' gdams lha bzhi'i sgrol ma dang 'dra'o/ /klu sgrub lugs su kuna~X nas grags/ /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dga~X' bde bskyed/ /rgya bod gzhung gi yang snyinga~X tsam/ /gsal po~Xr brjod la nyes pa ci/ /phyag brgyad sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ don dam shes rab pha rol phyin/ /lha mo'i tshul gyi skur bstan nas/ /'gro ba'i re skong bar chad sel/ /sgrol ma la 'dud sgrub thabs bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis bla ma yi dam mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs dang tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ pad zla'i steng du rang sems tāṃ yig ljang khu'i 'phro 'du las rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing*/ sin+dhu ra'i mdog can gyi ras bzang pos dbu skra bcings pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ ljon shing rab tu rgyas pa la rgyab brten pa'i rnam pa can no/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyas btab sogs spyi dang mthun pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ snying gar pad zla la sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mthar snod bcud thams cad rang la thim/ rang yang tāṃ la thim/ de yang mi dmigs par bsam/
