slar yang rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkha' rje btsun sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig ci nus su 'don/ dkar gtor zhig bshams la/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod du baṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis rlabs/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod byas la gsol ba drag tu btab/ rje btsun ma rang gi spyi bor thim/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di la rjes gnang med/ sgom lung 'bogs pa tsam yin te/ rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs yan chad kyi mngon rtogs sgom du bcug la yi ge bcu pa brgya rtsa re'i rjes bzlos byed du bcugade man chad kyi dmigs pa rnams tshar gcig bshad pas don 'grub pa nyid do/ /'di kā pa li tā ra'i sgrub thabs yin/ zhal bsgyur tā ra bsgom par 'dod na/ gzhan 'dra ba las zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung mdzad pa ni khyad par ro/ /kuna~X la mtshan yang ma grags pa'i/ /sgrub thabs dā na shrī las/ /legs brgyud stag lug thang ba'i srol/ /rab dga~X'i snyinga~X po~X ngo mtshar rmad/ /rje btsun ma kā pa li tā ra'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang zhig bsgom pa tsam gyis ni/ khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa dang*/ /nad rnams ma lus sel 'gyur ba/ /skul byed sgrol ma de la 'dud/ /skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ sems dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag de nas seng ldeng gi sdong po yal ga lo 'dab rgyas pa'i rtsa bar pad zla la tāṃ las rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog dmar zhing dwangs pa/ ba spu'i khung bu re nas 'od zer dmar po'i dra ba 'gyed pa/ dbu skra grol ba mu tig dmar po'i chun po bcings pa/ phyag g.yas pi tsu ra'i shing gi 'bras bu nang ser la kha sngo ba pus mo'i steng du 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon po tis mtshan pa'i ut+pa la dmar po thugs kar 'dzin pa/

zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ mu tig gtso bor gyur pa'i dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /thugs kar pad zla la tāṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mthar lha sku mi dmigs par bsams la dge bar bsngo/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ kā pa li tā ra dang 'dra ba la/ slob ma rnams la bsgom lung 'bogs pa'i tshul ni/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa rnams ji ltar rigs pa zhig byas la/ gong bzhin mngon rtogs sgom du bcug la/ sngags nyer gcig gi bzlas lung sbyin pas 'grub pa nyid do/ /kuna~X las nyams len khyer bde ba/ /rab tu zab pa yid dga~X'i gnas/ /rtse gcig bsgoms na dngos grub kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X len pa shin tu bla/ /'phags ma tsun+dha tā ra'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o// //gcig zhus/ dar rgyas 'phel/ dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin pa yi/ khro rgyal gnod sbyin sde dpon tshul/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /drag sngags kyi che ba phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya'i sgrub thabs ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim/ chos thams cad stong par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ hūṃ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hūṃ du gyur/ badz+ra hūṃ las gnam lcags kyi rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lan gsum/ rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'phyar ba/

g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs ka'i thad nas gnod byed la sdigs pa/ spyan gsum me stag ltar 'bar ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas klu 'bum/ gnyan khri/ sa bdag stong spungs pa'i steng du/ pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la rnam par 'gying ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan dang*/ dar gyi stod g.yogs can/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'bar zhing*/ nor rgyas dung skyong ser pos dbu la brgyan pa/ dga' bo/ nyer dga' dmar po'i snyan cha/ pad+ma/ chu lha dkar po'i dpung brgyan dang*/ 'dab bzang dang rigs ldan nag pos se ral kha byas pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril gshin rje ltar khros pa/ sku bong che bas zhabs rgya mtsho'i gling du sleb cing*/ dbus tshangs pa'i gnas rigs khyab pa/ zhal nas drag sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa/ khyung chen rigs lnga pho nyar 'gyed pa/ ba spu'i bu ga nas khro bo'i tshogs spro zhing*/ khro bos gtams pa/ dug lnga sreg byed me dpung kha dog sna lnga pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' gsang bdag 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes ye shes sems dpa'i bdag la dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can grol bar byas te bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ rdo rje khu tshur kha sbyor bcings la/ rang gi lce rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa rwa re re la snying po'i sngags dang bcas pa/ snying gar yang rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ lte bar khro chung tshon gang ba/

de'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi mtha' skor du sngags 'phreng dmar pos bskor ba/ hūṃ las steng 'og tu raṃ gnyis gnyis spros/ spyi bo dang rkang mthil gnyis su gnas par gyur/ sngags kyi 'khor lo g.yas su bskor ba las/ me'i tsha tsha spros rgya je cher steng 'og tu chad de/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ raṃ gnyis pa las byung ba'i me dang lhan cig tu gyur/ stod kyi ye shes kyi me thur la 'bar zhing smad kyi me gyen la 'bar bas rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par gyur/ mahā ro ṣa ṇa e raṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ ba spu'i rtsa bar gnas pa'i khro chung rnams kyis sngags di ri ri bzlas/ de rnams las khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa me dpung dang bcas pa phyogs bcur spros/ gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad zhal du gsol slar yang khro chung rnams la thim/ u tsa tsar+ya yak+ṣa se na aṅku sha dza dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 'bum phrag gsum bzla bar bshad kyang*/ 'bum phrag bcu drug go /bzhi bcu zhe brgyad bzla'o/ /drag sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ rang lha sku snang stong du bsgom pa'i ngang nas/ sngar gyi dmigs pa'i steng du mdun du sprul pa'i las mkhan khyung nag mgo bo dgu pa dang*/ de'i g.yas su mgon po nag po gri gug can dang*/ g.yon du lha mo bong zhon ma/ sku'i mtha' skor du phyogs skyong bcu sogs gtsang ris bdun cu rtsa lnga yod par bsgom ste/

bka' bsgo ba'i tshul gyis/ u tsa tsar+ya yak+ṣa se na aṅku sha dza dza/ pu pu dan du/ nag po bab/ tsi tsi rgyas/ trag sha snying la thur/ nyams nyams rtsa bzhi bskums/ shan shan srog la shan/ tsa tur nag po sod/ gnod byed 'byung po'i snying la mā ra ya rbad/ tiṣ+ṭha a be sha ya rbad/ nā ga gu h+ye rbud/ pi pi pa/ li li ka dha dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub bo/ /dus bzhir las bzhi dang sbyar ba'i dmigs pa spyi dang 'dra/ 'phreng ba rak+ṣa dang*/ lung tang dang*/ thod 'phreng rnams shes so/ /thun 'jog khar 'khor rnams rang la bsdu/ lha sku mi dmigs pa sbyangs te/ dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su yang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /las dang po pas oṃ gyi mgo drangs te sngags bzlas na/ rgyud 'jam pa yin no/ /zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo*/ /gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thod pa'i nang du dmar gtor zhig dang*/ rin po che'i nang du dkar gtor zhig dang*/ gzhan rdza snod lta bu zhig tu sho lu chang bu dang mtheb kyu can gcig bya/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma dang po gnyis/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang du hūṃ bh+ruṃ dz+riṃ aṃ khaṃ/ de rnams las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa 'phros gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bkugasems yig 'bru lnga la thim pa ye shes lngar gyur/ lus sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gyur/ de thams cad zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan lnga brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas byang sems sprul pa ye shes khro bo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa/ nang gi las mkhan gsum/ phyi'i las mkhan dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/

mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan lngas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma dang po de/ snying po'i mthar sarba duṣ+tāṃ sarba shā trun thuṃ mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan gsum gyis gtso bo la phul/ gti mug sha yi mchod pa bzhes/ /zhe sdang rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa bzhes/ /bdag 'dzin la sogs dgra bgegs rnams/ /bdag med dbyings su bsgral du gsol/ /de ltar bsgral ba'i dgra bgegs de/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ /gnyis med ye shes rtogs par shog/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod/ snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bas nang mchod phul/ gnyis pa dkar gtor de las mkhan rnams la 'bul te/ a kā ro 'i mthar ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa 'di phyi nang gsang ba'i las mkhan rnams la 'bul la/ bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dril bu sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'i bstod pa ni/ gdug pa 'dul byed gnod sbyin rgyal/ /'dul dbang chen po sprul pa'i sku/ /'jigs byed chen po drag po ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag gos sngon can/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyi rdo rje bsnams/ /bgegs rig brgyad khri rdul du rlog/g.yon pa sdigs mdzub sde brgyad 'dul/ /nyi zla pad+ma la sogs dang*/ /klu 'bum khri stong gdan la bzhugs/ /sku zhal shin tu rgyas pa ste/ /sbrul gyi chas kyis rnam par brgyan/ /stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ /spyan gsum gdug pa can la gzir/ /'jig rten 'dul ba'i dbang phyug can/ /dregs pa 'joms pa'i stobs po che/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i thugs rje can/

khyod la bdag cag phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog na/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje ni/ /yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs/ /skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu las/ /bdun 'bum sum khri'i khro bo sprul/ /pho nya nyi zer rdul dang mtshungs/ /gsang ba'i bka' sdod rnams la bstod/ khyung chen thugs las sprul pa ste/ /gsung gi phyag brnyan re ma tī/ /sku las mgon po nag po byung*/ /nang gi bka' sdod gsum la 'dud/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'dus gyur kyang*/ /thugs rjes 'khor ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /phyogs skyong gtsang rigs bdun cu lnga/ /phyi'i las mkhan rnams la bstod/ / ces bstod/ gtor ma gsum pa/ chang bu 'theb kyur bcas pa'i gtor ma de/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thams cad kyang phyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis bsngos/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'byor ba dang*/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i gdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad lha rnams dang*/ /de yi sras dang tshangs la sogs/ /'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'di/ /ma tshang ba ni bzod par gsol/ /gang zhig nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma tshang de bzhin ma mnyes dang*/ / nyes pa'i dri mar gyur pa kun/ /de yang khyed kyis bzod par gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes lan gsum gyis 'khor 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ nang mchod kyis slar yang gtso bo la mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/

hūṃ gsang ba'i bdag po u tsar+ya/ /ye shes khro bo nang 'khor bcas/ /mchod gtor bzang pos mnyes gyur nas/ /bdag kyang khyed dang mnyam par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ ces 'dod don gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya/ nyal ba'i tshe bsrung 'khor bsgoms nas/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe snying po lan gsum brjod nas/ lha sku snang stong du ldang*/ rmi lam yang longs sku'i lam khyer du bya'o/ /skabs 'dir snying po dang rtsa sngags don gcig cing*/ drag sngags la 'phreng ba'i sngags zhes zer ro/ /de'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nagagru bcad dmar po/ mtha' rdo rwa me ris bskor ba rdul tshon gyis bri/ bsdu na maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu bkod pas kyang btub/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma nag po gru gsum rten gtor du bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ 'thor nas sogs nyer mkho tshogs par bya/ bum chog byed pa ltar na/ bum pa'ang spyi dang mthun par bca'/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed gong bzhin/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ bum pa'i nang du pad+ma zla nyi'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa re re yongs su gyur pa las phyag na rdo rje'i sku re rer gyur pa na/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig sems dpa' dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pas bar bdag bskyed bzhin las bdag la dbang bskur zhes pa mdun bskyed la zhes par 'don pa spro/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs ba nas/

oṃ āḥhūṃ lan lnga'i bar gong bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems sprul pa zhes pa nas/ thogs （《 pa med par 'grub pa'i gtong grogs mdzad du gsol gyi bar gong bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes sde brgyad dang gzhi bdag rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ zhes brjod/ mchod pa kha gso ba nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ga ི bar kyang gong bzhin/ mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal dang gtor ma la chabs gcig tu dmigs nas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ bum nang gi lha'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum pa gang bar gyur/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste snying po brgya tsam bzla/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lcang lo can sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes nang mchod thig pa gcig bum nang du blug bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas rjes gnang dngos ni/ slob ma rnams la khrus chab btang*/ gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad cung zad bya/ phyag na rdo rje la che ba bzhi'i drug tu grags pa las/ u tsar drag sngags kyi che ba yin pas 'di'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul zhes brda sprad/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol sogs lan gsum/ rgyun bshags kyi dmigs pa brda sprad la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'phags pa u tsar+ya'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ lus bde ba dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs brgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ rnam smin sha khrag brdos bcas kyi phung pos mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas thugs kar hūṃ gi bar mngon rtogs bzhin la rang sems zhes pa khyed rang rnams kyi sems/ rang nyid ces pa khyed rang rnams kyi zhes 'don pa spo/ slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim/ khyad par lcang lo can gyi gnas nas/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang*/ phyag na rdo rje'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam/ yang chung rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon/ de dag thams cad khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ ces brjod/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing*/ snying po lan gsum drag sngags lan gcig gi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi kā ya a dhiḥtiṣ+ṭha oṃ/ zhes bzlas/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar yang mos pa gyis/ zhes brjod la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ces brjod cing bum chus dbang bskur ro/ / de ltar sku'i rjes gnang thob pas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bar chad zhi lus lha skur sgoms pa la dbang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku dang*/ rang gi lus dbyer med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas gsung gi rjes gnang la/

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'phags pa u tsar+ya'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa rtsal du gsol/ ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ ngag nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams gsang ba'i bdag po'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar gnas lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte ba sbubs stong du gnas pa'i nang du nyi ma la hūṃ mthing nagalce yang hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse dgu par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du/ dbus su hūṃ mtha' skor du rtsa sngags g.yas skor du bskor ba de'i phyir skor du 'phreng ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba gsal btab la/ slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs brgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las sngags 'phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi mtha' skor du lce'i rdo rje'i rwa rnams la spar btab pa bzhin du 'khod par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ rtsa sngags lan gsum/ 'phreng sngags lan gcig rjes zlos byed du 'jug yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nas/ mdun bskyed dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rang rang gi gsung gi rigs sngags thams cad gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i u tsar+ya'i sngags kyi yig 'bru'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga dang*/ lce steng gi sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams la thim/ zhes brjod rol mo'i sgra bya/ snying po drag sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi wā ka a dhi tiṣ+ṭha āḥ zhes bzla/ yang sngags kyi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i don du/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes bzlos kyis/

bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid sngags 'phreng du byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang rnams la gtor ma spyi bo nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim pas sngags rnams nus pa mthu can du bgyis par mos par mdzod/ ces brjod cing*/ me tog 'thor bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'phags pa u tsar+ya'i gsung rigs sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad thogs med du 'jug par gyur cigaslar yang bum pa'i chus sngar bzhin dbang bskur ba las/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa mi bskyod par gyur pa/ sngar gyi rigs bdag dang gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /de ltar gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob pas ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bar chad zhi/ ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med du gyur par mos mdzod/ de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang la gsol btab ni/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ yid ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes 'don pa spo/ slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rnams rdo rje rtse dgu pa dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi yi ge la gnyis su med par thim par mos mdzod/ ces brjod la/ rol mo dang*/ sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi tsit+ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ zhes bzlas/ slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ba gsung gi rjes gnang bzhin/ de ltar thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pas yid kyi sdig sgrib byang*/ bar chad zhi/ yid stong nyid sgom pa la dbang*/ gsang bdag gi thugs dang rang gi yid dbyer med du gyur par mos mdzod/ de nas gtor dbang ni/ gtor ma 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya dngos su mos/ de la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam pa gyis/ gtor ma mgo bor bzhag la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs shing*/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /gtor ma'i dbang bskur byin par bya/ / rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ sngags nyid drag tu brjod/ mthar phyag na rdo rje 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas gsang bdag dngos su gyur pa yin snyam pa gyis/ zhes brjod/ slar yang gsung gi rjes gnang gi skabs ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ de nas slob ma la mchod bstod/ brtan bzhugs/ bkra shis rnams byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pas spro na bya/ bsdu na bum chog mi byed pas/ chu dbang lan bzhi po de rnams bskur mi dgos so/ /rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi dang 'dra/ mchod pa kha gsos/ spyi dang mthun par byin rlabs bya/

mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab rnams gong bzhin/ yig brgya lan gsum/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol byas nas/ bkra shis kyi bar gong bzhin/ 'di la sgrub thabs gsar pa mang na yang*/ nor pa rgya 'byams bris bshus kho na las/ rtsa ba'i gzhung dang mthun pa nyung mthong nas/ rang lugs gtsang mar cung zad zhib par bris/ drag sngags kuna~X las stobs chen zhing*/ /mchog tu dga~X' 'di yig rnying dang*/ 'phags pas mdzad pa grags pa'i gzhung*/ /snyinga~X po~Xr bsdus pa'i snying khu lags/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // nā gārdzu na༄༅/ /gos sngon can gyis gzungs las byung ba'i phyag rdor gyi sgrub thabs so/ na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ gang zhig bsgoms na dngos grub mchog ster ba'i/ /sgrub thabs dze twa ri las brgyud pa'/ /mkha' 'gro gser gling pa'am jo bo rje/ /'gar dge :gyed [gyang ]phu ba dang sa skya pa/ /de las brgyud pa'i lugs bzhin te/ /gos sngon gzungs dang bla med rgyud/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyang gsungs/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /'dir gsang ba'i bdag po'i gzungs ring la brten pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ sngon 'gro bsod nams tshogs bsog ni/ /skyabs 'gro byams dang snying rje sems bskyed bsgom/ /zhes pa ste spyi dang mthun/ ye shes tshogs bsog yan lag bzhi ni bsregs dang sems dang sgyu ma snang med bzhi/ de yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gis phung khams skye mched nad gdon nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ chos thams cad sems tsam/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ sems de yang sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /sgyu mar snang ba yang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs/ dngos gzhi yan lag bzhi ni/ lhar bskyed gnas gsum byin rlabs dgug gzhug dang*/ rgyas btab rnams ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa yin/ zhes pa ltar te/ hūṃ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/

g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas bskum pas nyi ma dang*/ g.yon brkyang bas zla ba mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang*/ rin po che'i con pan can/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra me ltar 'bar ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ / rgyas par spro na/ gnod sbyin bye ba stong phrag bye ba dpag tu med pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ zhes nyams nyi shu rtsa lnga po dag tu yang 'don/ ma brjod kyang chog dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ rang la thim/ yang hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ yid kyis mchod bstod gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur te/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa yan lag bzhi ni/ byin rlabs sngags bzlas bzod gsol smon lam mo/ /de yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ yid kyi mchod pas sngags bzla bar gnang ba stsal/ sngags bzla grogs mdzad par bsams la/ bzlas bya'i sngags dngos ni/ tad+ya thā/ bho bho paṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ i daṃ ni lāṃ ba ra dha ra sha ri raṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hri da yaṃ/ yaḥs mā ti kra ma thā/ uta pā ta naṃ bha bi ṇ+ya ti/ tad+ya thā/ bud+dha bud+dha/ bi bud+dha bi bud+dha/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ha ra ha ra/ nā ga naṃ/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ nā ga naṃ/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ nā ga hri da ya ni/ bhiṃ da bhiṃ da/ nā ga marma ni/ bhi : shinān+bhu （《dzaṃ》 shir+yan+tu/ ） nā ga shi rī ra ṇi/ bi s+pho ṭa ya nā ga nā ya ni/ tad+ya thā/ hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇa ya phaṭa/ rā go ta pā dā na ya phaṭa/ ni la ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta pā la pa ḍā kra mā ya phaṭa/ kri trāṃ tā ya phaṭa/ kri tān ta ru pa ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇā ya phaṭa/ tra pa nā ya phaṭa/ kum+bha ṇ+ḍot+pā dā nā ya phaṭa/ pre ta pi shā tsā bi nā sha ka ra ya phaṭa/

yak+sha a pa smā ra/ bi nā shā ka ra ya phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi nā shā ka ra ya phaṭa/ sarba sha trūṃ saṃ gha bi nā shā kā ra ya phaṭa/ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ de nas sangs rgyas rnams la yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang rjes su yi rang mdzad de/ mi dmigs par gshegs/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ rjes kyi yan lag bzhi ni/ spyod lam kha zas gtor ma nyal ba bzhi/ dang po ni/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha skur bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ kha zas byin gyis brlabs la lha'i nga rgyal gyis za'o/ /gsum pa gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun du hūṃ las bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gzungs ring lan gsum bzlas la phul/ mchod bstod sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang mthun no/ / bzhi pa ni/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du nyal zhing lha'i snang bar ldang ba'o/ /de ltar yan lag nyi shu dang ldan pas bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi bya'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg dang mchod bstod la bsten nas lha nye bar sgrub pa dang*/ bum pa'i cho ga sogs dang 'brel ba'i las tshogs mang du gsungs pa rnams bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni klu dbang gi rgyal po'i rjes gnang gi rigs 'gre ste/ bdag ni klu dbang rgyal po yi/ / zhes pa/ bdag ni gsang ba'i bdag po yi/ /zhes par 'don pa spo ba sogs byas pas 'grub bo/ /gsung gi rjes gnang gi skabs/ gzungs mdo chung chung de lan gsum klog pa ni khyad par ro/ /kuna~X nas shin tu zab mo'i gsang*/ /dga~X' zhing yi ge'i lam du spel/ /snyinga~X nas chos 'dir mos pa'i dges/ /sgrub po~X bdag gis zhal mthong shog/ces pa ni phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi gzungs las byung ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ḍā ki nī/ a wa dhū tī/

jo bo/ 'gar dge gyang phu ba/ sa skya ba/ / ༄༅/ /phyag rdor sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs so/ / na mo gu ru/ dpal ldan rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba la btud nas/ /gsang bdag snying po'i sgrub thabs gang*/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig gi lugs ltar na/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs nas/ pad nyi la hūṃ las bskyed pa'am/ 'di nyid kyi man ngag thun mong ma yin pa ltar na/ rang gi snying nang du nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ sngon po de las 'od 'phros/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ tha mal ba'i lus dang sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang*/ rin po ches brgyan zhing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhing*/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ snying gi nang du nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ gi mtha' skor du sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar dmigs la/ sngags bzlas pa de las 'od 'phros/ rang gi sdig sgrib sbyang*/ bgegs rnams bcom/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus te/ sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam la/ oṃ nī laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes 'bum phrag bco brgyad bzlas so/ /'jug dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma dkar gtor bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod du/ āḥlha'i bdud rtsi/ dbus su hūṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ nī laṃ nas/ ba ya ti sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ bā ling kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing*/ / sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs par gsol ba rnams spyi dang mthun par bya zhing*/ rtag tu lha'i nga rgyal la gnas par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa kho na ltar yin la phyis kyi lag len ltar na/ man+ṭal gyi steng du gtor ma bzhagarjes gnang gi 'jug tu gtor dbang re yang byed kyin snang ngo*/ /gsang ba kuna~X bdag dga~X' chen gyi/ /sgrub thabs kun gyi rtsa ba 'di/ /snyinga~X po~X'i don tsam bsdus pa ste/ /dgra las rnam rgyal las brgyud pa'o/ /dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs sa lugs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bdud kun 'joms pa'i ye shes ni/ /thugs rjes khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /rdo rje gtum po la btud nas/ /gsang sgrub chen po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /de las sgrub thabs bsrung ba'i mkhar zhes bya ba sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ rang rdo rje gtum por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis bla ma dang yi dam mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*/ /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lcang lo can gyis gnas mchog na/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po ni/ /yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs/ /skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/

/thabs la mkhas pas sna tshogs skur ston zhing*/ /sde brgyad dregs pa mtha' dag zil gnon pa'i/ /rgyal sras khyung gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mchod pa sprul/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho?&haṃ/ snying rje chen por bskyed la/ stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par bya'o/ / zhes brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo spros/ rdo rje nyid 'od du zhu/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar zhing*/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing gsor ba/ g.yon dril bu bkur bsten pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas dbang phyug dang*/ g.yon brkyang bas dbu ma mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ sbrul dkar pos dbu brgyan/ ser pos rna cha dang dpung gdub/ dmar pos mgul rgyan dang ske rags/ nag pos zhabs gdub dang ga zha/ ljang khus phyag gdub byas pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las spros pa'i rdo rje'i go khrab kyis rkang mthil yan chad gtams/ bud+dha ga ru ḍa oṃ/ spyi bor 'khor lo'i khyung dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa hrīḥ mgrin par pad+ma'i khyung dmar po pad+ma/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūṃ/ snying gar rdo rje'i khyung sngon po rdo rje/ rat+na ga ru ḍa traṃ/

lte bar rin po che'i khyung ser po rin po che/ karma ga ru ḍa a/ las kyi khyung ljang khu ral gri/ e/ dpyi g.yas su me tog gi khyung dmar po me togabaṃ/ g.yon par bdug spos kyi khyung sngon mo bdug spos/ ma/ dpung pa g.yas par mar me khyung dmar po mar me/ ya/ g.yon par dri chab kyi khyung ljang mo dri chab/ a/ brang gzhol du gnod sbyin gdul ba'i khyung sngon pos ral gri/ swa/ sog phrag tu gshin rje 'dul ba'i khyung be con/ hrīḥ lte 'og tu klu 'dul ba'i khyung dmar po lcags sgrogahūṃ/ tshang rar dri za 'dul ba'i khyung ljang khu rdo rje/ dzaḥ sna la lcags kyu'i khyung dkar po/ hūṃ/ kha la zhags pa'i khyung ser po/ baṃ/ gsang bar lcags sgrog gi khyung dmar po/ ho/ bshang sgor dril bu'i khyung sngo sangs/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yon pas rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sprul bzung nas zhal du gsol ba'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ spyi bo nas snying ga'i bar sprul pa'i bya khyung zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sa mā ya dzaḥ de nas lte ba'i bar yang sbrul gyi khyung zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sa ma ya āḥ de nas rkang mthil bar nying sbrul gyi khyung zhal gcig phyag drug pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sa ma ya ho/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar phyi nang thams cad du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i khyung dbu dgu pa la sogs pa dbu phyag ma nges pa rnams kyis gang bar gyur/ rnam sprul gyi khyung de rnams thams cad sku mdog dang phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ bdag lus dang khyung thams cad las me dpung 'bar bar gyur/ rang gi snying gar pad nyi la hūṃ sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ puṣ+pe

nas/ nai wi te 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ sku'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ gsung gi sngags te 'bum phrag re re'o/ / oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa na hūṃ phaṭa/ thugs kyi sngags te sum 'bum nyi shu rtsa gcig go /sham bu thung 'dogs ni/ ro ṣa ṇa 'i rjes su/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa/ du ta mā ra ya swāhā/ ring 'dogs ni/ phaṭa phaṭa kyi rjes su/ badz+ra ba ti ga ru ḍa be ge hūṃ hūṃ dza dza ri dza pri dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ga ru ḍa tsa le sogs 'dra/ drag sngags ni/ hūṃ hril hril/ dī ma dī ma/ phob phob/ shar shar/ di ri di ri/ kha tham kha tham thum/ dza re dza re bh+yo/ ha sa ha sa/ te pa te pa/ kri da ha kri da ha/ gri khug kri khugatshal pa tshal pa/ sreg srog tshig nan rbad/ lus du la mā ra ya rbad/ raṃ raṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ shi shi rdul bun rbad sod/ ces 'dogs pa'o/ /sham bu rnams la bsnyen pa'i tshe grangs kyi nges pa med do/ /mthar mi dmigs par byas te dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me/ 'bru gsum las byung ba'i mi mgo sgyed pu/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ na go ku go ha las sha lnga/ steng gi nam mkha' la a las zla ba dang hūṃ las rdo rje/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar rdzas rnams bskol zhing*/ dri ma sbyangs/ zla ba rdo rje zhu zhing thim pas bdud rtsir gyur/ snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug ste bstim pas rgya cher spel/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/

rdo rje gtum po bya khyung gi tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mdun du dpag bsam gyi shing rab tu rgyas pa'i rtse mor bzhugs par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ tshogs zhing gi skabs su bshad pa ltar mchod bstod bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi mthar badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig tu 'dab chags dang*/ rmig gcig pa'i sha dang*/ sgo nga mi za/ klu gtor rgyun du gtong*/ rtags brgyad ni/ lus la me 'bar ba dang*/ rkang pa mtsho nang du skyod pa/ ri klung la bskor ba/ rus pa 'joms pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan byed pa/ sku gzugs bzhad pa/ me tog sngon po 'thu ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon byed pa rnams so/ /'di'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad me ris bskor ba'i dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po bkod steng mañdzi la bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ mchod gtor spyi dang mthun par bskor/ slob dpon gyis mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro nas tshogs zhing rang la bstim pa'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa bsangs/ swa bhā wa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin bya ste/ bdag mdun phyogs gcig tu sgrub pa yin la/ dmigs pa ni tha dad du sgom pa yin no/ / bum pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i nang du pad nyi la hūṃ las/ zhes pa nas/ phyag gdub byas pa'o 'i bar gong bzhin/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab bdag bskyed kyi rigs 'gre/ gzungs thag nas bzung la sngags bzla/ mchod bstod bya/ dung chos kyi chu phul bas lha zhu nas bum chur gyur/

gtor chog ltar mdun bskyed la gtor ma phul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ klu gtor gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang btang*/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral la 'khod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rdo rje gtum po'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ stong nyid sgom pa nas/ me'i go bgo ba'i bar mngon rtogs ltar dmigs pa phogade nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa bstim pa rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra/ dbang bskur rgyas btab mngon rtogs dang 'dra ba las/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa a bhi ṣe ka ta ga ta ḍa tsā le tsā le/ dun+ṭa mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bum pas dbang bskur ba ni khyad par ro/ /de nas bzlas lung dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang 'dra/ de yang khyed kyis rdo rje gtum po'i sgo nas phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don sgrub par mdzod cig ces gnang bar byin/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog kyang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gtor ma gsar ba re bshams nas/ mdun bskyed dang chos skyong rnams la 'bul ba ni khyad par ro/ /yang gtor dbang la dga' ba rnams kyi ngor maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyab tu gtor ma nag po gru gsum zhig bshams/ skad cig gis gsang ba'i bdag por bskyed/ mchod bstod zhig byas la bzhagadabang bskur rgyas btab kyi rjes su gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur/ rjes chog gi sngon du de'i ye shes pa mdun du spar la/ gtor ma de 'bul gtor du byed pa'i lag len yang kha cig la 'dug mod kyi/ brgyud pa 'di'i lugs kyi yi ge rnams las gtor dbang ma bshad cing*/ rje stag lung pa yab sras kyi phyag len la'ang mi mdzad cing*/ don la'ang mi dgos pa yin par mngon no/ /kuna~X tu zab par rab grags pa/

/bgegs 'joms 'dod rnams yid dga~X'i gnas/ /ras chung gdams pa'i snyinga~X po~X ni/ /legs par snyed gang ngo mtshar ro/ /phyag rdor gtum chen bsrung ba'i mkhar zhes grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /gtum po khra thogs kyi sgrub thabs so/ / na mo badz+ra dha ra yā/ gang zhig bsgoms pas gdug pa kun/ /skad cig gcig gis nyams 'gyur la/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub kun thob pa/ /bdag snying ya mtshan skyes nas bris/ /'dir shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab par gyur pa'i man ngag ste/ sgrub po gang zhig 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba yang dag par thob pa dag gis nan tan du bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun/ oṃ shū n+ya tā 'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sgra las rang nyid rdo rje gtum po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje ser po rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub brkyang bas bgegs rnams la gzir ba/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sbrul nag pos brgyan pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khyung sngo nag gis gtams shing*/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pas kyang rung ngo*/ /dam ye dbyer med kyi ngo bor mos pa bya/ klu 'dul ba gtso bor 'dod na/ sbrul rigs lnga'i chun po zhabs 'og tu mnan pa sgom gsung dregs pa rnams lta ci smos/ ye shes kyi lha rnams kyang bka' 'og tu 'dus so snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed la/ spyi bor bla ma mi bskyod pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la hūṃ mthing ga'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba/ de rnams las me g.yas bskor du 'bar zhing*/

lus gang*/ sdig sgrib bsregs phyi'i me dang 'dres te cher 'bar bas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i gzhal yas khang dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'grub par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu bya'o/ / de nas phyag g.yon gyi sdigs mdzum gyi rtse la khyung nag po sbrul nag po thogs pa bskyed la/ ga ru ḍa tsā le tsā le hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa btags la 'bum phrag gsum bzla'o/ /de nas snod bcud thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom zhing*/ me dang*/ bya khyung nam mkha' gang ba spros te/ gong gi sngags sham bu can la/ hūṃ phaṭa ṣa ṇa ro mahā tsaṇ+ḍa ga ru de ba then byung*/ sa ga nā ga'i snying la gzer/ gnod byed 'byung po thuṃ ri li li rbad/ ces pa btags la bzla'o/ /de rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub legs par song nas las sbyor thams cad sgrub tu rung*/ thun mtshams thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag bo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ / zhes sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba btab la gshegs su gsol ba sogs spyi dang mthun no/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ tshom bu'i steng gtor ma gru gsum 'god/ gzhan sku'i rjes gnang yan chad spyi dang 'dra/ de nas bla ma'i gnas lnga nas slob ma'i gnas lngar khyung rigs lnga bstim/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun/ de nas gtor dbang bya'o/ /lhag ma'ang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /rgyud kuna~X bdag po sgrub pa'i thabs/ yid dga~X'i gsos 'di bris pa'i mthus/

/bde gshegs snyinga~X po~X mngon gyur nas/ /'phro kun thar mchog la 'god shog/ces pa ni skyes mchog ras chung pa'i thugs kyi nying khu phyag rdor gong khug ma gtum chung me 'bar ma'am/ khra thogs kyi mngon rtogs bla ma'i gsung las byung ba ltar bkod pa'i le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /phyag rdor gtum chung dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ oṃ swā sti/ sku las du ma'i 'phrul pa 'chang*/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsang ba can/ /ma rung thams cad mthar mdzad pa/ /phyag na rdo rjes bdag skyongs shig/skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba la rang sems hūṃ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa 'dzin pa/ stag sham dang*/ dar gyi sham thabs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhing*/ khro bo'i rgyan dang*/ cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ snying gar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' nag po de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gsang bdag mthing ga'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas/ rang nyid sku mdog dmar mthing du gyur/ rang gi phrag gong g.yas su bya khyung nag po dang*/ g.yon du gshog pa g.yu mdog can/ gnyis kar sbrul za bar bsgoms la/ rang 'dra'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gnam sa thams cad sngags kyi sgras di ri ri khengs par bsam/ brag tu bzlas/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni phyag rdor gtum chung dang 'dra'o/ /'di phyag rdor gtum po dmar po bzlas lung dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs yin zhing*/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa dbang dang 'brel ba ni kho bos logs su bkod zin to/ /'di'i bzlas lung ster tshul ni/

mngon rtogs gtor ma dang bcas pa gong ltar byas nas/ slob ma la sgom lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin no/ /sgrub thabs kuna~X nas ches dkon pa/ /dga~X' chen pad+ma 'byung gnas gsung*/ /rgya mtsho'i snyinga~X po~X thig pa tsam/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod pa lags/ /phyag rdor gtum chung dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje thugs kyi gtso/ /gos sngon 'dzin pa khro bo'i rgyal/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ / skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying gar hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing nagade las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rgyal ba mi bskyod pa phyag na rdo rje rigs brgyad kyis bskor ba steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ badz+ra pā ṇi ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag byas/ oṃ nī laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta/ phyag na rdo rje khro bo che/ /gtum po drag po rdo rje'i sku/ /mi zad nam mkha'i mdog 'dra ba/ / 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs lan gsum/ tshogs zhing gi thugs ka nas 'od zer byung*/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rang nyid lha'i sku dwangs shing gsal ba 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer phar 'phros te/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rega'od kyi lam de la brgyud nas/ rang nyid gtso bo'i thugs kar thim/ bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba des sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur ciga.oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/

snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu/ bcud kyi sems can la thim/ de rnams tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs la thim/ de rnams rang la thim/ de hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba dra ba/ gur bla bre/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa la hūṃ mthing nag gis mtshan pa/ de las kyang 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje'i sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro zhing dregs pa bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing bzhad pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ rdo rje cod pan can/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma rab tu 'bar ba/ spyan g.yas zla ba/ g.yon nyi ma/ dbus me'i rang bzhin can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga 'phyar ba'i stabs dang*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub gnod byed thams cad la sdigs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs can/ rin po che'i cod pan dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin phyag 'tshal dang*/ mchod bstod bya/
dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ / nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis gong bzhin mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ / gdug pa thams cad 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /gsung mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /ngag gi nyes pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /rigs sngags gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /thugs mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /rtog pa'i dra ba gcod mdzad pa/ /rdo rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar oṃ/ rtsibs la yi ge bcu gsum pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥ 'dab ma la yi ge bcu gsum pa/ snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma hūṃ/ de'i mtha' mar yi ge bcu gsum pas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ nī laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas/ slar yang mchod bstod/ lha sku stong par sbyangs/ cung zad mnyam par bzhagaslar yang lha skur langs la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po yig rnying rnams las gsal bar shes la/ deng sang lag len phyi ma la mdzad pa ltar na/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus su hūṃ yig dang bcas pa bri/

ma lcogs na tshom bu tsam gyis kyang chogade'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar du bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ bzlas pa'i bar 'don pa spo/ 'bul gtor/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod kyi nang du khaṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇi ad+ya nut+pan+na twa ta/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sadha ni swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan bdun bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ nī laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi oṃdzñā pa ya ti i daṃ ba ling gṛh+nan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ sarba karma sā dha a mo ghā ya swāhā/ zhes lan gsum maṃ bdun gyis phul gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs su bstod pa/ bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni/ /sogs la lag len la mdzad na'ang*/ bsdu na sngar bshad pa nyid kyis chog go /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas la gral du 'khod pa la/ spyi dang mthun par bgegs gtor zhig btang la/ dmigs pas bsrung ba bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad bya/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/

sku bskyed bstim dang*/ gsung bzlas lung rnams rjes gnang spyi dang mthun/ 'di'i rang lugs la thugs kyi rjes gnang gi sngon du gtor dbang mdzad na'ang*/ deng sang lag len thugs kyi rjes gnang gi rjes su mdzad do/ /de la thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rnams 'od zer sna lnga pa'i rnam par bsdus/ slob ma'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ spyi mgrin snying lte gsang ba nas brgyud/ lus thams cad 'ja' 'od kyi gang bas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams sang sang dag/lus sems thams cad bde bas gang bar bsam/ de ltar lan gsum bsgoms pa'i rjes su slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ gsang bdag gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan gyi byin rlabs ma lus pa bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur bsdus/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bar bsam pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag go / de nas gtor dbang dang slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog rnams ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gos sngon sgrub thabs chos skyong gi /kuna~X nas che bar rab grags pa'i/ / sgrub thabs 'khyer bde rab dga~X' ba/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can/ / 'gro bzang lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gsang bdag de la gus btud nas/ khang bu brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyud don grwa pa mngon shes kyi/ /gter mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong bar sbyangs/ pad nyi'i steng du rang sems hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje nam mkha'i mdog can phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/

g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis pad nyi la dbang phyug chen po dang u ma de ba mnan pa/ stag lpags dang*/ dar sngon po'i na bza' can/ seng ge'i lpags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ rin po che dang*/ sbrul dang mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing*/ dbang bskur mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ lcang lo can gyi sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ nī laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ 'di la deng sang gsar ma dang mthun pa'i rjes gnang mdzad pas/ de'i tshul ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar gtor ma bzhagamatha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ bdag mdun sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā ling gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ btags pas 'bul/ rjes gnang gi skabs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags byed/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung*/ thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa/ 'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo dang bcas pa byed/ gnod sbyin zha 'on la sogs kuna~X/ /sgrub tshe 'di nyid dga~X' 'o zhes/ /rab grags gang 'di'i rgyud sogs las/ /snyinga~X po~X khol phyung de tsam lags/ /phyag rdor khang bu brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal nas/ /kun gyi thugs dang dbyer med pa'i/ /gsang ba'i bdag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /'byung po kun 'dul bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang sems hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gi mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

rang nyid phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mig sman ltar gnag pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal gdangs pa ljags 'gril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya 'ching bar mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon 'og mas sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs pa zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang bas tshogs bdag glang po che'i gdong can mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bhu ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog sogs sam/ dpal chen dri med nam mkha'i mdangs dang ldan/ /dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūṃ sgra 'brug stong che/ /'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad pa 'gems/ /phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ de nas hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla zhing*/ oṃ bhu ta ḍā ma ra bhu ta a ti pa ti ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ ki ri ṭī na/ sarba bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsi sā dha ya swāhā/ zhes pa'ang bzlas la thun gyi mthar stong pa nyid du bsdus la mnyam par bzhagaslar yang lha skur langs la gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag sogs bsngo bas rgyas thebs par bya/ gtor chog ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ spyan drangs la/ oṃ bhu ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ a kā ro sogs lan bdun gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol btab spyi dang mthun par bya/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams kyang bya/ 'di la sgrub thabs rgyas par sgom na/ mgor tshogs zhing tshogs bsag sbyor zhing*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab kyang bya/ gdan zla gdan dang*/ phyag dang po gnyis dang*/ phyi ma gnyis rnam 'gyur brjes pa dang*/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya'i dod du hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa dang*/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ zhabs 'og tu 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa mig gsum lag bzhi gri thod ḍā ma ru rtse gsum rnams 'dzin pa ste/ dbang phyug chen po mnan pa sogs ni 'dam ka yin pas/ sgrub thabs tha dad pa yin par mi bsam mo/ /'byung 'dul gsar ma ltar na/ snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ mthing nag spu shad tsam gsal btab/ rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ thun mong ba sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra zhing*/ khyad par lhag por gtor dbang bskur ba'i lugs kyang yod cing*/ 'byung 'dul gsar ma la ni/ gnas lnga nas 'byung 'dul rigs lnga spros te/ slob ma'i gnas lnga bstim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang thob par mos shing*/ de nas sku'i rjes gnang dang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba'i sgom bzlas kyis lung phog la/ lha sku spro bsdu/ yig 'bru spro bsdu/ phyag mtshan spro bsdu/ me dpung kho na spro bsdu ste/ 'du 'phro khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin/ yig 'bru sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin/ gnam lcags dbur mo'i ting nge 'dzin/ me 'bar klong chen gyi ting nge 'dzin/ mi dmigs bzhir grags pa rnams rim pa bzhin phog la/ de re re la'ang gsol btab re mdzad pa'i lugs gda'/

gsar ma 'di la thugs kyi rjes gnang*/ gtor dbang kho na yin/ 'di la me dbang gi tha snyad bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /shin tu byin rlabs che'o zhes/ /blo ldan kuna~X gyis dga~X' bar bsngags/ /sgrub thabs mi 'dra sna tshogs kyi/ /dgongs pa snyinga~X po~X tsam du dril/ /phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te brgyad pa'o// //gcig zhus/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrubs thabs rin chen 'byung gnas bzhugs/ - PAGE 138 -- PAGE 137 -- PAGE 1 - EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
